title: SUPER COMMANDO RAGHAV
d: Bharat ke potential threats se ladne alag-alag deshon mein assign kiye jaane waala, ek undefeated soldier... aise mission par jaane ko taiyaar ho gaya, jo kisi desh ya battlefield mein nahi... balki university mein tha. Aakhir aisa kya tha, jo usne is mission ko chuna? Aur kya tha, use wahaan milne waali ladki ka raaz? Show Team: Virendra Kushwah

title: MONEY MAN
d: Raj ke gareebi se joojh rahe jeevan mein ek U-turn aaya jab use pata chala ki uske pita uske liye Kuber jaisi sampatti aur science & technology ki andekhi duniya chhodkar chale gaye the, jisse woh na keval ameer ban gaya balki ek superhuman bhi.

title: UPGRADE
d: Ek nimn madhyam vargeey parivaar mein janme aur pale-badhe Yash ko pata hai ki Bangalore jaise shahar mein use aarthik roop se sthir hona zaroori hai. Yash ke apne sapne hain aur woh unhe haasil karne ke liye betaab hai, jab tak ki use Magic System naam ki koi cheez nahi mil jaati jo uski zindagi ulat-pulat kar deti hai. Yash ka maanna hai ki yeh system uski paison ki samsya ka samaadhaan kar sakta hai aur use ab aur kaam karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Yeh Magic System kya hai? Yash iske saath kya karta hai? Yeh uski aur uske parivaar ki kaise madad karta hai?

title: SHABDWANI
d: Ghar waalon ke dabaab ke kaaran ek naami businessman Shabd, madhyam vargi parivaar ki ladki Vani se shaadi toh kar leta hai par kabhi use apni biwi ka darja nahi de paata kyunki uska pyaar Vani nahi koi aur hai.

title: PASSIONATE LOVE
d: Yeh kahani do aise logon ki hai. Jinki duniya ek-doosre se bilkul alag hai. Aastha Sharma ek madhyamvargeey parivaar se hain, toh waheen Arjun Singh Rathore Bharat ke ek bahut bade business tycoon hain. Aastha aur Arjun pehli hi mulaqat mein jhagad pade aur ek-doosre se nafrat karne lage. Aastha ko Arjun ke niji sachiv ki naukri mil jaati hai, jisse Aastha bahut khush thi kyunki woh is baat se anjaan thi ki Arjun uska boss hai. Jab Aastha ko pata chalta hai ki uska boss Arjun hai, toh woh naukri se isteefa dene ki sochti hai, lekin woh chhe maheene se pahle naukri nahi chhod sakti thi kyunki usne contract paper par sign kar diye the. Waheen, Aastha ko pareshan karne ke liye Arjun usse apne niji kaam karwane lagta hai. Jise maanna nahi chahti thi lekin majboori mein use karna padta hai. Waheen, Aastha ki zindagi mein ek aise shakhs ki entry hoti hai, jo kisi bhi qeemat par Aastha se shaadi karna chahta tha. Jo dono ki zindagi palat deta hai aur Arjun aur Aastha ki shaadi ho jaati hai, kya dono us shaadi ko nibha payenge?

title: KALARI WARRIOR
d: Kalkin, ek saadharan bhikhhaari jo kabhi yoddha tha, Air City ke aasmaan mein toofaan aane ke baad ek mahaan yuddh ka mook gawaah ban jaata hai. Is sangharsh ke dauran, use pavitra amrit beej milta hai, jo uski supt jeevan shakti ko jaagrit karta hai. Ab, woh ek nayi aur khatarnaak duniya mein qadam rakhta hai, jahaan andhakaar ka raja Asthiyaan apni vinaashakaari yojanaon ke saath ubhar raha hai. Vishwaasghaat, shatruuta aur aantarik sangharsh se joojhte hue, Kalkin ko yeh tay karna hoga ki kya woh is andhakaar ko samaapt kar sakta hai ya duniya hamesha ke liye Asthiyaan ke saaye mein doobe rahegi. Creative Team - Jaagrit Vijay Mehta (Creative Director), Akhlaq Khan (Lekhak), Chirag Khatri (Nirmata)

title: THE NEW AVATAR
d: Ek bahaadur raajkumaar, Daksh ko uski apni mangetar Chinaai dhoka deti hai aur berahmi se maar deti hai. Daksh ki maut ke baad haalaat tab badte hain jab Chinaai ko raajya ki rani bana diya jaata hai. Daksh ki hatya ke peeche ki asli wajah koi nahi jaanta. Daksh ka shareer toh mar gaya hai, lekin uski aatma uske saath hue anyaay ka badla lena chahti hai. Yeh pata lagane ke liye ki kya hua tha, Daksh ki aatma ek chhote ladke ke shareer mein chali jaati hai jo apni besahara aur garib maa ke saath rehta hai. Ab Daksh ko na sirf ek raajkumaar ke taur par balki ek besahara chhote ladke ke taur par bhi insaaf chahiye. Aage kya hota hai? Kya Daksh apni hatya ke peeche ki sachaai jaan pata hai? Kya woh us chhote ladke aur uski maa ki madad kar pata hai? Show Team: Veerendra Kushwaha

title: DANGEROUS DIL
d: Saysha, ek khubsurat yuva ladki, puri tarah se toot gayi jab use pata chala ki uska premee apne sabse achhe dost ke saath use dhoka de raha hai. Phir unki mulaqat sanyogvash Abhay Khanna se hui, jo ek prasiddh vyavsayi the, jo apne bure swabhaav aur kruur maanasikta ke liye badnaam the. Woh Saysha ke parivaar ka purana dushman tha. Is ghatna se Saysha ki zindagi puri tarah se badal jaati hai. Abhay uski sundarta aur swabhaav par mohit ho jaata hai. Kya in do bilkul vipareet kirdaaron ko antattah pyaar ho jaayega? Aage kya hoga jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye 'Dangerous Dil'

title: EK LADKI KO DEKHA TO
d: Kisi ke saath physical hue bina, 120 kg wazn waali 18 saal ki Anika ko pata chalta hai ki woh pregnant hai. Lekin 6 saal baad jab Anika apni beti ke saath shaandaar waapsi karte hue Manali lauti hai, toh woh sabhi log jo use naapasand karte the, ab use apni zindagi mein wapas paane ke liye kuch bhi karne ko taiyaar hain. Kya Anika apne doosre judwaan bacche ko dhundh payegi aur kya woh pata laga payegi ki uske bacchon ka pita kaun hai? Show by: Drishti, Amitabh, Vandana

title: MANI ASTRA
d: Rohan ki zindagi waisi nahi hoti jaisi usne sochi thi. Uski patni use niji aur peshevar taur par itna naakaamyaab maankar chhod deti hai. Lekin har samsya ka samaadhan hota hai, Rohan ke samaadhan ke saath ek ratna juda hua tha jo use sanyog se mil jaata hai aur uski zindagi hamesha ke liye badal deta hai. Lekhak: Nitin Singhal. Show Team: Ratish Satish Mangalam, Riddhi Kotecha, Amar Pandey.

title: KHO GAYE HUM KAHAN
d: Devika ko uske apne dada ne das saal tak ek prayogshala mein baandhkar rakha tha. Bechaari Devika, jo zanjeeronse bandhi thi, jald se jald aazaad hokar apne dada se door jaana chahti thi. Ek din, Devika ko aakhirkar apne dada ke changul se bhaagne ka mauka mil hi gaya jab jis prayogshala mein woh qaid thi, usme aag lag gayi. Devika ke liye cheezein behtar hone lagi, jisne pashu chikitsak banne ke liye padhai shuru kar di, lekin lagta hai zindagi ne uske liye aur bhi kai aashchary chhipa rakhe the. Ek behtar bhavishy ki umeed kar rahi Devika achanak behosh ho gayi aur jab use hosh aaya toh woh ek alag hi duniya mein jaagi. Is nayi jagah par Devika ko ek bilkul nayi pehchaan mili. Aage kya hota hai? Devika is nayi duniya mein kaise zinda rehti hai? Yeh nayi duniya kahaan hai aur Devika yahaan kyun hai? Is nayi duniya mein Devika ke safar ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye Kho Gaye Hum Kahaan sunte rahiye, sirf Pocket FM par. Show Team: Himanshu, Hardik

title: RUTHLESS
d: Arjun ek jung ka sipahi jise bachpan se hi logon ko maarna sikhaya gaya ho aur use log killing machine ke naam se jaante hain jo apne ek mission ko pura karke jab waapas aata hai tab use phir se ek naya mission diya jaata hai, jahaan use aam logon ke beech rehkar us mission ko pura karna hai, par kya Arjun aisa kar payega. Arjun jo kabhi aam logon ke beech nahi raha, na use dukh aur sukh ka ehsaas hai, na dard ki use parwah hai na maut ka khauf. Kya Arjun apne is mission ko pura kar payega aur kya woh apne aap ko aam logon ki tarah rakh payega par is mission par aane ka uska ek aur maqsad hai. Wahin doosri taraf hai Naira Jaiswal ek behad khoobsoorat aur chanchal ladki jise is duniya mein kya ho raha hai uski parwah nahi woh bas apni masti mein doob rahi hai magar is baat se anjaan ki uski zindagi par bahut se logon ki nazar hai jo mauka milte hi Naira ki zindagi khatm kar denge. Toh kaisi hogi Naira aur Arjun ki zindagi jab dono ka saamna hoga aur Arjun ke is mission mein aane ka doosra maqsad kya hai.

title: JOKER THE ASLI HERO
d: Abhimanyu, ek antarrashtriya jaasoos, apne peshe ki bajaay apne desh ko chunata hai aur apne kaam ko alvida kehkar Bharat lautta hai taaki woh gumnaam zindagi ji sake... lekin laautne par use pata chalta hai ki uske mafia pita ka kaarobaar tabaah ho chuka hai. Uske bade bhai ki hatya ho chuki hai... aur uske doosre bhai ko bhi dushmanon ne pakad liya hai... Kya Abhimanyu mushkilon ke is chakravyuh se bahar nikal payega?... Kya Abhimanyu gumnaam rahega? Kya woh apne bhai ko zinda rehte hue dhundh payega?

title: RAJKUMARI SULOCHNA
d: Yeh kahani hai 400 saalon se apne mata-pita aur apne saath hue anyaay ka badla lene ka intezaar kar rahi nark mein baithi ek jaadui raajkumari Sulochna ki, uske punarjanm ki, uske narak se Prithvi lok tak ke romanchak safar aur aane waale andekhe khatron ki.

title: MISSION MANGALSUTRA
d: Uska parivar gayab ho chuka hai. Uske dushman uske kareeb aa rahe hain. Lekin agent Panther ki ladai sirf badle ki nahi hai—yah wafadari, sachhais aur ek aise rahasya ki ladai hai jo sab kuch badal sakta hai. Rachnakar: Nazia Qureshi, Sanel Kapoor

title: THE MAGICIAN'S SECRET
d: Aadish ko ek kulin vyakti ke putra ke roop mein naya jeevan prapt hua aur use apne pichhle janam se ek shaktishali quantum computer bhi mila. Kya is vishaal shakti ke saath Aadish sarvkalik mahan jadugar ban paega?

title: RAJPUTRA TANISHQ
d: Yeh Yajpal vansh ke raajkumaar Tanishq ki yuvavastha ki kahani hai, jo kamzor aur goonga hone ke baavajood apne arjit shastra kaushal aur dridhta se shakti prapt karta hai.

title: LORD OF DARK WORLD
d: Vicky samay yatra ke zariye shaaitaanon ki dharti par pahunchta hai aur yaheen uski zindagi mein uthal-puthal mach jaati hai. Ek boodhe jaadoogar Aaryaman ke shareer mein phase Vicky ke paas shaaitaanon ke beech zinda rehne ka bas ek hi raasta hai, use jaadoogar ke shareer mein hi rehna hoga. Vicky ka shaaitaanon ki dharti par samay yatra karna na sirf uske liye, balki Aaryaman ke liye bhi jokhim bhara hai. Aage kya hoga? Kya Vicky khud ko shaaitaanon se bacha payega aur apni duniya mein wapas laut payega? Jaanne ke liye sune Vicky ki samay yatra ki dilchasp kahani Lord of Dark World

title: TERE ISHQ MEIN
d: Aastha ek maasoom, chulbuli ladki, jo sirf apni maami ki beti ki shaadi mein shareek hone aayi thi, lekin kismat ne aisa khel khela ki woh khud is shaadi ki dulhan ban gayi! Aur dulhan bhi kiski? Heartless businessman Armaan Singhania ki, jo rishton par nahi, sirf paison par yakeen karta tha. Shaadi ke din dulhan Priyanka bhaag gayi, aur dosh Aastha par aa gaya! Parivaar ki izzat bachaane ke liye use bali ka bakra bana diya gaya. Ab kya yeh shaadi sirf ek jabardasti hogi ya Aastha Armaan ki nafrat mein pyaar dhundh payegi? Jaanne ke liye suniye, 'Tere Ishq Mein'

title: VAJRA
d: Saat saal gumaami mein bitaane ke baad, Viraj nirdayi Supreme Commander 'Vajra' bankar apne parivaar ka sammaan wapas paane ke liye lautta hai. Bhrasht rishtedaaron, shaktishali vyaapariyon aur raajnitik dushmanon ke khilaaf khada Viraj vyaktigat aur khatarnaak dono hi tarah ki ladaai ladta hai. Lekin uski sabse kathin ladaai apni patni Saanvi ko wapas paane ki hogi, jise woh peeche chhod gaya tha.

title: LOVE LUCK AUR LOCKET
d: Ek besahara ladka apne ameer sasural waalon ka mazaak udaata rehta hai, jab tak use apne dada dwara chhoda gaya ek jade pendant nahi mil jaata! Yeh uske aage ke jeevan ko kaise badlega? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Rashi Upadhyay

title: MARRIED TO A HARD HEARTED
d: Ek durghatna mein Raghuvanshi parivar tabaah ho jata hai aur is durghatna ka dosh Shaurya Rajput par madh diya jata hai! Raghuvanshi parivar ka beta Shivaye Raghuvanshi, Shaurya Rajput se badla lena chahta hai! Lekin Shaurya ki chhoti behen Arya ek saazish mein fans jati hai. Mansik roop se bimar Arya apne bhai ko bachane ke liye Shivaye ki har yatna sahan karti hai! Doosri or, Drishti bhi apne bhai-behnon ko bachane ke liye Divyansh ke paas jati hai aur bina soche-samjhe is shart par khud ko Divyansh ke hawale kar deti hai ki iske baad wah uske bhai-behnon ko riha kar dega. Kya ye dono behnen Raghuvanshi bhaiyon se bach paengi? Kya wakai durghatna Shaurya ki wajah se hui hai? Kya Shivaye Arya ki bimari ko samajh paega? Is dushmani ka kya anjaam hoga? Kya Shaurya apni behnon ko bacha paega? Aur jaanne ke liye 'Married To A Hard Hearted' sunein.

title: MY CEO GIRL
d: Mumbai chhodkar pichhle do saalon se Goa mein akeli reh rahi Sara apne boss Ajit Sabarwal ko apna pita maanti thi. Badkismati se, jab Shri Sabarwal ka achanak nidhan ho gaya, toh Sara sadme mein aa gayi. Isse pahle ki woh Ajit Sabarwal ki maut ko sweekar kar paati, ek aur chaunkane waali baat saamne aayi. Shri Sabarwal dwara chhhodi gayi vasiyat mein ek baat ne use hairaan kar diya. Iske alaawa, vasiyat ki wajah se unke iklaute bete Neil aur Sara ke beech ek ajeebogreeb ankahi kadwaahat paida ho gayi. Aage kya hota hai? Vasiyat mein kya hai? Neil aur Sara ke liye kya hai? Jaanne ke liye My CEO Girl dekhein.

title: SECRET WARRIOR SHIVANSH
d: Yeh kahani Shivansh naam ke ek 12 saal ke ladke ki hai jo galti se ek rahasyamay system se takra jaata hai. Yeh pranali Shivansh ke andar vileen ho jaati hai aur use atyant shaktishali bana deti hai. Unka saada jeevan ab sahasik aur romanchak ho gaya hai. Shivansh, jo ek bahut hi saadharan dalit jeevan ji raha tha, achanak ek roller coaster ki sawaari karta hai aur use ek super yoddha banaata hai! Uske naye aur damdaar jeevan mein kya hone waala tha..? Jaanne ke liye suniye 'Secret Warrior Shivansh'

title: CARE TAKER
d: Tanuja, ek akeli bacchi jo ek behad ameer aur pratishthit parivaar mein pali-badhi hai, apne jeevan ke pyaar ke kaaran apne pita ko dhoka dene aur unka vyavsay hatiyaane ke liye unpar jhuthe aarop lagaane ke baad gehre avsaad mein chali jaati hai aur baad mein apni hi sabse achhi dost se shaadi kar leti hai! Is poori ghatna ne Tanuja ko itna gehra sadma aur karz diya ki use woh shahar chhodna pada jahaan woh pali-badhi thi aur ek nayi jagah par jaana pada jahaan woh kisi ko nahi jaanti. Tanuja ek aise yuvak ki dekhbhaal karne wali ke roop mein kaam karna shuru karti hai jo ateet mein hui kisi durghatna ke kaaran hilne-dulne mein asamarth hai. Kya yeh naya vyakti Tanuja ke jeevan mein koi khushiyan laayega? Kya woh kabhi apne kadwe ateet se ubar payegi? Poori kahani sune Care Taker. Show Team - Mithilesh Gupta, Hardik Gupta

title: MR. MONEY
d: Gareebi aur apamaan ka jeevan jeene waale Abhiram ka jeevan raaton-raat kaise badal gaya? Woh ek company ka CEO kaise ban gaya? Aakhir anath Abhiram ke mata-pita kahaan se aaye the? Kya uski patni Chaaru uske jhooth ko maaf kar payegi? Creative Team: Ratish Marulkar, Vidya Sarangi

title: BRAHMAND KA RAKSHAK AI VOICE
d: Kshitij, Raja Ransinh dwara shaasit Navangana naamak ek chhote se raajya ka raajkumar hai. Haalaanki yeh raajya chhota tha, phir bhi yeh shaantipurn aur samriddh tha. Lekin jald hi, bhaagya kroor ho gaya - 200ven star ke do shaktishali dragon ne hamla kar diya aur poore raajya ko nasht kar diya. Kshitij hi ekamaatra jeevit bacha. Kya Kshitij apne khoye hue parivaar ko dhundh payega? Aur kya woh apne raajya ke vinaash ke peeche ki sacchai ka pata laga payega? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye 'Brahmand Ka Rakshak'

title: ATHARVA DHARTI KA RAKSHAK
d: Atharva ek aisi duniya mein rah raha hai jo aaj se 250 saal aage hai. Use pata chalta hai ki uski maa ek aisa rahasya chhupa rahi hai jisse prithvi ki suraksha khatre mein pad sakti hai. Atharva ko apni vishesh shaktiyon ka gyaan nahi hai aur use yah bhi pata hai ki poore brahmaand ki suraksha usi par nirbhar karti hai. Kya Atharva is rahasya ko ujaagar kar paega aur dushmanon ka samna kar paega?

title: PHIR MILENGE
d: Kritika naadaan thi jo yeh sochti thi ki pyaar aasaan hota hai. Uska sabse bada din apne pyaar se hamesha ke liye juda hone ke saath khatam hua. Lekin har hamesha hamesha ke liye nahi hota! Kritika ka punarjanm hua hai, lekin kya woh apne pyaar se dobara milne ke liye taiyaar hai? Kya woh is udhar ki zindagi mein khushiyaan pa sakegi? Phir Milenge Kritika ke jeevan ke unche padaavon ko darshata hai. Aur jaanne ke liye jude rahiye. Show Team: Aayush, Prakhar

title: SILENT MONEY SYSTEM
d: Varun Shetty ek gareeb lekin dayaalu vishwavidyalaya ka chhaatra tha. Uski premika Shreya ne use sabke saamne apmaaanit kiya aur ameer ladke Gaurav Kapoor ke liye use chhod diya. Dil toot jaane par Varun ghar lauta, lekin tabhi achanak uske naye iPhone mein kharabi aa gayi. 'Chandrama ki Devi' aur 'Narak ke Raja' jaise preshkon se rahasyamayi laal lifaafe aane lage. Us kshan Silent Money System sakriya ho gaya, jo ek gupt kaaryakram tha jisne chupchap Varun ko asimit dhan, shakti aur prabhav pradaan kiya. Kuch hi dinon mein Varun ek sangharshrat chhaatra se ek gumanaam arabpati ban gaya. Apne swabhaav ke anurup, usne sabse pehle Sharma Uncle aur Anshika ki madad ki aur unhe anmol praacheen kalakritiyan bhent kin, jinmein das million se adhik keemat ki jade ki ek hairpin bhi shaamil thi. Ab sab samajh gaye... Varun Shetty ab pehle jaisa ladka nahi raha tha. Woh ek khaamosh arabpati ban chuka tha. Aur Shreya aur Gaurav Kapoor se uska badla lena... abhi toh bas shuru hi hua tha.

title: ROMEO KI RAASLEELA
d: Ek alaukik praani ko swarg ke raja dwara anant kaaraavaas ki saza sunaai jaati hai, jahaan uski mulaqat ek rahasyamay boodhe vyakti se hoti hai jo use aazaad hone ka mauka deta hai. Toh kya Romeo ki aatma ko mukti milegi? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Rashi Upadhyay.

title: PYAR TO HONA HI THA
d: Kehte hain pyaar umra ka bandhan nahi hota, lekin kya ye sach hai? Kya chabbees saal ki Aarti apne se das saal bade insaan se pyaar kar payegi? Aarti ko aise rishte mein aane ke liye kisne majboor kiya? Rishton ke taane-baane mein uljhi ek aisi kahani jo pyaar, dosti, dhoke aur laalaach jaise ehsaason ko ek nayi paribhaasha degi aur in cheezon ko lekar aapka nazariya badal degi. Bemel rishton ki ye anokhi kahani suniye Pyaar Toh Hona Hi Tha sirf PocketFM par. Show Team: Brajesh Kumar Atulkar, Hardik

title: SECRET AFFAIR
d: Apni pehli shaadi ki raat ko Tanvi pehli baar apne pati superstar Vidyut Nomani se mili. Haalaanki, Vidyut pichhle aath saalon se Tanvi se nafrat karta hai, jiske chalte woh kai mauqon par Tanvi ke saath bura bartaav aur apamaan karta hai. Usne ek bacche ke liye Tanvi se shaadi ki thi, jabki Tanvi ko apne bhai ke operation ke liye moti rakam ki zaroorat thi. Tanvi ke boss ne use Vidyut Nomani ki gupt patni ke baare mein pata lagane ke liye kaha, jabki Vidyut ne use pahle hi chetaavni di thi ki woh kisi bhi qeemat par apni gupt shaadi ka khulasa na kare. Vidyut ki film ki sah-kalakar Yamini Sahay ek pal mein Tanvi ko usse door rehne ki chetaavni dekar thappad maar deti hai. Tanvi ke apamaan ke kaaran, Vidyut poori film crew ke saamne Yamini ko daanta hai aur film chhod deta hai. Kya yeh Tanvi ke prati Vidyut ke hriday parivartan ki shuruaat hai?

title: EK THI SHIRIN (OLD)
d: Kahani yuva aur khubsurat Shirin ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jise uske premi ne maar daala hai. Uski maut ke baad haalaat tab badal jaate hain jab marne ke bajaay, Shirin ko ek alag yug mein, ek naye shareer mein, ek nayi zindagi milti hai. Naye shareer aur nayi zindagi ke saath, Shirin ko kai nayi chunautiyon ka saamna karna padta hai. Hukum Singh se khud ko bachane se lekar Bhim Singh ke pyaar mein padne tak, woh ek nayi zindagi ka anubhav karti hai. Shirin ki nayi zindagi mein kya hota hai? Uske liye aur kya hai? Jaanne ke liye sune Ek Thi Shirin sirf Pocket FM par. Show Team: Aayush, Richa

title: MY COMMANDO WIFE
d: Arohi ek aalsi ladki jise apni life mein sabse zyada agar kisi cheez se pyaar hai toh woh sirf uski neend se hi hai. Lekin ek din woh apne uncle jo ki ek scientist hai unke invention ke dwara khud ke dimaag mein ek advanced system chip ko install kara leti hai. Ab Arohi ki life mein aage kya hoga? Kya uski zindagi saamaanya ho paayegi?

title: KHATTA MEETHA PYAR
d: Ye kahani bilkul aisi hi hai khatti meethi aur pyaari si, ye kahani sirf ek ladke aur ladki ki kahani nahi, do parivaaraon se judi hui hai. Aarzu jo natkhat si jo mann mein ho woh kehne aur karne waali, ek suspensive si ladki hai jo apne doston par jaan chhidakti hai, khaas kar Ruhi par. Aarzu aur Abhinav jo college ke pehle din se hi ek doosre ke dushman ban jaate hain lekin inke parivaaraon mein utna hi zyada pyaar hai. Abhinav ke bhai Neil aur Aarzu ki behen Ruhi ko ho jaata hai pehle hi din ek doosre se pyaar lekin kabhi keh nahi paaye. Neil aur Ruhi ko milaate milaate kab Aarzu aur Abhinav ki nok jhonk waali ladaai khatte meethe pyaar mein badal gayi unhe pata nahi chala. Lekin mushkil tab hoti hai jab Aarzu ke hi bachpan ke dost ko ho jaata hai us se pyaar, ab kya karegi Aarzu? Kise chunegi? Apne pyaar ko ya phir bachpan ki dosti ko? Kya Neil aur Ruhi ko mila payenge Abhinav aur Aarzu? Kya hoga love triangle ka?

title: TERE SANG YAARA
d: Devika ki zindagi mein chaar chaand lagane aaya Neil naam ka raajkumaar, par shaadi ke kuch hi dinon mein aaya Devika ki zindagi mein toofaan. Aakhir aisa kya hua ki Neil ne Devika par goli chala di? Beinteha pyaar aur is toofaan mein aakhir kiski hui jeet, jaanne ke liye suniye Tere Sang Yaara,

title: TERI MERI EK ZINDAGI
d: Dhokhe ke chalte Amitash aur Pakhi ki mulaqat hoti hai. Pakhi ki chhoti si duniya mein bas uska teen saal ka beta aur uske dost hi the. Kya Pakhi Amitash aur uske bete ko god legi? Content/Creative team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Jyoti Pal.

title: DEVIL'S LOVE WITH HER
d: Ye kahani hai Ansh Singh Rathore aur Avni Sachdeva ki. Ansh gusse, nafrat, arrogant aur cruel nature ka tha, to wahin Avni thi hansti-muskurati aur chulbuli si ladki. Jaane-anjaane mein Mysore ke jungle mein Avni ki mulaqat Ansh se hui. Jahan Ansh kaale libaas mein liptta pahad ki choti par khada dur jungalon ko dekh raha tha, aur use dekh Avni apne qadam uski taraf badhane lagi, lekin tabhi wahan achanak hi uske samne kuch ajeeb se dikhne wale log aa gaye, aur jis wajah se Avni hamesha ke liye ho gayi Ansh ki qaid mein giraft. Pehli nazar ki wo nafrat kya Avni ko kabhi Ansh ke pinjare se nikaal paegi? Aur kaun the wo ajeeb se dikhne wale log? Aakhir kyun karta tha Ansh, Avni se itni nafrat? Aur kya is nafrat mein kabhi pyar ka rang ghul paega? Kya Ansh jaise heartless person ko apne dil ki baat samajh aayegi?

title: REBORN FOR FAMILY
d: Yeh kahani hai aseem prem se aseem ghrina tak ke safar ki. Isha Chauhan ek mahatvaakaankshi ladki thi jise dikhaave ki koi parwaah nahi thi. Uski sabse kareeb dost aur uske pyaar ne hi uski jaan le li. Doosri or, uske pati use bahut pyaar karta tha, lekin woh uske pyaar ko kabhi samajh nahi payi. Lekin jab uske apne premee aur dost ne hi uski hatya kar di, toh woh sirf usi ke baare mein soch rahi thi aur yeh soch rahi thi ki usne apne pati ke saath itna bura kyun kiya. Lekin ab kuch nahi kiya ja sakta tha kyunki ab woh marne waali thi, marne se pahle uski aankhon mein badle ki aisi aag thi jo kisi ko bhi jala sakti thi. Kya Ishwar use apni galti sudhaarne ka doosra mauka dega?

title: SHOORVEER
d: Aaj se 100 saal baad, science aur technology mein tarakki ke saath insaan ab teleport kar sakte hain. Teleportation jo is grah par har insaan ke liye ek vardaan sabit hua hai, uski apni kuch shartein hain. Yahaan insaanon ko past ya future mein nahi, balki puri tarah se ek alag grah par teleport kiya ja raha hai. Is naye grah par, insaanon ke paas ajeeb jeevon aur jaanwaron ke beech rehne ke alaawa koi chaara nahi hai. Kya hota hai jab teleportation insaanon ko ek alag grah par le jaata hai? Woh wahan apni jaan bachane ke liye kaise ladenge? Is naye dilchasp grah aur teleport kiye gaye insaanon ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye sirf Shoorveer sune.

title: TRULY DEEPLY MEDLEY
d: Puraskaar vijeta abhineta Rehan ke paas duniya ki saari khushiyaan hain. Woh apni prasiddhi mein itna khoya hua hai ki use yeh bhi nahi pata ki Sara aur Pari uski zindagi ka aham hissa hain. Sara, Pari ko Rehan ki zindagi se kyun chhupa rahi hai? Pari ke astitva ke baare mein pata chalne par Rehan ki zindagi kaise badlegi? Zindagi, shohrat aur pyaar ki yeh kahani suniye. Show Team: Pragati Gupta, Hardik Gupta

title: BRAHMYODHA THE DESTROYER
d: 16 saal ka Vidyut Brahma Yoddha banne ke safar par nikal pada hai. Lambe baal, gora chehra, gathila shareer aur lambi kad-kaathi wala yeh yuvak duniya ka sabse shaktishaali yoddha banne ka sapna dekhta hai. Lekin ek sachcha yoddha banne ki raah uske liye aasaan nahi hogi. Is safar mein use anjaane aur andekhe dushmanon ka saamna karna padega! Phir bhi, Vidyut ko Brahma Yoddha banne mein madad karne aur uska maargdarshan karne ke liye, saat ajeya yoddha uske saath khade honge. Vidyut ke jeevan ka uddeshya apne laapata pita ko dhundhna aur apne dushmanon ko sazaa dilaana hai. Iske liye, use itna shaktishali yoddha banna hoga ki woh Panchtatttvon par vijay praapt kar sake—tabhi woh vaastav mein Brahma Yoddha ban payega. Apni peeth par Panchtatttvon ke pratik chinh, haath mein sunhara bhala aur gale mein chamakta hua locket liye, Vidyut apne asambhav mission par nikal pada hai! Kya Vidyut apne pita ko dhundh payega? Woh itna paraakrami yoddha kaise banega ki duniya use 'Brahma Yoddha' kahegi?

title: BREAK-UP WALA PYAAR
d: Karan Grover aur Sanjana Arora, ateet mein kisi galatafahmi ki wajah se juda hue do premi, kismat se ek baar phir ek doosre se takraate hain. Phir shuru hoti hai us khoye hue pyaar ko dobaara jagaane ki kashmakash aur usi ke saath shuru hota hai kai chhupe hue razon ka pardaafaash. Kya tezi se badalte haalaton aur pareshaniyon ke beech Karan aur Sanjana phir se ek doosre ke kareeb aa payenge? Agar milte hain toh kya ek jealous ex-girlfriend unhe saath rehne degi? Kya hain woh raaz jinhone kiya tha in do pagal premiyon ko juda.

title: IMPERFECT SOULMATES
d: Kehte hain ki pehla pyaar hamesha khaas hota hai. Ek khubsurat raat jo Jiya aur Aditya ki zindagi ki sabse achhi raat maani ja rahi thi, unke liye sabse bura sapna ban gayi. Dono ke beech haalaat bigad gaye aur aakhirkar, Jiya aur Aditya ne alag hone ka faisla kiya. Aaj, zindagi unhe phir se kareeb la rahi hai. Lagta hai ki kismat ne unke liye kuch aur hi soch rakha tha. Kya hota hai jab Jiya aur Aditya phir se ek-doosre se milte hain? Kya woh ab bhi ek-doosre ke liye waisa hi mehsoos karte hain? Jaanne ke liye Imperfect Soulmates sune. Show Team: Amit, Hardik

title: BILLIONAIRE HIDDEN WIFE
d: Kartik Shaurya business ki duniya ka king aur mafia ki duniya mein khauf ka naam KS. Kisi ko nahi pata ki dono ek hi shakhs hain. Lekin uski zindagi tab badalti hai jab ek ladki uski jaan bachaati hai. Wahi Anika, jise uska parivaar panauti maanta hai. Kartik dushmani ki aag mein Anika se shaadi toh kar leta hai, par use nahi pata ki woh usi ladki se shaadi kar chuka hai jisse woh beintehaa pyaar karne laga tha. Kya hoga jab yeh raaz khulega? Kya pyaar dushmani par bhaari padega ya sab kuch tabaah ho jaayega? Jaanne ke liye suniye, 'Billionaire Hidden Wife'

title: CHANAKYA
d: Yeh mahaan vidwaan Chanakya ki kahani hai, jinhone 2,600 saal pahle apne pavitra keshon ke samman mein Bharat ke itihaas ki dhara badal di aur ek ekikrit Bharat ki neev rakhi. Ek saadharan shikshak se, Chanakya ek raajneta ban gaye aur unhone Chandragupta Maurya ko Maurya vansh ki sthapna ke liye prashikshit kiya, jisse poore Bharatiya upamahadvip ko ekajut aur samridh kiya ja sake.

title: AMBAR-ASTRA
d: Fire se janmi Ambar ki magical duniya tabaahi ki kagaar par, jab chhal se chin li gayi uski powers! Kya Ambar kaali shaktiyon ko maat dekar apni powers ko wapas pa sakegi?

title: MAD FOR YOU
d: Ye kahani hai Maahir Agnihotri aur Mihir Oberoi ki, dono judwaan bhai jo 6 saal ki umra mein bichhad gaye the, dono ek doosre se anjaan apni duniya ke mashhoor business tycoon ban chuke the. Jo kisi cheez ko paana chahte hain, woh use paakar hi rehte hain. Dono bhai ek doosre ko dhundhne ke safar mein Nishtha aur Arohi se milte hain aur milte hi unhe dhundhne ki har mumkin koshish karte hain. Nishtha ki zindagi mein ek taraf uske pita ki beruhi hai, toh Arohi ki zindagi mein maa-baap ka pyaar nahi hai. Toh ab dekhna ye hai ki kismat in chaaron ko ek doosre se kaise milaati hai? Kya inhe inka pyaar milega? Kya dono bhai apne junoon ki saari hadein paar kar denge? Pyaar, junoon, ghamand aur paane ki chaahat mein inka anjaam kya hoga? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Mad For You aur dekhte rahiye

title: INSTA MILLIONAIRE
d: Kismat ka khel insaan ko ek raat mein kangal bhi bana sakta hai aur maalamaal bhi, theek aisa hi kuch Lakshman Lal Agarwal urf Lucky ke saath hua. Ek raat ne uski zindagi mein kaafi halchal macha di jis raat pyaar mein dhoka milne ke baad uska dil khaali hua. Theek usi raat bhagwan ne uski jeb hari-bhari kar di. Ye hai anlucky Lucky ki lucky lakhpati hone ki kahani aakhir kaise anlucky Lucky, Lucky bana lakhpati? Aur kaise ek raat mein badal gayi uski kismat? Jaanne ke liye suniye Insta Millionaire

title: PAATAL
d: Yah Paatal Lok ke ek rajya Vish Lok ki kahani hai. Vish Lok ke raja Hastar ki daasi se ek santan hai. Hastar ke kayi shatru hain, jinmein unke apne bhai bhi shamil hain. Santan ko bachpan se hi khatre ka samna karna padta hai. Ek din, ek jaadu hota hai aur uske baad sab kuch badal jata hai. Wah jaadu kya tha?

title: LOVE YOU SUPERSTAR
d: Ek chhote se shahar ke roodhivaadi parivaar se taalluk rakhne wali Aalia apne naye college ke dinon ka besabri se intezaar kar rahi hai. Lekin college ke pehle hi din use singing superstar Yuvraj se pyaar ho gaya, lekin kahani utni aasaan nahi thi jitni Aalia ne sochi thi? Aaiye uski kahani par chalte hain, kaise woh apne sapne aur apne pyaar ka peechha karti hai. Show Team: Mithilesh, Prakhar

title: KARMA CONNECTION
d: Karma, jo bachpan se hi gareebi aur parivaar ke sadasyon dwara pratadit kiya gaya hai, ek din apne ghar mein ek pushtaini locket paata hai. Locket ki taakat ko samajhte hue, Karma kai ghataanon se guzarta hai jo ek dilchasp kahani ki or le jaati hain, jiska naam hai Karma Connection. Content/Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor.

title: SHUNYA SAMRAT
d: Prithvi ke commando, Aakarsh ki aatma, uski hatya ke baad ek doosri duniya mein chali jaati hai. Is duniya mein log vibhinn martial arts ka gyaan praapt kar yoddha ban sakte hain. Woh na sirf yoddha ban sakte hain, balki hathiyaar banaane wale, vaidya aur rahasyamayi kalaon ke ustad bhi ban sakte hain. Is duniya mein pahunchane par Aakarsh ko ek anmol varadaan milta hai, jisse woh sarvashaktishali yoddha ban sakta hai. Aakarsh ka hatyaara kaun hai? Kya woh is nayi duniya ko apna bana payega aur sarvashaktimaan ke roop mein ubhar payega? Yeh jaanne ke liye, 'Shunya Samrat' sunte rahiye.

title: TU JAHAN MAIN WAHAN
d: Saumya aur Rishit ek-dusre se nafrat karte hain kyunki unki shaadi dhoke par aadharit thi. Unhe is baat ka bilkul bhi andaza nahi tha ki ajnabi, jinse we ek raat ke liye mile the, ek-dusre ke pyar mein pagal ho gaye the. Kya unhe kabhi is khubsurat sachhais ka pata chalega?

title: KYON DARD HAI ITNA ISHQ MEIN
d: Ridhima aur Rishit bachpan ke dost the aur 'Dil Hi Dil' film mein dono ek-doosre se pyaar bhi karte the. Lekin ateet mein Ridhima ke saath kuch aisa hua tha jisse Ridhima ko laga ki usne uske saath dosti ka bartaav nahi kiya. Pita ke dabaav mein aakar Ridhima ne usse shaadi kar li, lekin Ridhima ko laga ki usne usse sirf paison ke liye shaadi ki hai. Shaadi ke agle hi din Ridhima London chala gaya aur nau maheene baad jab woh lauta toh Sonia ko bhi saath le aaya. Ridhima ka talaak dekhkar Ridhima Sonia se shaadi karna chahta tha. Phir Ridhima ka accident ho gaya aur sabko laga ki woh mar gayi hai, lekin chaar saal baad Ridhima ko pata chala ki woh aur uska baccha Nishant zinda hain. Toh kya woh apni nafrat bhulakar apne bacche ke liye ek ho jaayenge? Woh kaun sa raaz tha jiski wajah se Sonia Ridhima ki zindagi mein aayi? Aakhir Ridhima se itna pyaar karte hue bhi Ridhima ne Sonia ka pyaar kyun sweekar kiya? Kya Ridhima aur Ridhima ke pyaar ka dard suhaag-e-ishq mein badal jaayega? Kyun dard hai itna ishq mein

title: HELP ME AISHA
d: 'Meri madad karo Aisha... meri madad karo!' Aisha ne aisi awaaz pahle bhi kai baar suni thi. College se ghar laute samay raaste mein ek qabrastan padta tha, jahaan uske saath ajeebogreeb ghataanayein ghaTne lagi thi. Us raat, apni study table par baithakar Aisha padhai kar rahi thi, tabhi usne khidki ki jaali hilte hue dekhi. Jab woh wahaan pahunchi, toh woh yeh dekhkar dang reh gayi ki ek parchhaai use behad daraaune dhang se ghur rahi hai. Aisha andheron mein aankhein gadaye ghur rahi thi. Isse pahle ki woh kuch kar paati, wahi awaaz uske kaanon mein phir goonnji - 'Meri madad karo Aisha!' Yeh kiski awaaz thi aur kaun usse madad maang raha tha? Khubsurat aur chanchal Aisha aur us daraauni awaaz ki is anokhi kahani ko jaanne ke liye suniye! HELP ME AISHA!

title: HRIDAYAM THE HEALER
d: Hridayam, jiski saadharan si zindagi... tab ek khatarnak mod leti hai, jab apni maa ko cancer se bachane ke liye woh apna accident karata hai aur use milti hai, uske pita ki anokhi shaktiyan! Shaktiyan, jinmein ilaaj ki behtarin khubi hai. Lekin kya woh kaabil ban payega un shaktiyon ke? Aur aage kya mod legi, uski zindagi? Jaanne ke liye sune Hridayam - The Healer

title: DIVINE POWER
d: Aap jaante hi hain ki agar bhavishy pehle se pata ho, toh chahe insaan ho ya daanav, har koi apne vinaash ko rokne ki poori koshish karega. Lekin niyati hamesha koi na koi raasta nikaal hi leti hai. Yeh kahani insaanon aur daanavon ke beech yuddh ki hai. Daanavon ko pata chalta hai ki Sen vansh ka uttaraadhikaari ek din sabhi daanavon ka naash karke ek mahaan yoddha banega. Isliye, woh us bachche ko maarne ki poori koshish karte hain. Yeh kahani isi aadhaar par aadhaarit hai.

title: SILENT LIES
d: Ye kahani hai Shri Tripathi aur Anay Ahuja ki. Anay ek laparwah insaan hai jis ki car se Shri ke pita ka accident ho jata hai aur is guilt mein wo akeli pad chuki Shri se shaadi karne ka faisla leta hai. Jabki wo Amayra se pyar karta tha. Kya hoga jab innocent Shri ko pata chalega ki uske pita ka accident usi ke pati ne kiya tha? Kya wo use maaf kar paegi? Kya mod legi inki zindagi? Kya Shri Anay ko ek zimmedaar insaan bana paegi? Aur kya Anay Shri se pyar kar paega aur Amayra ko bhool paega?

title: THE LEGEND OF JAY SIMHA
d: 16vi shatabdi mein Jay Singh ke roop mein punarjanm lene wala, 21vi shatabdi ka ek purv sainik, jise Jay Singhania ke naam se jaana jata hai, martial arts mein maharat hasil karta hai, jeevan-maran ki chunautiyon ka samna karta hai, aur satta hasil karne aur apne kul par lage abhishap ko door karne ke liye prachin rahashyon ko ujaagar karta hai. Show ki creative team - Saurabh Yadav (Creative Director), Rajinder Singh Pular (Creative Producer)

title: LIKHA HAI KYA LAKIRON MAIN
d: Ye kahani hai Ishani aur Meet ki, jo ek doosre se 5 saal baad dobara milte hai. Aaj Ishani ek magazine ke office mein chief editor hoti hai. Usi magazine ke liye use Meet Mehta ka interview lene jaana hota hai. Meet se milte hi use apne purane din yaad aane lagte hai. Saalon pehle, college ke dauran woh apne doston ki madad karte hue kareeb aaye the. Aaj Ishani apne ateet ko aise yaad karti hai, jaise kal ki hi baat ho. Itne saal baad bhi dono ke bheetar pyaar aur jazzbaat ghumad rahe hote hai. Aaj dobara jab woh kareeb aane lagte hai, Meet ka accident ho jaata hai. Kya Meet theek ho payega? Ishani jo ke ab ek maa hai kya Meet ko sab kuch sach bata payegi? Kya likha hai inki lakiron mein? Jaanne ke liye suniye Likha Hai Kya, Lakiron Mein sirf aapke apne

title: ZEHER HAI YA PYAAR HAI
d: Ek andheri raat mein, Swadha KK ki jaan bachati hai, jisse woh dono pyaar aur rahasyaon ke ek romanchak jaal mein uljh jaate hain. Kya in dono ki mulaqat pyaar ke gulabon mein tabdeel hogi ya zeher ke kaanton mein? Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Chirag Kulshreshtha

title: RAEESZADA
d: Mihir kabaad bechkar apni fees bharta hai, aur uski premika garibi ke karan hi use chhodkar chali gayi hai. Ek din use pata chalta hai ki wah duniya ke mashhur karobaari samuh ka iklauta waaris hai. Ab Mihir kya karega? STORY LINK BUY KARNE KE LIA CONTACT KRE. 30/-rs

title: MAFIA'S SWEET LOVE
d: Kehte hain ki jodiyaan swarg mein banti hain, aur pyar ya kahein ki jeevansathi jeevan mein apratikshit roop se aata hai, aise tarikon se jiski koi kalpana bhi nahi kar sakta. To kya hota hai jab do ajnabi jeevansathi bankar ek-dusre ki zarooraton ko pura karne ke liye milte hain? Ek taraf hai AK, ek gussail aur khatarnak businessman, aur dusri taraf hai Pakhi, ek pyari aur masoom ladki. Kya ye do bilkul alag log kabhi ek saath aa paenge? Yah akasmik bandhan apni yatra kaise shuru karega? Kya yah rishta toot jaega ya jeevan bhar ka saath ban jaega? Aur unki kahani kaise shuru hogi? Jaanne ke liye, 'Mafia ka meetha pyar' sunte rahiye

title: DEVIL'S INNOCENT LOVE
d: Underworld mein kukhyaat Eddie ke naam se mashhoor, vyaapaar jagat ke baadshaah Arshat Singhania ki mulaqat bachpan mein Ananya se hui, jisne unki zindagi ki disha hamesha ke liye badal di. Aakhir Ananya hai kaun? Arshat ke liye woh itni mahatvapurn kyun hai? Content/Creative Team - Sanel, Indu Kapoor, Jyoti Pal.

title: VEER WARRIOR
d: Ek samay bekaar samjhe jaane wale Narendra ko tab tak maut ke darwaaze ka saamna karna padta hai jab tak ki uske bheetar ek divya yoddha jaag nahi jaata. Nayi taaqat ke saath, woh shaktishali dushmanon ko phir se chunauti deta hai. Kya woh laapata Amrit Kalash ko punah praapt kar sakta hai aur ek Veer Yoddha ke roop mein apna khoya hua sammaan punah praapt kar sakta hai?

title: 99 PERCENT MINE
d: Ek snehi patni aur laadli bahu, Pranjali apne parivar se bahut pyar karti hai. Wah apne pati Abeer aur sasural walon ko hamesha khush aur santusht rakhti hai. Lekin doosri taraf, uske pati aur uski bachpan ki dost Pratibha ne Pranjali ki zindagi nark bana di hai. Pratibha Pranjali ko pareshan karne ka koi kasar nahi chhodti. Jab Abeer ke dadaji ki ek durghatna mein mrityu ho jati hai, to wah Pranjali ko doshi thahratha hai aur usse aur bhi nafrat karne lagta hai. Abeer Pranjali ko jaan se maarne ka pakka irada kar leta hai aur Pratibha ke saath milkar uski hatya ki yojana banata hai. Aage kya hota hai? Kya Abeer aur Pratibha Pranjali ko maar dalenge? Kya hoga jab Pranjali apni maut ka badla lene ke liye punarjanm legi? Yah sab jaanne ke liye '99 Percent Mine' dekhein. Show team: Pragati, Richa, Prakash.

title: SATARA KA SAUDAGAR
d: Ek aisi audio series hai jise sunna behad zaroori hai. Yeh ek pita aur uske bacche ke beech ke bandhan ko khubsurti se darshati hai. Dard bhare bichhadne ke baad apni beti ke saath gaon laut rahe Rituraj ki romanchak yatra mein shaamil hon. Bijli girne se ek train durghatna unhe aseem shakti ki duniya mein le jaati hai, jo unki gehri icchaon ko poora karne ka waada karti hai. Lekin jaise-jaise woh gaharaai mein utarte hain, is asaadharan kshamata ka asli swaroop rahasya bana rehta hai. Kya yeh aashirvaad bankar unhe unke sapnon ki or le jaayegi, ya abhishaap bankar unhe ek khatarnaak raaste par le jaayegi?

title: ISHQ KI MANMARZIYAAN
d: Daksh se sagaai tootne ke baad Anushka ka pyaar par se bharosa uth gaya tha. Ranveer ne uski zindagi mein phir se khushiyan bhar din. Lekin kismat ko unki prem kahani mein kuch aur hi manzoor tha. title: DON NO.1
d: Don Number 1 Kabir ki kahani hai, jise underworld mein Buddha ke naam se jaana jaata tha. Woh ek khoonkhaar apraadhi tha. Ek durbhaagyapoorurn ghatna ke dauran, uski mulaqat Kajal se hui aur uske baad usne khud ko puri tarah se badal liya. Usne apne pichhle jeevan ko bhi gupt rakha. Apne pichhle jeevan ko peeche chhodne ke peeche uska kya kaaran tha? Kya sach chhipaane se Kajal ke saath uski shaadi baraqarar rahegi?

title: YODDHA YEAR 2056
d: Duniya bhar ke vaigyanik maanav jaati ki raksha ke liye COVID-19 aur anya virusoon ko haraane ke bahut kareeb hain. Lekin kya hoga jab yeh virus jaanwaron mein utparivartan paida kar de? Yoddha: Varsh 2056, maanav jaati ki raksha ke liye in utparivartanon se ladne wale ek yoddha ki kahani hai. Utparivardit jeevon par vijay paane ke liye koi dawa ya teeka nahi hai. Yeh vartamaan aur bhavishy, prabhaav aur prabhav, tatha chatur aur balwaan ke beech ki ladaai hai. Kya duniya utparivardit jeevon ke aage jhukegi ya yoddha un sabhi ko hara dega?

title: SHAADI EK WADA DO ANJANO KE BEECH
d: Mumbai jaise vyast shahar mein basi yeh kahani Goel parivaar ke ird-gird ghoomti hai. Rajveer, Shauryam, Raina aur Payal sirf bhai-behen nahi hain, balki ek-doosre se behad khaas hain. Ek hi ghar mein pale-badhe hone ke baavajood ye bhai-behen ek-doosre se bilkul alag hain. Kya hota hai jab unka saadharan parivarik jeevan bad se badtar ho jaata hai? Kya woh ek parivaar ke roop mein ekajut rahenge ya bikhar jaayenge? Yeh jaanne ke liye 'Shaadi - Ek Waada Do Anjaane Ke Beech' dekhein. Show Team: Rahul, Prakhar

title: TOXIC LOVE S1 & S02
d: Ranveer Singh Raajawat, jo bahut ghamandi aur badtameez ladka hai, apne mata-pita ke kaatil ko dhundh raha hai, jisne unhe uski aankhon ke saamne maar daala tha. Maahi, jo bahut pyaari aur chulbuli ladki hai, zindagi ka maza leti hai. Kya alag-alag personality waale ye dono log ek-doosre se pyaar karenge? Kya woh pyaar, romance aur passion ka anubhav karenge? Kya Maahi apni maasoomiyat aur sachche dil se Ranveer ke gusse ko khatam kar payegi? Kya Ranveer ke dil mein Maahi ke liye pyaar ki bhaavna jaagegi, ya sab kuch uske gusse ki aag mein jal jaayega?

title: PAANCH PATTHAR - KING OF STONES
d: Bhrigugarh raajya ke raja Samarjit Singh ki teen patniyon se utpann paanch putra aur putriyan sinhaasna ke uttaraadhikaari banne ke liye ek anokhi pratiyogita mein bhaag lete hain. Parivarik kalah aur bhai-behenon ki aapasi pratidwandvita ke kaaran yeh pratiyogita shadyantron ka khel ban jaati hai, jisme koi bhi surakshit nahi hai. Sinhaasna ki is anokhi pratiyogita mein vijaeta ko shakti, buddhi, gati, swaasthya aur dooradrishti ke paanch ratna prapt honge, jo use Prithvi ka sabse shaktishali raja/raani bana denge. Show Team: Ratish Satish Mangalam, Riddhi Kotecha, Vidyashish Sarangi.

title: MOHABBAT HO NA JAY
d: Ameerzaade Manav Bajaj ke dadaji Yashika ke zariye ghar mein bacchon ki kami poori karna chahte the. Apne pita ke business ko phir se khada karne ke liye Yashika ne surrogate mother banne ka raasta chuna aur Yashika ne Manav ke do bacchon ke janam toh diya lekin Bajaj family ko sirf ek ke baare mein hi bataya. Doosri taraf Manav Yashika se pyaar karta raha. Lekin kya hoga jab use apne doosre bacche ke zinda hone ki khabar milegi? Aur kya life ki struggle phase mein film industry mein nayi-nayi aayi Yashika apne pairon par khadi ho payegi? Kya Manav aur Yashika ke raaste phir se milenge?

title: HIRAK THE REBORN WARRIOR
d: Martial art mein visheshagya ek punarjanm waale Hirak ko pata chalta hai ki woh apne pichhle janam mein 'Treta Yug' ke dauran kuch raakshasaon dwara nark ke dwaar par maara gaya tha. Nepal ke pavitra desh mein apne punarjanm mein, Hirak jo ab khud ko 'Dwapar Yug' mein paata hai, use apne parivaar ko bachaane ke liye kuch raakshasaon ka saamna karna padta hai. Yahaan pakad yeh hai ki kuch uske poorv janam ke ye raakshas vastav mein uske parivaar ke sadasya hain.

title: FANAA
d: Pyaar aahaon ke dhuyen se bana ek dhuaan hai. Ek ladki - Ayesha ki aparihaary gaatha, jo daanav-vansh ke Kaalkeya ki raani hai, lekin apne kartavyon ki parwah kiye bina, woh apne teekhe iradon aur apni raktapipaasa ko shaant karne ke liye insaanon ki hatya nahi karna chahti. Kaalkeya ke liye khatara badhta hai kyunki wahaan koi hai - ek 'Divya-Maanav': Armaan jo unhe ek-ek karke maar raha hai aur ladki ka pita - Kaalraaj is aadmi ka pata lagaane mein koi qasar nahi chhoda, shaayad hi use pata ho ki yeh wahi aadmi hai jisse uski beti dil se pyaar karti hai. Is prakar, ek nishiddh prem kahani shuru hoti hai jahaan Ayesha ke paas ab apne sabse bade dushman ko maarne aur apna mission poora karne ke alaawa koi vikalp nahi hai. Lekin kya woh apne jeevan ke pyaar ko maar payegi aur kya hoga jab ladke ki asli pehchaan ujaagar hogi kyunki uske shareer mein woh prateek hai jo ateet ke jeevant hote hi sab kuch badal dega. Khatarnak raaz ka pardafaash hone waala hai kyunki gaddaar andar hi hai. Team: Aditya Sinha, Saurav Chatterjee, Hardik Gupta

title: LOVE AFTER MARRIAGE
d: Ye kahani hai Rajveer aur Saina ki aur unki arrange marriage ki, pyaar ko lekar apne pichhle anubhavon ke chalte dono ek doosre se shaadi nahi karna chahte the, lekin unke parivaar waale unki shaadi chahte the. Aisa isliye kyunki dono ki umra shaadi ki hua karti thi. Parivaar ki khushi ke liye dono ek doosre se mile bina ya ek doosre ko theek se jaane bina bhi shaadi kar lete hain aur ek anchahe bandhan mein bandh jaate hain lekin is shaadi ke baad unki zindagi mein bahut kuch badal jaata hai. Isliye dono ne apne ghar walon ki khushi ke liye ye shaadi ki, lekin phir dheere-dheere dono ke dilon ne ek doosre mein apni khushi dhundh li. Lekin phir unka ateet ek baar phir saamne aata hai. Kya dono apne ateet se ladkar bhavishy bana payenge? Kya hoga jab unka ateet ek baar phir unke saamne hoga? Kya dono apne rishte ko bacha payenge? Adhik jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Love After Marriage

title: SUPER VISION ARYAMAN
d: Aarya ko achanak ek mahashakti mil jaati hai, jiski wajah se woh aane wali durghataon ko pahle hi dekh sakta hai. Kya Aarya is nayi shakti ki madad se apne mata-pita ke hataaron ka pata laga payega? Ya kya uska bhi apne mata-pita jaisa hi hashr hoga? Chhipe rahasyoon ko jaanne ke liye sune Super Vision Aaryman

title: EK SANYASI AISA BHI
d: Veerendra ek 18 varshiya sanyasi hai, jo ek sudoor ashram mein akela rehta hai, lekin uski iccha apni sapnon ki ladki ko dhundhne aur usse shaadi karne ki hai. Voh ashram chhodkar sadaiv sukhi parivarik jeevan jeena chahta hai. Uski iccha adhoori reh jaati agar uske devta Nagaraj ki baat karne wali murti na hoti, jo Veerendra ko kuch chamatkaron ke saath-saath chunautipurn kaarya karne ka mauka bhi deti hai. Badle mein Veerendra apne jeevan ke pyaar ko poora kar sakta hai aur usse shaadi kar sakta hai. Kya Veerendra ka apna parivaar banane ka sadharan sapna pura hoga?

title: ADHURI MOHABBAT KI PURI KAHANI
d: Bas itna hi kehna chaahungi apne chahne waalon se - main guzra hua waqt nahi jo lautkar na aa sake.

title: ISHQ KI BAAZI
d: Ishika, jo Bollywood ki sabse khubsurat actress hai, apni best friend Roopali aur co-actor Amit ki buri saazish mein phaskar apne parivaar ko chhod deti hai. Kismat se use samay mein peeche jaakar badla lene ka ek aur mauka milta hai. Kya woh apne ameer pati ka dil phir se jeet payegi? Ya samay use koi aur kismat dikhayega?

title: ANDHADHUN ISHQ
d: Ruhi, ek chatur vyavsayi, apni sauteli maa ke bure kaamon se bachne ke liye moorakh banne ka naatk kar rahi thi. Is ghar se bahar nikalne ka uska ekmaatra raasta ek ameer andhe ladke Chirag se shaadi karna tha, jiske khud ke kuch gehre raaz the. Ye dono apni shaadi ko kaise safal banaayenge? Kya hoga jab unhe ek-doosre ke raaz pata chalenge? Show Team: Ratish Satish Mangalam, Riddhi Kotecha, Amar Pandey.

title: 19 DATES : IT'S A MATCH
d: Jo number 19 hai, yeh do numbers se bana hua hai, 1 aur 9. Ek jo hai woh ginti ka pahla number hai, aur 9 jo hai ginti mein aakhri akela number hai isliye jab yeh dono number milte hain, toh shuruaat aur ant ek doosre se milte hain. Yeh jaanne ke liye ki tumhari zindagi akele jeene ke liye bani hai ya phir kisi ke saath! Insaan ko 19 dates ke safar ko poora karke yeh ehsaas hota hai! Dev ne bhi ye baatein suni thi lekin use is theory par bilkul vishwaas nahi tha. Toh aisa kya hoga, uski zindagi mein jo use is baat ko maanne par majboor kar dega? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Dev ki anokhi kahani 19 DATES.

title: HAMARI ADHURI KAHANI
d: Ek raat, Kiara ki zindagi ko puri tarah se badal deti hai, jab uski chacheri behen ke shadyantra ki wajahon se woh pregnant ho jaati hai. Saat saal baad jab woh apne bacchon ke pita ki talaash mein wapas lauti hai, toh use Virat ke liye gehra aakarshan ho jaata hai. Us Virat se jo uski usi behen ka mangetar hai jisne uske khilaf shadyantra racha tha!

title: AMAR VEER
d: Veer apni mrit maa se baat karne ka raasta khoj raha hai, lekin ek galti ke kaaran woh doosre samay mein pahunch jaata hai. Uski mulaqat Raja Lankesh se hoti hai, jo apne raajya ko bachaane ke liye sangharsh kar raha hai. Veer ke paas jaadui shakti dekhkar Lankesh, Veer se ek samajhauta karta hai ki agar woh Lankesh ko apna raajya bachaane mein madad karega, toh woh Veer ko uski maa se mila dega. Kya Veer Lankesh ki madad karega? Team Leader: Amitav Mitra. Content Editor: Vandana A Sharma.

title: TERMS AND CONDITIONS
d: Nidhi, ek bahut hi khubsurat ladki, jiski kismat ne kabhi saath nahi diya. Aaj uska bhai zindagi aur maut ke beech, hospital mein apni aakhri saansein gin raha hai. Nidhi ke paas itne paise nahi ki woh apne bhai ki pareshaani door kar sake. Par tabhi use ek aisa offer milta hai jise woh mana nahi kar paati. Is offer mein kuch shartein hai jo uski zindagi ko uthal-puthal kar de par itne paise bhi hai jo uske bhai ki zindagi bacha le. Lekin kya Nidhi is offer mein maujood ajeebogreeb Terms & Conditions ko accept karegi? Kya hai woh shartein jiske chalte koi Nidhi ko dher saare paise dene ke liye raazi hai?

title: AGHORANAND AUR MAHAMARAN PRAPANCH

title: AJNABI SA ISHQ
d: Ishq ek ajnabi sa ehsaas hai, jo har insaan mehsoos karna chahta hai. Is kahani mein Saumya school ke baad apni aage ki padhai ke liye shahar apne bhaiya bhabhi ke paas rehne aati hai. Shahar mein uski mulaqat ek ajnabi se hoti hai jo use pehli nazar mein bada ajeeb sa lagta hai aur woh use Devdas naam de deti hai. Par kuch hi dinon mein use us Devdas se pyaar ho jaata hai par ye khabar sunkar ki uske ghar waalon ne uske liye kisi aur ko chuna hai, uske pairon ke neeche se zameen khisak jaati hai. Toh ab kya karegi Saumya? Kya woh apne parivaar ko apne pyaar ke baare mein bata payegi? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye ye kahani Ajnabi Sa Ishq

title: BRAHMAND KA RAKSHAK REAL VOICE
d: Kshitij, Raja Ransinh dwara shaasit Navangana naamak ek chhote se raajya ka raajkumar hai. Haalaanki yeh raajya chhota tha, phir bhi yeh shaantipurn aur samriddh tha. Lekin jald hi, bhaagya kroor ho gaya - 200ven star ke do shaktishali dragon ne hamla kar diya aur poore raajya ko nasht kar diya. Kshitij hi ekamaatra jeevit bacha. Kya Kshitij apne khoye hue parivaar ko dhundh payega? Aur kya woh apne raajya ke vinaash ke peeche ki sacchai ka pata laga payega? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye 'Brahmand Ka Rakshak'

title: INDRAVAT THE BATTLE OF KINGS & WITCHES
d: Chetan ko samay yatra tab tak avaastavik lagti thi jab tak ek subah use pata nahi chala ki woh Indravat ka naya raajkumaar hai. Chetan, jo ab Chiranjeevi hai, praacheen Bharat mein phansa hua hai aur logon ki ek basti ka netritva karta hai aur chudaailon aur raakshasaon se ladta hai. Ek saadharan ladke Chetan ke raajkumaar Chiranjeevi banne ke safar ko dekhne ke liye Indravat: Raajaaon aur Chudaailon ka Yuddh dekhein,

title: SANAM RE
d: Parivaar ki laadli beti Lavanya ki apni ek alag hi duniya hai, jisme maa sa baba sa ke alaawa uska pyaara dost Himmat bhi hai. Poori kahani Lavanya ke ird-gird ghoomti hai. Kaise gaon ki ek maasoom si ladki shaadi ke baad pati ke business ko sambhaalti hai. Aur jo ladki kabhi gaon ke bahar bhi na nikli ho, woh videsh jaakar apne pati ko kaise dobara haasil karti hai. In sab mein uska dost Himmat uske saath hamesha bana rehta hai. Toh Lavanya ki kahani aage kya-kya mod leti hai

title: KHOONI VADHU
d: Ek rahasyamay mandir jahaan pravesh karne ke baad koi bhi jeevit nahi bach sakta, saath hi ek khooni vadhu ki aatma bhi hai jo gaon mein purushon ka shikaar karti hai aur in sabke beech Chetan naam ka ek ladka phans jaata hai jo mandir se bhaag gaya tha. Kya Chetan in rahasyoon ko suljha payega?

title: TERI HONE LAGI HUN
d: Preeti aur Rahul duniya ke liye ajnabi the. Lekin unhone gupchup tarike se shaadi kar li. Unki is gupt shaadi ke baare mein sirf unhe hi pata tha. Ek raat ne unki zindagi hamesha ke liye badal di, unhone apne rishte ko anjaam diya, haalaanki donon mein se koi bhi aisa nahi chahta tha. Rahul bachpan se hi Preeti ko pasand karta tha, lekin Preeti ke dil mein Preeti ke liye sirf nafrat thi. Kya Preeti Rahul ki nafrat ko pyaar mein badal payegi? Is gupt prem kahani 'Teri Hone Lagi Hoon' ke sune. Show Team: Mithilesh, Prakhar, Prakash Ram.

title: SILENT CRUSH
d: Kahani Avani naam ki ek ladki ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jise uska poorv premee Rohit kai saalon se pratadit kar raha hai. Saalon baad bhi, Avani ke haalaat nahi sudre hain aur ab woh Tarun ke saath rehti hai. Tarun samaaj ke saamne bhale hi ek achha insaan ho, lekin ghar mein uska chehra alag hi hai. Saalon tak takleef jhhelne ke baad, Avani zindagi ka matlab dhundh rahi hai, tabhi woh apni padhai poori karne ke liye dobara college jaane ka faisla karti hai. Aage kya hota hai? Avani ke is faisle par Tarun ki kya pratikriya hoti hai? Ab Avani ka kya hoga? Aur jaanne ke liye sune Silent Crush.

title: BREAKUP SHAKE-UP
d: Bachpan ke dost Ishani aur Aditya ko unke parivaar walon ne shaadi ke liye majboor kar diya. Aditya ke dadaji ke guzarte hi, usne talaak ke liye arzi de di, jisse Ishani ka dil toot gaya. Lekin yeh breakup toh unki pyaar ki kahani ki bas shuruaat thi.

title: LAW OF ATTRACTION (2 VOICE AVAILABLE)
d: Kehte hain ki kismat yeh tay karne mein aham bhumika nibhati hai ki aap kiske saath rahenge. Anika aur Chirag bhale hi ek-doosre se bilkul alag hon, lekin unke beech ek spark hai. Aisa lagta hai ki universe chahta hai ki woh saath rahen. Woh bhale hi ek-doosre se sirf ek baar mile hon, lekin yahi baat unhe alag hone se rok rahi hai. Ek taraf, Chirag uske baare mein jaanna chahta hai, jabki Anika ko apni poori mulaqat bas kuch jhalkiyan yaad hain. Is jodi ke liye aage kya hone wala hai? Kya woh saath rahenge ya yeh anishchitata unhe alag hone par majboor kar degi? Yeh jaanne ke liye Law of Attraction dekhein. Team Head: Arshad Jafri. Senior Associate Creative: Om Dolia.

title: MISS MISSFIT
d: Kahani khushmizaaj aur zindaadil Apoorva ke ird-gird ghoomti hai. Apni chhoti si duniya mein khoyi hui, uske mann mein dheron sapne hain. Apoorva ke mata-pita, Ahaana aur Neeraj, ab alag ho chuke hain aur Apoorva ke mata-pita mein se koi bhi Apoorva ki custody nahi lena chahta. In sabke baavajood, Ahaana, Apoorva ko apne saath uski naani ke ghar le jaane ka faisla karti hai. Tabhi Apoorva ki mulaqat uski chhoti behen Riya se hoti hai, jo har tarah se Apoorva se behtar hai. Phir cheezein bigad jaati hain aur Riya aur Apoorva ek hi chhat ke neeche rehne lagte hain. Apne naye ghar mein Apoorva ke bartaav ne sabhi ko chaunkaa diya hai. Aage kya hota hai? Apoorva ajeeb bartaav kyun kar rahi hai? Jaanne ke liye Miss Missfit dekhein. Show Team: Mithilesh, Hardik

title: MRITYUNJAY THE JOURNEY OF AFTER LIFE
d: Kya Aaryan ab punarjanm ke baad ek sachcha rakshak ban payega? Kya woh yoddha ka vesh dharan kar duniya aur uske logon ko jaadui jaanwaron se bacha payega?

title: TIME MACHINE
d: Kya samay ko rokne waali machine bhi bhala bani hai? Lekin ek din, ek prayogshala mein ek time machine banayi gayi. Ek aisi anokhi time machine, jisne past, present aur future ki duniya ki ek khaas kadi khol kar rakh di, aakhir kisne banayi thi ye time machine? Aur phir kaise badal gayi kai zindagiyan? Aakhir kaun tha iska mastermind? Ek anokha aur romanchak safar bhootkaal se vartamaan aur bhavishyakaal tak. Lekhak - Yogesh Mali

title: MERE NAAM TU
d: Delhi ke sabse ameer aur sabse takatwar aadmi Atharv ne Ridhima ke saath ek raat bitane ke baad usse jabardasti shaadi kar li, kyunki Ridhima uske bachche ki garbhavati thi. Lekin kahani kuch aur hi mod leti hai aur sachhais kuch aur hi hoti hai. Kya Ridhima aur Atharv apne us rishte ko nibha paenge jo pehle se hi galatafahmi par aadharit tha? Aakhir us raat ki sachhais kya thi?

title: YE NADAN SI MOHABBATE
d: Ameer business family ka handsome smart Vihan, college ke music band ka lead singer hai. Lekin uska sapna hai ki woh police officer bane, kyunki jasoosi uske khoon mein hai. College ki ladkiyon ke crush Vihan ko uski junior Meera se pyaar ho jaata hai. Waise Meera hai toh badi sharmeeli hai lekin Vihan se ladne mein kabhi peeche nahi rehti. Isi nok jhonk mein dono ko kab pyaar ho jaata hai pata hi nahi chalta. Idhar college mein drugs ki supply ka maamla police tak pahunch jaata hai aur police Vihan ko apna jaasoos banati hai. Vihan ka jasoosi dimaag har kisi par shak karta hai phir chahe woh uske bachpan ka dost Ranbir ho ya college ke junior. Jaasoos Vihan aur junior Meera ki ye naadaan si mohabbat kaise pahunchegi apni manzil tak aur kaun hai jo jaasoos Vihan ko lagaataar dhoka dekar college mein drugs supply kar raha hai jaanne ke liye dekhiye Vihan aur Meera ki kahani 'Ye Naadaan Si Mohabbaten'

title: JADUGAR JUGNU
d: Ye Uttar Pradesh mein Nepal border ke paas base gaon Bhawanipur mein rehne waale Jugnu ki kahani hai. 22 saal ke Jugnu ka koi nahi hai. Ek din use ghar mein rakhi khaandaani khukri se karishmaai saudaagar Shireen mil jaati hai. Shireen use ameer aur shaktishali banne mein madad karti hai lekin phir jaadui system Shireen ka asli chehra saamne aata hai. Woh phans jaata hai. Woh jaadui system Shireen ke is jaal se kaise bahar niklega? Jaanne ke liye suniye 'Jadugar Jugnu'

title: DULHAN KABRISTAAN KI

title: THE SOLDIERS WHO ALSO HAVE HEART
d: Har sainik khud ke baare mein sochne se pahle apne desh ke baare mein sochne ki qasam khaata hai, lekin hum yeh nahi bhool sakte ki sainik hone se pahle woh bhi baaki logon ki tarah insaan hain. Yeh kahani Karanveer Singh ki hai, ek bahaadur sainik jo apne desh ke liye apni jaan qurbaan karne se pahle do baar nahi sochega. Karanveer ka tabaadla uske grihanagarr mein ho gaya hai jahaan uske pita apne bete se milne ka besabri se intezaar kar rahe hain, lekin Karanveer ka kehna hai ki woh na toh apne parivaar aur na hi doston se koi rishta rakhna chahta hai. Karanveer aur uske parivaar ke beech kya gadbad hui? Karanveer ab unse baat kyun nahi karta? Jab woh saalon baad apne parivaar se milta hai toh kya hota hai? Jaanne ke liye sune The Soldiers: 'Who Also Have Hearts'

title: PYAAS
d: Pyaas ek yuva ladki Mugdha ki kahani hai, jo haal hi mein apne mata-pita aur bhai-behnon ke saath Shimla sheher mein aayi hai. Mugdha ka parivar behad ameer hai, lekin saath hi behad rahasyamaya bhi. College mein dakhila lete hi uske aaspaas rahasyamayi ghatnaein ghatne lagti hain. Achanak Mugdha ko pasand karne wala ladka gayab ho jata hai. Sheher ke nivasi rahasyamayi paristhitiyon mein mrit paye jaate hain aur sabhi ko chaunkate hue unki maut ka karan agyaat rehta hai. Police ko aise shav milte hain jo peele pad chuke hain, maano unka saara khoon chus liya gaya ho. Mugdha ke college ka sabse honnhar ladka, Mihir Khurana, apne dost ke gayab hone ke peeche Mugdha ko hi zimmedaar manta hai. Haalaanki Mihir ko Mugdha par shak hai, lekin saath hi wah uski or aakarshit bhi hota hai. To aakhir Mugdha kaun hai? Mihir ke dost ke gayab hone se uska kya sambandh hai? Aur uske parivar ka kya, kya unka in hatyaon se koi lena-dena hai? Kya Mugdha par Mihir ka shak sahi hai? Show team - Soham Abhiram, Meenu Khanna, Rashi Upadhyay, Hardik Gupta, Prakash Kumar Ram.

title: MARTIAL EMPEROR
d: Daksh ek ladka hai jo anjaane mein ek aisi duniya mein aa jaata hai jahaan keval balwaan logon ka hi samman kiya jaata hai. Is duniya mein, logon mein ek yoddha jaisi bhaavna hoti hai. Daksh ko pahle uski yoddha jaisi bhaavna ke liye nechi nazar se dekha jaata tha. Lekin kisi ko nahi pata tha ki jis yoddha jaisi bhaavna ko sabhi nechi nazar se dekhte the, wahi ek din Daksh ko ek mahaan yoddha bana degi. Is duniya mein, Daksh ko anaginat musibaton aur khataron ka saamna karna padta hai. Lekin kya Daksh is duniya mein un sabhi musibaton ka saamna kar payega? Kya Daksh sachaai ka pata laga payega? Adhik jaanne ke liye, The Martial Emperor

title: EK THA BAAZIGAR
d: Hotel Dilbahaar ka zindaadil aur joshila waiter Raj, jeevanasaathi ki talaash mein hai. Use Ramakant Kaka ki beti Kamali se pyaar ho jaata hai aur Kamali bhi Raj se pyaar karne lagti hai, lekin jab Tara naam ki ek ladki Raj ki zindagi mein aati hai, toh woh usse jabardasti shaadi kar leti hai. Phir Raj ka safar ek aam insaan se ek Baazigar banne tak shuru hota hai.

title: YEH ISHQ HAAYE
d: Lucknow ke sabse bade vyapari, patthar dil Anirudh Mittal, hamesha ladkiyon se dur rehte the. Phir unki mulaqat Shreya se hui! Shreya aur Anirudh ek-dusre ke liye bane the, phir bhi ek-dusre ke nahi ho sake! Kya unka yah vaivaahik sambandh unhe sachcha pyar paane mein madad karega? Prastutakarta: Drishti Nanavati

title: SUITABLE BOYFRIEND
d: Taste of Decor naam ke safal vyavsaay ki maalik Pakhi Aaryan ek yuva aur safal mahila hain. Unke prem jeevan mein tab uthal-puthal mach jaati hai jab unke jeevan ka pyaar Yash Singhania unka dil tod deta hai. Yash ke is krit se Pakhi puri tarah toot jaati hain. Ek din unhe ek cruise trip aayojak ka phone aata hai jo Pakhi ko unki aagami cruise yatra ke baare mein bataata hai, wahi yatra jo unhone Yash ke saath plan ki thi. Pakhi akele hi yatra par jaane ka faisla karti hain. Yaheen unki mulaqat Erik se hoti hai, jinhe Coffee King ke naam se jaana jaata hai. Erik se mulaqat Pakhi ki zindagi puri tarah badal deti hai. Pakhi ki solo trip par kya hota hai? Kya Erik ke mann mein unke liye bhaavnaayein jaagrit hoti hain? Pakhi aur Erik ki pyaari kahani, 'Suitable Boyfriend' sune aur adhik jaanein. Show Team: Simran, Richa

title: MAI BANUNGA SUPERHERO
d: High school jaane waala aur basti mein rehne waala ek garib ladka Yug, ek khatarnaak medical experiment mein bhaag leta hai. Experiment fail ho jaati hai magar Yug ko aisi rahasyamay shaktiyan mil jaati hain jo uski kshamataon ko badhakar use super human bana deti hai. Ab Yug un shaktiyon ka kaise istemal karega ek superhero banne ke liye, ye jaanne ke liye sune Main Banunga SuperHero. Jaanne ke liye 'Main Banunga SuperHero'

title: MARRIAGE DEAL
d: 22 varsheeya Devika ki zindagi uske pita Pramod Khanna ki mrityu ke baad puri tarah badal jaati hai. Haalaat tab aur bigad jaate hain jab uski sauteli behen Sonal, Devika ke premee Yash ko rizhaane ki koshish karti hai. Pita ko khone aur premee dwara dhoka diye jaane ke baad, Devika ko samajh nahi aata ki woh aage kya kare. Woh bas apna khoya hua sab kuch wapas paana chahti hai. Devika apne pita ki mrityu ki jaanch shuru karti hai aur pata lagaati hai ki unki hatya Shri Arjun Malhotra ne ki hai, jo Pramod Khanna ki company mein 70% hissedaari chahta tha. Apne iklaute parivaar aur premee se mile dhoke ke baad ab Devika kya karegi? Woh apne pita ki maut ka badla kaise legi? Kya Yash uske paas wapas aayega? Devika ke liye aage kya hoga? Yeh jaanne ke liye 'Marriage Deal' sune. Show Team: Amit, Prakhar

title: IMPERFECT HUM
d: Do apoorurn log ek saath aakar ek paripoorurn prem kahani rachte hain, lekin kya hoga jab poora brahmaand is jode ke khilaf saazish rachega? Prem ki is mahaayuddh mein, kya Ishani aur Karn ka rishta samay aur sangharshon ki kasauti par khara utarega?

title: KHILADI ANOKHI DUNIYA KA
d: Raghav apne mata-pita ki maut ka badla lene pahuncha hai aur uski jaan ko khatara hai, ek aise aayam mein jahaan madad kam aur khatara zyada hai! Kya Raghav un sabse ladkar Anil Singhania se apne mata-pita ka badla le payega?

title: BANDA YEH BADASS HAI
d: Abhay, ek mehanti lekin aarthik tangi se joojhta hua aadmi, apni ameer patni aur uske parivaar se lagaatar uphaas sahta hai, lekin uski zindagi mein ek naatakiya mod tab aata hai jab use pata chalta hai ki woh koi saadharan insaan nahi hai; woh ek ameer yoddha hai jiske paas apaar sampatti hai. Ab, gupt abhiyaanon mein uljhe rehne ke dauran, jab woh ek aisi duniya mein qadam rakhta hai jisne kabhi use tuchha samjha tha, Abhay sabko apni asli aukat sabit karne ke liye dridh hai.

title: SAMAY YATRI
d: Aadhunik yug ke poorv premee, peshe se puratatvavid Rudra aur Shruti, Rudra dwara ki gayi ek galti ko sudhaarne ke liye apne ateet mein samay yatra karte hain, lekin durbhagyavash Mahabharat yug mein pahunch jaate hain, jahaan Raja Duryodhan Shruti ka apaharan kar leta hai. Rudra, Shruti ko Raja Duryodhan se kaise bachayega? Kya woh vartamaan samay mein wapas aane ka koi raasta khoj payenge? Ya woh hamesha ke liye Mahabharat yug mein phans jayenge? Show Team: Ratish Satish Mangalam, Riddhi Kotecha, Amar Pandey, Aakash Abhang.

title: YUNAN KI PRET RANI
d: Sadiyon se sukoon se so rahi Yunan ki pret rani ki aatma ko chandre swaartha logon ne apne swarth ka nishana banaya uske neend mein khalal daala aur woh pret rani ke bhayaanak pratishod ka nishana ban gaye aur Yunan ki yeh pret rani unke peeche peeche Hindustan tak chali aayi. Yeh ek jawaani ki daheliz tak ki dahshat aur rahasya mein doobhi hui khaufnaak daastaan hai. Isko kamzor dil paathak raat mein na padhen.

title: SUPER YODDHA
d: Ek yuva pratibhashaali vyakti 100 saal purane kul ka sarvochch pad prapt karke ek misaal qaayam karta hai. Uski safalta alpkaalik hoti hai aur woh tab tak us pad se vanchit rehta hai jab tak uski mangetar use use wapas jeetne ka avsar nahi deti. Lekin sambhaavanaayen oonchi hain aur uske kul ka samman daav par laga hai.

title: ARRANGED WALA PYAAR
d: Arohi maanti hai ki aazaadi aur aantarik sundarta hi uski pehchaan hain aur woh ek aisa jeevanasaathi chahti hai jo uske in gunon ka samman kare. Use uncle se pyaar ho jaata hai, lekin jald hi use pata chalta hai ki yeh romance zyada din nahi chal sakta. Use apne liye ek adarsh saathi dhundhne ke saare armaan chhodkar, uske pita ke boss se shaadi karne ke liye majboor hona padta hai. Kya woh uncle ke pyaar ko bhool payegi? Arohi ki zindagi mein aisa kya galat hua ki apne pita ke boss se shaadi karna hi ekmaatra raasta ban gaya? Kya Arohi is asaamaanya shaadi mein dhal payegi? Jaanne ke liye sune Arranged Wala Pyaar. Show Team: Brajesh, Hardik

title: MUKKEBAAZ
d: 21 varsheeya Zorawar apne poore parivaar ki hatya ka gawaah banta hai. Apni khoyi hui pratishtha aur parivaar ka badla lene ke liye, Zorawar Neel Mani naama ek jaadui patthar prapt karta hai aur ek durjey 'Mukkebaaz' ban jaata hai. Samagri/Rachanaatmak Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Rashi Upadhyay

title: FORBIDDEN NIGHT KAHANI USS RAAT KI
d: Ek band kamre mein ek ajnabi dwara Pratyusha ke saath yaun utpeedan kiye jaane ke baad, Pratyusha ka sautela parivaar use Kolkata chhodne ke liye majboor kar deta hai. Lekin Pratyusha paanch saal baad apni maa ka saamaan lene ke liye Kolkata lauti hai. Tabhi, uske bacchon ka ek video internet par viral ho jaata hai, jise dekhkar log un bacchon ko Roy parivaar ke chhote bete ki najaayaz santaan samajhne lagte hain, lekin Pratyusha abhi bhi is sachaai se anjaan hai ki uske judwaan bacchon ka pita kaun hai. Pratyusha apni maa ka saamaan kaise haasil karegi? Amrita Sengupta aur Drishti Nanaavati dwara prastut.

title: MY GANGSTER LOVER
d: Kahani Raghavendra Singh urf Raghav ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jise uske pita kuch dinon ke liye Priya ke saath rehne ka nirdesh dete hain. Raghav ko yeh sahi nahi lagta kyunki Priya abhi bhi uske liye ek ajnabi hai. Aage jo hota hai use dekhkar sabhi stabdh reh jaate hain. Samaaj mein Priya ki izzat banaye rakhne ke liye Raghav usse apni sagaai ki ghoshna kar deta hai. Uske baad kya hota hai? Kya Priya is baat par raazi hogi? Ab Priya aur Raghav ka kya hoga? Dekhiye My Gangster Lover

title: IAS PRACHI
d: Prachi ka ekmaatra sapna IAS adhikari banna hai, lekin uski saas ko yeh manzoor nahi hai. Ab Prachi kya karegi? Kya woh apne sapne ko saakaar kar payegi ya apne sapnon ko poora karne ke is safar mein kho jaayegi? Jaanne ke liye, sapne dekhne waalon aur apnon ke beech ki kahani sune, IAS Prachi ko sune, sirf PocketFM par. Show Team: Amit, Hardik. Show ke Lekhak - Pragati Gupta

title: MISTAKEN IDENTITIES
d: Neha aur Mayra sauteli bahnen hain. Mayra ki shaadi Saransh se hone wali thi. Haalaanki, ek durghatna mein Mayra ki maut ho jati hai aur uski maut ka zimmedaar Neha ko thahraya jata hai. Mayra ki maut ke baad, Neha ki zindagi nark ban jati hai. Haalaat tab aur bigad jaate hain jab Neha ki shaadi Saransh se ho jati hai, jise wah bachpan se bahut pyar karti thi, lekin durbhagya se Saransh usse nafrat karta hai. Use aur uske parivar ko lagta hai ki Neha ne hi Saransh se shaadi karne ke liye apni hi bahan ki hatya ki hai. Saransh use sabke samne chahe jitna bhi beizzat kare, Neha ko lagta hai ki aakhirkar use Neha ke pyar ka ehsaas ho hi jaega. Aage kya hoga? Kya Saransh ko Neha se pyar ho jaega? Kya Neha ko wo pyar milega jiski wah haqdaar hai? Jaanne ke liye sunein 'Mistaken Identities.'

title: LOVE AT SEVENTEEN
d: Ritvik ek 17 saal ka dilfenk aashiq hai. Uske daddy ek jhuthe case mein jail mein band hain, ek din Ritvik Kareena Madam ki angoothi galti se nigal jaata hai, jisse usme kuch aisi shaktiyan aati hain, jisse woh kisi ka bhi dimaag control kar sakta hai, kya in shaktiyon se Ritvik apne papa ki begunahi sabit karega ya un ladkiyon ko paane ki koshish karega jinse woh pyaar karta hai? Jaanne ke liye suniye 'Love@Seventeen'

title: RISK HAI BUT ISHQ HAI
d: Resham ki mrityu ke baad, Veer ne Resham ki behen Kesar se jabardasti shaadi kar li. Kismat ne Kesar aur Veer ko mila diya hai, lekin kya woh kabhi pyaar mein pad payenge? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Rashi Upadhyay

title: MY CRUEL HUSBAND
d: Jahnavi ek madhyamvargeey parivaar se taalluk rakhti hai, toh doosri taraf underworld ka baadshah Siddharth hai. Kuch aisa hua ki unki duniya badal gayi aur dono ne shaadi kar li. Kya hua? Kya Siddharth aur Jahnavi ke beech pyaar panpega ya unki duniya bikhar jaayegi?

title: MILLIONAIRE DELIVERY BOY
d: Ek garib yuvak ki zindagi tab uthal-puthal ho jaati hai jab ek anjaan vyakti uske khaate mein 50 crore jama kar deta hai. Ameeri bhari zindagi mein dhalne ki koshish karte hue, woh apne us madadgaar ki pehchaan bhi dhundhhne ki koshish karta hai jo uski zindagi par qabza karne ki koshish kar raha hai.

title: THE RAICHANDS
d: Abhinav, ek saadhaaran sales executive, apni apmaaanjaanak shaadi aur saas ke lagaataar taanon se toota hua jeevan ji raha hai. Maan ke ilaaj ke liye paison ki jaddojehad karte hue use achanak ek chaunkane wali sacchai ka pata chalta hai—uske jeevike pita, Randheer Raichand, ek arabpati, achanak gaayab ho gaye, aur apne peeche ek vishaal samraajya aur anaginat dushman chhod gaye. Abhinav anichchha se is viraasat ko sambhaalne ki koshish karta hai, aur use dhokhe, saazishon aur ek aavishkaar ka saamna karna padta hai, jiske liye kai log jaan lene ko bhi taiyaar hain. Is beech, uski patni Ishita, apni doobti company aur apne poorv premi Rajveer ke saath beete dardnaak palon ke beech fansi hui hai, aur Abhinav par shak karne lagti hai, khaaskar tab jab afwaahon aur ghotalon se uski pratishtha ko khatraa paida ho jaata hai. Iske baavajood, Abhinav chupke se apni nayi mili shakti ka upyog Ishita ki raksha ke liye karta hai, aur usse apni asli pehchaan chhupata hai, kyunki use dar hai ki agar Ishita ko pata chal gaya ki woh ameer hai, toh woh use chhod degi.

title: AARYAN EK SHOORVEER YODDHA
d: Ek 18 varsheeya najaayaz ladke, Aarya ki berahmi se hatya kar di jaati hai. Woh ek doosri aatma ki madad se punrjeevit hota hai taaki apni maut ka badla le sake aur apni maa ke adhikaaron ke liye lad sake.

d: Rakshita ne apni purani haveli mein qadam rakhte hi galti se ek aisi aatma ko jaga diya jo hazaaron saalon se qaid thi. Woh aatma koi insaani aatma nahi, balki ek yaksh ki aatma thi. Kya hoga jab sone ke khazaane ki raksha karta yaksh apni shaktiyon se qadam lega Rakshita ko apne jaal mein? Kya is jaal mein phasne ki qeemat chukayegi woh apne shareer se?

title: KARAN ARJUN RELOADED
d: Ek durghatna ke baad, Arjun ko pata chalta hai ki uska shareer mrit ho gaya hai. Arjun ki aatma Karan naam ke ek ajnabi ke marte hue shareer mein pravesh karti hai. Is naye shareer mein Arjun ko anokhi shaktiyan prapt hoti hain aur woh ek super doctor ban jaata hai. Ab Arjun ko Karan ke shareer mein dohri zindagi jeeni hai. d: Apne premee ke dhoke aur sab kuch kho dene ke baad, Mahira apne likhe upanyaas ki duniya mein kho jaati hai. Haalaanki, kahaani mein achanak bada badlaav aane lagta hai aur ab Mahira aur upanyaas ke naayak Adhiraaj, dono ek-doosre se nafrat karne lagte hain. Amrita aur Priya dwara prastut

title: EK BOOND ISHQ
d: Nikita ne zindagi ki saari umeedein kho di thi. Wajah thi - Siddharth, jisse woh pyaar karti thi aur jisne usse breakup karne se pahle ek pal bhi nahi socha. Is asveekriti ne use akelepan mein dhakke de diya. Is breakup ke baad woh khud ko kaise sambhalegi? Kya Nikita ko uska pyaar wapas milega ya uska pyaar adhoora hi rahega? title: THE MESSENGER
d: Kaahul naam ke ek chhote se kasbe mein, ek builder ki rahasyamay paristhitiyon mein ek mahila dwara hatya kar di jaati hai. Police is hatyakaand ki jaanch shuru karti hai aur jaanch ke dauran isi tarah do aur hatyaayein ho jaati hain. Yeh baat Baba Maharaj Ji ko raas nahi aati. Maharaj Ji kasbe ko in buraaiyiyon se mukt karaane ka sankalp lete hain. Lekin kasbe ke doosre kone mein, ek nilambit policewale ko ek chhipe hue rahasya ka pata chalta hai jo chhal, shadyantra aur satta ki ladaai ke un adhyaayaon ko ujaagar karne waala hai jo poore kasbe ko hilaakar rakh denge. Suspense, rahasya aur utaar-chadhav se bhari is kahani ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye, sune - The Messenger! Show Team: Inderjeet, Prakhar

title: THE IMMORTAL WARRIOR
d: Car durghatna mein ghayil Dhanush ki aatma do hisson mein bant jaati hai. Aatma ka ek hissa ek nayi duniya mein 10,000 saal bitaane ke baad Prithvi par laut aaya hai, kya jud payenge Dhanush ki aatma ke do hisse? Jaanne ke liye suniye The Immortal Warrior

title: K FOR KING
d: Deshdrohi ka beta karaar diya gaya delivery boy Vedant ko pata chalta hai ki woh 1000 crore rupaye ki sampatti ka asli waaris hai. Apne samrajya ko wapas paane aur apne pita ka naam saaf karne ke liye use Mumbai ki sabse ameer raajkumari Kiara Raizada se shaadi karni hogi. Lekin jab uske mata-pita ki hatya karne wali saazish Kiara ko bhi khatre mein daal deti hai, toh Vedant ke saamne ek mushkil vikalp aa jaata hai - apna badla poora karna ya us mahila ko bachaana jisse use pyaar ho gaya hai. Galiyon se lekar boardroom tak, dekhiye kaise ek delivery boy dushmanon, dhokhe aur apne dil se ladte hue aradpati ban jaata hai.

title: VISHKANYA
d: Naagdhaam ke mahant ne ek bacchi ko dekhkar daawa kiya ki uski raksha Sheshnag vansh ke naag kar rahe hain. Mahant ne bacchi ke mata-pita ko yeh bhi nirdesh diya ki jab woh sapne mein Naagmani dekhe, toh woh unke paas aayein. Bacchi ke aadhunik pita ne is par dhyaan nahi diya, lekin unki beti Vishakha ko baar-baar sapne aate rahe. Agar mahant ki baat sach hai, toh yeh bacchi Vishakha kaun hai? Kya uska pichla janam in sapnon se juda hai? Vishakha aur uske pichle janam ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye sune Vishkanya. Show Team: Amit, Hardik

title: AYUSHMAAN BHAVA
d: Apne mata-pita ko khone ke baad, Kanhaiya bas amar ho jaana chahta tha. Lekin kya yeh is saadharan mombatti ko jalaane jitna aasaan hai? Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Nishat Iqbal.

title: SECRET LIFE OF A FAMILY MAN
d: Yudhveer, jo apni vishesh shaktiyon ko duniya se chhupa kar rakhta hai, Avika se shaadi kar leta hai. Jab Avika ko Yudhveer ke baare mein asli sachhais pata chalegi to kya hoga? Kya Yudhveer ki sachhais Avika ke liye musibat khadi karegi, ya phir dono milkar un shaktiyon ka samna karenge jinse ladne ke liye Yudhveer ko vishesh shaktiyan mili hain?

title: ROYAL ROMANCE
d: Saalon tak apne ghar se door rehne ke baad, Gauri Udaipur wapas aakar bas apni maa ke saath kuch samay bitaana chahti thi, lekin pata chala ki uske parivaar ne uski zindagi mein agla kadam pahle hi tay kar liya tha. Ghar pahunchte hi use pata chala ki uski shaadi bachpan mein hi uske dost Samar Pratap Singh se tay ho gayi thi. Samar ne London mein apni padhai poori ki aur ab raajkumaar tha. Woh bahut hi sankochi swabhaav ka tha jo hamesha apne tak hi seemit rehta tha. Doosri taraf, Gauri ek madhyamvargeey parivesh mein pali-badhi ladki thi aur apne adhikaaron ke liye ladna jaanti thi. Jab ye dono shaadi ke bandhan mein bandhenge toh kya hoga? Kya Samar aur Gauri kabhi pyaar mein padenge? Kya hoga jab Gauri uske parivaar ke saath rehne jaayegi? Jaanne ke liye Royal Romance sune. Show Team: Ankur, Richa

title: AAI BALA KO TAAL TU
d: Ek saadharan college chhatra, Saurabh ek baar ek aitihasik sangrahalay ki yatra par gaya. Haalaanki, wahan uska saamna kuch aisa hota hai jisse uska jeevan badal jaata hai. Voh mahaan shaktiyon ke saath lautta hai. Sangrahalay mein kya hua? Aur Saurabh apne jeevan mein mahatvapurn chunautiyon par kabu paane ke liye apni nayi kshamataon ka upyog kaise karega?

title: MOKSH
d: Apne pita ki rahasyamay mrityu ke peeche ki sachaai jaanne ki khoj mein, Veer Pratap Singh ka saamna un bhatki hui aatmaon se hota hai jo moksh ki prateeksha kar rahi hain. Kya in alaukik mulaaqaton ka Veer ke ateet se koi sambandh hai? Jaise-jaise Veer is maamle ki gaharaai mein jaata hai, woh apne pita ki mrityu se jude rahasyaon ko ujaagar karta hai. Kya Veer in bechaain aatmaon ko mukti dilaane ka maarg khoj payega, ya ye aatmaayein hamesha ke liye uske safar mein baadha banti rahengi?

title: RUDRA - THE SUPERHERO
d: Rudra - The Superhero: ek aise khaas ladke ki kahani hai jo ek insaan aur machine ka combination hai. Mr. Singhania ne ise mafia ki duniya ke liye banaya tha. India mein ek mission ke dauran Rudra ki zindagi mein kuch aisa hua ki woh is duniya ka rakshak ban gaya, aur is duniya ne use superhero ka tag de diya. Kya ye superhero apne hi banaye hue scientist ke khilaf ja payega ya nahi? Ek insaan hone ke naate kya woh ek normal zindagi ji payega? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Rudra ki kahani

title: ASUR
d: Kya aap mrityu ke baad jeevan mein vishwaas karte hain? Agar haan, toh aap bilkul sahi kahani par aaye hain. Yeh kahani hai mashoor underworld don Mohit ki, jise mrityu ke baad ek naya jeevan mila. Apni nayi zindagi mein, woh Yakshan Raajya ka moorakh Anshumaan ban gaya. Ab yeh dekhna behad romanchak hoga ki Mohit ki aatma Anshumaan ke shareer mein kya-kya karegi aur woh apne dushmanon se kaise badla le payega... aur kaise Anshumaan Yakshan Raajya ka sabse bada hero banega.

title: AISI DEEWANGI
d: Ruhi - Taarpur nagar ki sabse khubsurat magar ek aam ladki, jise apni aam zindagi behad pasand thi lekin ek din us nagar ke khatarnak yuvaraj Yaman ki nazar Ruhi ki khubsurti par pad gayi, aur Yaman ne use Rajmahal bulaya. Ruhi darte hue Rajmahal pahunchi toh usne Yaman ka woh roop dekh liya jo kisi khaufnaak manzar se kam nahi tha. Usne Yaman ke shareer ko kisi aur roop mein badalte dekha. Uske lambe nakhun, chehre par khoon ke nishaan, aur laal aankhein dekhkar Ruhi kaanp gayi, aur wahaan se bhaagne lagi. Lekin Yaman ne Ruhi ke aage ek aisi shart rakh di, ki use Yaman ke mahal mein qaid hona pada. Aakhir kya thi woh shart? Kya hai yuvaraj Yaman ka asli roop? Yuvaraj Yaman kaise jataayega dari hui Ruhi se apna pyaar? Jaanne ke liye suniye Aisi Deewangi
