title: MR. CROREPATI SYSTEM
d: Dhruv, ek aam ladka, apne breakup ke baad ek system activate karta hai aur martial artist se bhari duniya ko explore karna shuru kar deta hai. Yeh system ek super spending system hai; Dhruv jitni tezi se system ka paisa kharch karta hai, utni hi tezi se uska level badhta hai. Kya Dhruv apne grah Prithvi ko doosre universe se hone wale bhavishy ke hamlon se bacha payega? Yeh jaanne ke liye, abhi dekhein Mr. Crorepati System!

title: NUMBER ZERO
d: Yun toh Vipin karta hai kai grahon ki sawari. Kya ho jab Prithvi par atak jaaye gaadi. Rukna toh aise tha ki kisi ko na ho khabar, par kya karein jab har kisi ki ho usi par nazar! Vipin ki jaadui library kya uska safar aasaan kar degi, lekin ye bhi Prithvi hai aise kaise itni aasaani se haar maan legi. Doosre grah se aaya Vipin kya Prithvi par apni jagah bana sakega ya is safar mein use koi saathi milega? Jaanne ke liye sune Number Zero

title: MY HEARTLESS LOVER
d: Achintya Singh Shekhawat ek safal vyavsayi aur nirdayi vyakti hai, jiska junoon Khanak par toot padta hai. Aavesh mein aakar Achintya ne Khanak ko dhokha diya aur wah usse door chali gayi. Kya Achintya kabhi pyar ka anubhav kar paega? Aakhir Achintya ne Khanak se badla kyun liya? Kya ye dono kabhi ek ho paenge?

title: HISS REBIRTH OF DESTROYER
d: Do saal tak koma mein rehne ke baad, Shiva ki aatma 'Naag Lok' se khaas martial arts seekhkar apne shareer mein laut aayi hai. Kya Shiva apne aur apne parivaar ke saath hue atyaachaaron ka badla lega? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Rashi Upadhyay

title: YEH HAI MOHABBATE
d: Apne pyaar ko khona har kisi ke liye aasaan nahi hota. Breakup ke baad woh 7 saal tak gaayab rahe lekin jab mile toh unka andaaz kaafi badal chuka tha. Ye kahani hai pyaar ki, pyaar ke us ehsaas ki aur us dard ki jise koi mehsoos nahi karna chahta, lekin agar zindagi ke us khaas padaav se guzar jaayein toh kisi bhi cheez par jeet haasil ki ja sakti hai.

title: TERE ISHQ MEIN THE STORY (OLD)
d: Shivani ko un logon ne dhoka diya tha jinse woh pyaar karti thi aur uska parivaar bhi lagbhag barbaad hone ki kagaar par tha. Shivani ko umeed ki kiran tab mili jab ek ajnabi uski zindagi mein aaya. Uske baad uski zindagi pahle jaisi nahi rahi. Yeh ajnabi kaun hai? Kya Shivani usse pyaar karegi ya yeh rishta un logon ke liye uski nafrat ka shikaar hoga jinhone use dhoka diya? Show Team: Aaryprakash Ram, Richa Acharya

title: REBIRTH STORY OF REVENGE
d: Atharah varsh ki aayu mein Aarushi Gupta ko bataya gaya ki woh desh ke sabse samriddh Gupta parivaar ki sachchi beti hai. Lekin use pyaar ke badle mila sirf tiraskar. Janmdata mata-pita ne use thhukra diya. Sauti behen Kaveri ki jhooti maut ka doshi thhahraaya gaya, aur mangeta Aashish ne bhi use dhoka diya. Chaar saal ki kendr, atyachar aur ant mein ek durdant maut- yahi thi Aarushi ki kismat. Lekin kismat ne use doosra mauka diya. Woh phir se usi atharah varsh ki umra mein jaagi- bina kisi zakhm ke, bina tooti haddiyon ya andhi aankhon ke. Is baar, woh prem ki bheekh nahi maangegi. Ab woh apna jeevan khud sanwaarne aayi hai - jhooth ko benaqaab karne aur jinhone use barbaad kiya, unse badla lene. Ab uski aankhon mein maasoomiyat nahi, sirf pratishodh ki aag hai. Kya is naye janam mein Aarushi apna badla le paayegi? Jaanne ke liye suniye, 'Rebirth: Story Of Revenge'

title: CRUEL HEARTED
d: Maasoom Bani ne kabhi sapne mein bhi nahi socha tha ki mafia don Reyansh Oberoi ke saath bitayi us ek manhoos raat ke baad uski zindagi puri tarah badal jaayegi. Reyansh ab Bani ka deewana ho gaya tha. Reyansh ke is bekhauf junoon se Bani kaise bachegi? Kya Bani ke paas koi aisa raaz hai jo Reyansh jaise mafia don ko bhi barbaad kar sakta hai?

title: DEVIL SE SHAADI
d: Ahankari Rajveer, jisse uske apne parivaar waale bhi uske bartaav ki wajah se darte hain, use Ishki naam ki ek ladki se pyaar ho jaata hai, jo usse darti hai aur use shaitan kehti hai. Kai twists ke baad, uski shaadi uski marzi ke khilaf is aadmi se kar di jaati hai. Aage kya hota hai?

title: LOVE THE DEVIL
d: Kehte hain pyaar saari nafrat mita deta hai. Lekin kya ho jab kisi insaan ke dil mein duniya ke liye itni nafrat bhar jaaye ki woh insaan na rahkar shaitan ban jaaye? Saksham Oberoi ek ghamandi aur ahankari shaitan hai jo kisi aur se nahi, balki khud se pyaar karta hai. Aur Saksham ko ladkiyon se sakht nafrat hai. Aur isi nafrat ki wajah se duniya mein uske kai dushman ban gaye hain. Logon ko maarna uske liye baayein haath ka kaam hai, aur uske haath kai logon ke khoon se range hain. Wahi Mansi college mein padhne waali ek maasoom ladki hai. Jiska sapna IAS banna hai. Ek din Mansi anjaane mein Saksham ko kisi ka qatl karte hue dekh leti hai aur us raaz ko chhipaane ke liye use qaid kar leti hai. Saksham ke saath rehte hue Mansi ko Saksham se pyaar ho jaata hai. Kyunki Saksham bhale hi duniya ke liye shaitan ho, lekin khud ke liye woh kisi bhagwan se kam nahi hai. Kya Mansi ka pyaar Saksham ke dil ki nafrat ko khatam kar payega? Kya Mansi ka pyaar Saksham ko shaitan bana dega? Kya Saksham Mansi ko uske dushmanon se door rakh payega?

title: THE LEGENDARY SURVIVOR
d: Kya hoga agar aap ek din jaag jaayein aur khud ko apne pasandida video game mein paayen! Aap kya karenge jab aapko pata chalega ki aap na sirf game mein NPC hain balki aapko aise samay mein transport kiya gaya hai jab yeh game launch bhi nahi hua tha. Kya hota hai jab kahani ka naayak Garv Rathod bhi aisi hi paristhitiyon ka saamna kar raha hota hai? Garv Rathod is transmission se kaise niptenege? Jaanne ke liye suniye The Legendary Survivor

title: CHAIWALA BANA BILLIONAIRE
d: Yash, jo kabhi ek saadharan chai vikreta tha, ek ameer ladki ke ajeeb saude ko maankar raaton-raat crorepati ban jaata hai. Dhan, shakti aur safalta toh uske peeche-peeche aati hai, lekin saath hi khatarnaak dushman aur ateet ka ek uljha hua pyaar bhi. Jab use lagta hai ki uske paas sab kuch hai, tabhi Yash ek aisa faisla leta hai jiski usne kabhi kalpana bhi nahi ki thi - woh sab kuch chhodkar apni chai ki dukaan par laut jaata hai. Kaun sa gehra raaz use apni banayi hui zindagi se door jaane par majboor kar raha hai? Kya woh apne anubandh ka paalan karega ya apne ateet ke pyaar ke paas laut jaayega? Mukhy kalaakaar - Rohan Jain, Sahyogi kalaakaar - Swanand Wagh

title: THE SWORD GOD
d: Shaurya ek martial art karne wala yoddha hai jo Vyom Lok ke sabse mahaan yoddha banne ki kagaar par hai, lekin jab uski mangetar Nayantara se use dhoka milta hai, use apne 1000 saal purane janam ki saari baatein yaad aati hai. Jahan woh sirf ek yoddha nahi balki khud Sword God, Shaurya Vijay tha. Ye kahani hai Shaurya ki wapis se Shaurya Vijay ban apne dushmanon ko dhool chatane ki! Kya Vijay ban payega ek Sword God? Aur kaise karega woh apne dushmanon ka khaatma? Jaanne ke liye suniye The Sword God

title: INSAANI DRAGON
d: Neil, ek saadharan chhatra, ek jaadui duniya ke apne sajeev sapnon ko bhayankar roop se saakaar hote hue paata hai jab uski mulaqat Sherry naam ki ek rahasyamay ladki se hoti hai. Saath milkar, woh dragons, kaale jaadu aur praacheen bhavishyavaaniyon ke ek aise kshetra mein pahunchte hain jahaan Neil ke bhaagya ka pata chalta hai ki woh apne bheetar chhipe ek shaktishali ratna ki raksha karega. Bhayankar yuddhaon aur rahasyamay rahasyaon se guzarte hue, unka yeh safar unhe ek dusht jaadoogar se antim muthbhed ki or le jaata hai, jahaan woh apni duniya ko aasann andhakaaar se bachane ka prayas karte hain. Show Team - Mohit Sharma, Abhivyanjana Pandey

title: SAADAGI A STORY OF PURE LOVE
d: Shimla mein gundon ke giron ke saath Anjali ke college jeevan ki shuruaat kathin thi, lekin jab use Shivaksh se pyar ho gaya, jo gundon ke giron ka hi hissa tha, to saazishon aur sangharshon ke beech ek nayi shuruaat hui.

title: SUPERSTAR PAPA
d: College graduate Rahul ki zindagi mein tab uthal-puthal mach jaati hai jab uski mulaqat ek chaar saal ki bacchi se hoti hai jo khud ko uski beti bataati hai. Kya Rahul use sweekar karega? Kya woh uske liye zero se hero ban payega?

title: PEHLA NASHA
d: Kehte hain ki pehli nazar mein pyaar ho jaane se zyada khubsurat kuch nahi hota. Nikita ne kabhi socha bhi nahi tha ki Delhi mein college ka uska pehla din uski poori zindagi ek jhatke mein badal dega. Pehle hi din, Nikita ameer aur ghamandi Jay ke pyaar mein pagal ho gayi thi aur use kisi bhi qeemat par apni zindagi mein chahti thi. Nikita ki madad uski sabse achhi dost Tanisha ne ki, jisne sunishchit kiya ki Nikita aur Jay ek saath zyada samay bitaayein aur kareeb aayein. Sab kuch theek chal raha tha jab tak Nikita ko pata nahi chala ki Jay ka sabse achha dost usse pyaar karne laga hai. Aage kya hoga? Ab Nikita kya karegi? Kya Jay apne sabse achhe dost ko chunega ya Nikita ko? Jaanne ke liye Pehla Nasha sune. Show Team: Simran, Richa

title: ROBOT ROMEO
d: Varsh 2050 mein, prasiddh vaigyanik Kabir Kohli ek robot viksit karte hain jisme manav ke sabhi gun hote hain, lekin cheezein tab ajeeb mod leti hain jab robot Kabir ki mangetar ke liye bhavnayen viksit karna shuru kar deta hai.

title: STAR REBORN
d: Vidhi ek bahut mashhoor gaayika thi, lekin achanak unke saath ek haadsa hua, woh unche manch se gir gayi. Baad mein jab unhone aankhen kholin, toh khud ko aaine mein dekhne ke baad unhe ehsaas hua ki woh ek bilkul alag ladki ke shareer mein hain. Aur ab unka naam badlakar Vidushi ho gaya hai, jo bas ek dance trainee hain. Vidhi soch mein pad gayi ki 'unke saath kya hua aur kaise?' In sawaalon ke jawaab jaanne ke liye hamare saath bane rahein aur Star Reborn ki hamaari nayi kahani ke saath

title: KAISA YEH ISHQ HAI
d: Jinse hum sachcha pyaar karte hain, woh aksar hume dhoka dete hain aur jeevan mein aage badh jaate hain. Kuch aisa hi Rishabh ke saath hua jab Maya use chhodkar chali gayi. Lekin Jahnavi Rishabh ke jeevan mein aayi aur uska bhavishy sanwarne lagi. Dono ko pyaar ho gaya... aur unhone shaadi kar li. Lekin kya karein, pehla pyaar toh pehla pyaar hota hai. Ab Rishabh kya karega jab Maya phir se uske jeevan mein aayegi? Creative Team: Ratish Marulkar, Prakash Ram

title: ISHQ KE SHAHAR MEIN
d: Simmi urf Simran, jo ki ek badi family mein pali-badhi hai, sabko lagta tha ki usse khushnasib ladki koi ho hi nahi sakti. Tabhi uski zindagi mein ek ladka aaya. Jiska saath pakar Simran khud ko bahut lucky maanne lagi ki use itna achha life partner milne wala hai. Lekin life ke in ups aur downs ke beech uski family hi uske liye challenge ban gayi. Phir kuch yun hua ki 7 saalon ne Simran ko badal kar rakh diya. Ishq aur life ki bhaagdaud mein ek naye shahar mein, apne iradon ko mazboot karne pahunchi Simmi wahi ladki thi jo kabhi apna stand tak na le paati thi aur aaj jab sirf ek smile kar deti hai toh uski ek smile se bhi aaj sab ghabrate hain. Kaisi thi uski ye nayi udaan? Kaisa tha ye naya shahar? Aur kaisi thi ye nayi manzilein? Janiye aakhir aisa kya hua jisse Simran ki zindagi puri tarah badal gayi?

title: MY LOVE MY WIFE
d: Ye kahani hain Navya aur Ansh ki. Navya (20 saal ki) ek college student hain aur wo bahut hi masoom hain. Use kabhi is duniya ki asaliyat nahi pata. Wo apne maa papa ke pyar ki aakhri nishani hain. Jis wajah se uske papa use apni jaan se bhi zyaada pyar karte hai. Unhone kabhi bhi Navya ko uski maa ki kami ka ehsaas tak nahi hone diya. Lekin kaam mein busy rehne aur Navya ki chinta ki wajah se unhone doosri shaadi kar li. Par is shaadi ke kuch hi saalon ke baad Navya ke papa ki bhi maut ho gayi. Wahin doosri taraf hain Ansh Singh Rajput (27 saal ka) duniya ka sabse bada businessman. Saath hi saath wo is duniya ka sabse rude insaan bhi hain. Kya hoga jab mila degi kismat Navya aur Ansh ko? Kya kabhi ho paega in dono ko ek dusre se pyar? Ya pann-paap jaegi in dono ke dilon mein nafrat?

title: TAAJ TUMHARA
d: 23 varsh ki ayu mein, murkh rani Trishala ne apne pati Maharaj Virbhadra ke krur nirnayo ka virodh kiya... jiske baad, Virbhadra ne sarvajanik roop se unka apman kiya aur unhe thande mahal mein kaid kar diya... lekin yah sab Trishala ki sochi-samjhi yojana ka hissa tha. Vastav mein, jis stri ko Virbhadra aur Vikramgarh murkh rani samjhte the, wah vastav mein Virbhadra ko ukhaad phenkne ki pratigya kar chuki ek khatarnak yoddha thi... thande mahal se bhaag nikalne ke baad, Trishala ek naye roop mein prakat hui, jisse sabhi log dang reh gaye... Virbhadra ke atyachar ke saath-saath, rani maa aur unki raniyon ne shadyantra ki ek nayi leher shuru kar di... Trishala ke liye apne lakshya ko prapt karna din-pratidin kathin hota ja raha tha. Aur phir ek aisa samay aaya jab, pratishodh, wafadari aur anchahi garbhavastha ke beech, Trishala ko yah tay karna tha ki wah Virbhadra ko samapt karke apni pratigya puri kare ya us samrajya ki raksha kare jise log rani Trishala ke naam se jaante the. Trishala kya karegi?

d: Shivam Gandhi ek sampann parivaar se taalluk rakhte hain, lekin saalon pahle unki maa ko apamaaanit aur bahishkrit kiya gaya tha. Ab unke pita unki gupt shaktiyon ke kaaran unhe kisi bhi qeemat par wapas paana chahte hain. Jab Shivam ko iska kaaran pata chalta hai, toh woh duvidha mein pad jaata hai. Shivam Takshak-Naag vansh ka ekmaatra aur aakhiri sarp yoddha bacha hai. Kya Shivam apne pita ko maaf karega, apne Takshak-Naag vansh ki raksha aur use aage badhayega ya apni maa ka badla lega. title: SHAKTIMAAN RETURNS
d: Bees saal pahle, ek dukhdayi ghatna ke baad, Shaktimaan ne phir kabhi apni bhumika na nibhaane ki kasam khaai thi. Lekin aaj... do dashakon ke lambe samay ke baad, Bharat ke sabse mahaan superhero ko wapas laautna hoga - pahle se kahin adhik mazboot, samajhdaar aur shaktishali. Kyunki is baar, khatara buraai se nahi hai... yeh swayam acchaai ki shaktiyon se utpann hota hai. Jo rakshak kabhi manavta ki dhaal bankar khade the, woh ab uske sabse bade khatre mein badal gaye hain. Aur ab, keval ek hi naam hai jo unke prakop ka saamna kar sakta hai - Shaktimaan. Bees saal baad, use ek baar phir uth khadaa hona hoga - logon ke liye, manavta ke liye, hamare grah ke bhaagya ke liye. Kalaakaar - Mukesh Khanna, Sanket Mhatre, Maanini De, Dinpal Ji, Ghanshyam, Anamaya, Aditya, Mani Puhan, Mausam, Vishal Menon, Shailendra Pandey, Sachin Suresh, Akshata Kaamat, Harish Mishra

title: KHOON BARSEGA

d: Pahaadon ka ek seedha-saadha ladka Bhairav achanak ek aisa yoddha ban jaata hai jise buri shaktiyon ko khatam karne ke liye bheja gaya hai. Woh aisi duniya mein apni jagah banaane ke liye sangharsh karta hai jahaan log aksar shaitan se bhi zyada bure saabith hote hain. Yeh kahani saazish, jaadu, rahasya, pyaar aur un ladaaiyon se bhari hai jo Bhairav ki zindagi ko aakaar deti hain. Dimaag ke khelon se bhari is duniya mein Bhairav ka kya hoga jo sirf apne dil ki sunta hai?

title: PISHACH HUNTER

Gaon waalon ki jaan khatre mein pad jaayegi aur khud Aayush ki zindagi ke 5 maheene bache hain, agar use aage zinda rehna hai toh use pishaachon ko maarkar 5 shaktiyan arjit karni hongi...

title: JAANE TU KAHAAN HAI

Ab chaar saal ke algaav ke baad kya Megha ke ateet aur unke rishte ki pechidagiyon ka raaz Kartik ke saamne kabhi khul payega? Team: Kajal Aneja aur Simran Ansari

title: ONE LAST MISTAKE
d: 26 saal ki Priyal Sharma ki zindagi bahut mushkilon bhari rahi hai. Apne poorv premee Varun Sharma ne use chhod diya hai aur ab uski cousin Riya ko date kar raha hai. Apne hi premee aur cousin se dhoka milne ke baad, Priyal ke paas apni takleefein bhulaane ke liye sharaab par nirbhar rehne ke alaawa koi chaara nahi bacha hai. Haalaat tab badal jaate hain jab woh apne purane rishte se aage badhne ke liye doosre shahar chali jaati hai. Tabhi uski mulaqat hotel maalik Rohan se hoti hai aur dono turant ek-doosre ke kareeb aane lagte hain. Aage kya hota hai? Kya Priyal aur Rohan ke beech rishte sudhrengen? Kya woh aakhirkar Varun se aage badh payegi ya uska ateet ek baar phir uski zindagi mein dastak dega? Jaanne ke liye sune Ek Aakhiri Galti

title: VISHWAYUDH ALIENS
d: Vikram Singh ki hatya ke baad, ETDU ki nazar uske bete Arjun par hai. Unki nazar mein, Arjun bhi apne pita ki tarah Prithvi ka rakshak banega. Apne mata-pita ki hatya ka badla lene ke liye Arjun ka kya raasta hoga? Kya woh Prithvi ko raakshas se bacha payega? Team - Aditya Sinha, Saurabh Chatterjee

title: KAMBAKHT MOHABBAT
d: Kabhi ek-dusre ke pyar mein pagal rahe Aditya aur Aparna ko kismat ke ajeeb mod ne alag kar diya. Ek-dusre ko nazarandaaz karne ki unki tamam koshishon ke bawajood, kismat baar-baar unhe mila deti hai. Haalaanki, Aditya ke man mein Aparna ke liye gahra dukh hai; use is baat ka andaza nahi hai ki Aparna unke naajayaz bachche ki parvarish kar rahi hai. Kya yah bachcha unke beech khoe hue pyar ko phir se jaga paega?

title: BAADAL PE PAON HAI
d: Kehte hain ki zindagi mein family ka saath hona bahut zaroori hai, lekin tab kya hoga jab dushman aur koi nahi balki khud ki family hi ho? Tanisha, jo ek professional racer aur actress hai, samajh hi nahi paati ki kab uski zindagi uski apni hi behen ne barbaad kar di. Tanisha ki behen, Devika ne apni behen se uske boyfriend Ansh ko door kar diya. Itna hi nahi Tanisha jo apne papa ke bahut kareeb thi aaj unse nazrein tak nahi mila pa rahi thi. Aisa kya hua Tanisha ke saath? Aur aakhir kyun Devika apni hi behen ka bura chaah rahi thi? Kya Tanisha apni bigdi hui zindagi ko sudhaar payegi? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye ROCK & ROLL.

title: JAB KISI KI TRAF DIL JHUKNE LAGE
d: Yeh kahani Agnivarsha se shuru hoti hai - Agni aur Varsha apne naamon ki tarah do alag log..... Varsha Suryavanshi apne naam se bilkul alag India se meelon door New York shahar mein rehne waali 18 saal ki ladki jiski poori duniya uska business hai uska har minute har second uske mutaabik chalta ek chalti phirti robot ki tarah, waheen doosri or Dehradun mein rehne waala Agni Rathore usse bilkul alag har waqt mastmaula rehne waala ladka..... bilkul alag hote hue bhi kismat unhe ek saath lekar aa gayi unki kahani ek nafrat aur badle se shuru hui. Ye badla kis had tak jaayega?

title: SAMRAT VISHWAJEET
d: Ye Mahabharat ke theek baad Kaliyug ke aarambh ki kahani hai, jahaan raja-rani ki mrityu ke baad unke putra ko maatr 14 varsh ki aayu mein raajgaddi par baithna pada, Mahendraraav raajya ka ye raajkumaar Vishwajeet daivi shaktiyon se paripoorn tha, lekin use praja ka na toh gyaan tha, na hi raajya chalaane ki koi samajh, jiske kaaran use vidroh aur shadyantron ka saamna karna pada. Aur isi beech praja dwara ayogya thahraaye gaye is chaudah varsheeya chhote raja ko ek aatharah varsheeya raajkumaari se prem ho jaata hai, ab dekhna ye hai ki kya raajkumaari apne se chhote raja ko sweekar karegi? Vishwajeet ko uski shaktiyon ke baare mein kaise pata chalega? Kya woh ek yogya raja saabith hoga? Jaanne ke liye suniye

title: GAME OF HEARTS
d: Khubsurat aur aakarshak Love ne ek singing reality show mein hissa liya tha, lekin durbhagyavash woh show nahi jeet saka. Isse uski sabse badi fan, Kayra niraash ho gayi, jo use kisi bhi qeemat par jeet dilaana chahti thi. Lekin baad mein pata chala ki Kayra aur Love, dono ke liye yeh ant nahi tha, balki anjaane mein ek online gaming platform par bhi ek-doosre se baatcheet karne lage. Cheezein tab behtar hoti hain jab dono ek hi college, Delhi Vishwavidyalay, mein pahunch jaate hain. Lagta hai ki ab kismat ne Kayra aur Love dono ke liye kuch aur hi soch rakha tha. Aage kya hoga? Jab woh pehli baar asli duniya mein milenge toh kya hoga? Kya Love aur Kayra ek-doosre ke pyaar mein pad jaayenge? Jaanne ke liye sirf Game of Hearts sune. Show Team: Simran, Richa

title: SANKI LOVE
d: Kalpana kijiye, agar aap kisi ko chhookar uske mann ki saari baatein padh sakein! Yeh hai Aadarsh aur Sanwi ki thriller kahani, jahaan suspense ka raaz hai aur pyaar ki shuruaat abhi baaki. Lekin kya yeh itna aasaan hoga? Suniye poori kahani - 'SANKI LOVE'

title: PYAAR YA NAFRAT
d: Kehte hai pyaar aur nafrat ke darmiyan kaafi kam faasla hota hai.. ye faasla kab nazdeekiyon mein badal jaata hai iska ehsaas bhi nahi ho paata... ye kahani hai Jheel ki jo ki pyaar mein dhoka milne ke baad pyaar ke ehsaas se bhi munh mod chuki hai... ab Jheel ke liye uska kaam hi sab kuch hai aur wahi Dheeraj jiska filhaal ek hi maqsad hai Jheel se badla lena uske liye woh kisi bhi had tak ja sakta hai. Magar dil ke kisi kone mein aaj bhi woh Jheel se bahut pyaar karta hai... Dheeraj ke dil mein Jheel ke liye jo chhupa hua pyaar hai ya uske liye jo nafrat hai.. kaunsa ehsaas Dheeraj ke dil par raaz karega, pyaar ya nafrat??

title: TEJAS EK PRATISHODH
d: Tejas Brahm Lok ke amar raja Maheshwar ka beta tha. Unki amarta sabse shaktishali lok, Vyom Lok ke samraat Vyom ko raas nahi aayi. Isliye samraat Vyom ne Tejas ke bachpan ke pyaar Meera ko maar daala. Uske baad Tejas ne samraat Vyom se badla lene ke liye sabhi shaktiyon mein kathin

title: CLEOPATRA
d: DESCRIPTION NOT AVAILABLE

title: KHAUFF...
d: Shaadi se theek do din pahle, Priya ki zindagi mein ek khaufnak shaitan aaya. Usne na sirf Priya ke mangetar Aditya ko maar daala, balki use apne bacche se bhi garbhavati kar diya! Ek din ke andar hi Priya ne us shaitan ke bacche ko janam diya, jo phir use satane laga.

title: NUMBER ONE NOVA
d: Yah kahani hai Nova ki, jo doosri duniya ki ek kushul yoddha hai aur khud ko marnaasann rajkumari Kaveri ke sharir mein paati hai. Apni bahan jaisi Maya dwara dhokha diye jaane ke baad, Kaveri ka chehra bigad gaya aur use chhod diya gaya. Saza ke taur par, Nova ko Kaveri bankar jeena padta hai. Ab uske do lakshya hain—Maya ke dhoke ka badla lena aur Kaveri ke parivar mein jagah banana. Kya Nova apne badle ki raah mein safal hogi, ya Number One Nova ek apratikshit mod legi? Show ki creative team - Saurabh Yadav (Creative Director), Snehal Potdar (Creative Producer), Lalit Marathe.

title: DOCTOR RAJNEESH LADY'S SPECIALIST
d: Kehne ko toh Rajneesh urf Raju ek naushikhiya medical chhatra hai, lekin jo ilaaj Raju kar sakta hai use duniya ke sheersh surgeons bhi nahi kar sakte. Ek din ek vichitra bhavishyaavaani Raju ki duniya ko ulat-pulat kar deti hai ki use uski apni maa dwara maar diya jaayega! Lekin kyun? Raju jawaab chahta hai. Use apne pita se ek jaadui angoothi virasat mein mili hai jo har mushkil mein kaam aati hai, lekin Raju ise gupt rakhta hai. Usne apni premika se vishwaasghaat ka anubhav kiya, apradhiyon ke saath dosti ki aur ek kukhyaat underworld don se dushmani arjit ki. Raju ka jeevan aisi dilchasp ghataanon se bhara pada hai.

title: BECHARA BILLIONAIRE
d: Ek gareeb aur anaath chhaatra Sunny ko uske rahasyamayi roop se ameer dada ka phone aata hai aur ghoshna karta hai ki usne apne khaate mein karodon rupaye sthaanaantarit kar diye hain aur woh uska uttaraadhikaari hoga, lekin keval tabhi jab Sunny is paise ko adhik laabh mein badalne mein kaamyaab ho jaaye. Sunny khud ko sabit karne ke liye utsuk hai aur yeh bhi jaanna chahta hai ki uske dadaji ne use itne varshon tak door kyun rakha aur uske mata-pita ki mrityu ke peeche kya rahasya hai. Lekin apni nayi mili sampatti aur apne dil ki icchhaaon ko kharidne ki kshamata ke saath, kya woh khud ko ek yogya uttaraadhikaari sabit karega ya apne saare paise kharch kar dega aur ek baar phir haara hua vyakti ban jaayega?

title: SECRET MILLIONAIRE
d: Apne dada ki hatya ke baad Rohan apne asli mata-pita ko khojne ke liye Singapore chala gaya. Usne ek safal suraksha company khooli, tabhi uske dada ke hataare ne use apni beti ki suraksha ke liye bulaya. Rohan ne naukri sweekar karne ka faisla kiya aur woh khud Riya ke angarakshak ke roop mein usse sampark karta hai. Team - Aditya Sinha, Arpita Das

title: SCHOOL OF MAGIC
d: Aapki zindagi mein aamool-chool parivartan laane ke liye bas ek din ki zaroorat hoti hai. Woh ek din aapke jeevan mein ek mahatvapurn ghatna ban sakta hai. Aadarsh se behtar yeh kaun jaan sakta hai, jiski puri zindagi raaton-raat badal gayi? Sab kuch wahi tha, uska school, uske dost, uske sahpaathi, lekin vigyan ke ird-gird ghoomne waale Aadarsh ke jeevan mein kuch bilkul naya aaya. High school mein, jahaan chhatra doctor aur engineer banne ke liye padhai kar rahe the, wahaan Aadarsh apne samay ka sabse shaktishali jaadoogar banne ke liye puri tarah taiyaar tha. Aage kya hoga? Kya Aadarsh bada hokar ek shaktishali jaadoogar banega? Aadarsh ke safar ki ek dilchasp kahani, School of Magic sune. Show Team: Gaurav, Prakhar

title: SUPER SIDDHARTH
d: Siddharth ne apne bachpan mein rahasyamayi paristhitiyon mein apna parivaar kho diya. Ab use sacchai ka pata lagaane ke liye ek yoddha banna hoga, lekin use kis par bharosa karna chahiye? Show Team - Aditya Sinha, Saurabh Chatterjee aur Richa Aacharya.

title: RISK WALA LOVE
d: Rishi ek top businessman hai lekin us par manhoos ka tag laga hai. Uske saath relationship mein aane waali har ladki ka koi na koi haadsa ho jaata hai. Aise mein Rishi ka saamna hota hai Juhi se, jiske saamne woh ek contract marriage ka prastaav rakhta hai. Woh is kaam ke liye Juhi ko hi kyun chunata hai? Rishi ke baare mein sab kuch jaante hue bhi Juhi is shaadi ke liye kyun maan jaati hai? Kya Juhi bhi kisi haadse se guzaregi ya is contract marriage ka koi aur anjaam hoga?

title: YOU ME AUR SHADI
d: DESCRIPTION NOT AVAILABLE

title: PAKSHIRAJ
d: College student Manav yeh jaankar hairaan reh jaata hai ki uske shareer mein insaan aur pakshi dono ke elements ka mixture hai, jo 4000 saal pahle jitne purane samay ka hai.

title: MRITYUNJAY THE DIVINE WEAPON
d: Vijayant, jise kabhi Mandar ka sabse bahaadur yoddha aur sinhaasna ka sachcha daawedaar maana jaata tha, achanak najaayaz ghoshit kar diya gaya aur uski pehchaan chheen li gayi. Poore raajya ke saamne apamaanit hokar woh nirvaasan mein bhatakta raha aur apne bhoole hue ateet mein chhipi ek bhayankar sachaai se roobaru hua. Uski bichhdi hui judwaan behen, Ilakshi, asuron ki raani ban chuki thi. Ek taraf uska toota hua ateet tha, aur doosri taraf uski behen jo ab uski sabse badi dushman ban chuki thi. Kya Vijayant apna khoya hua samman wapas pa sakega aur is antim yuddh mein jeet haasil kar payega?

title: PANCHALI KA PRATISHODH
d: Veer raajkumari Nandini ko apne premee ke haathon chhal ka saamna karna pada hai! Apne paanch patiyon ke sahyog se, Nandini apne pita ke apamaan ka badla legi! Creative Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Chirag Kulshreshtha

title: DIL CONNECTION
d: Deepika ke life mein Ranveer ne di hai ek baar phir dastak. Ranveer se Deepika ka hai saat saal purana connection. Lekin is love bird ke nok jhonk ka hoga koi end? Kya ye do dhadakte dil ho jaayenge ek doosre se connect? Suniye ek life aur love ke utaar-chadhav ki ek romantic kahani 'Dil Connection'.

title: MHARI CHAND KANWAR
d: Ek saal pahle, Siya ne ek durghatna mein apne pati Raghav aur parivaar ko kho diya, jiske baad use London jaana pada. Lekin aaj, use apne adhikaaron ke liye ladne ke liye Rajasthan laautna pada hai, lekin paristhitiyon ke chalte use Samarth se shaadi karni padti hai. Kya yeh shaadi Siya ke liye saza sabit hogi ya use Samarth mein Raghav ka pyaar phir se milega? Siya ki zindagi mein aage kya hota hai,

title: SHIVAY EK VINASHAK
d: Shivay, ek upahaas ka paatr lekin ek chhupa hua yuddha naayak, apne bachpan ke pyaar Avantika ko bachaane ke liye ek nidaar yaatra par nikalta hai. Is dauraan, woh vishwaasghaat, wafaadaari aur sachche pyaar ki gehraai ko samajhte hue apna sammaan aur shakti punah praapt karta hai.

title: MARRIED TO A HEARTLESS
d: Somnath ki wajah se Rudra ke pita Sanjay ne khud ko goli maar li thi. Isliye Rudra Somnath se badla lene ke liye Kittu se shaadi kar leta hai. Aur Rudra apni dushmani ke chalte Kittu ko bahut pratadit karta hai. Lekin jab Rudra ko pata chalta hai ki Kittu Somnath ki beti nahi, balki uske bhai Naren ki beti hai. Aur woh bol bhi nahi sakti. Toh kya yeh jaanne ke baad Rudra use apni patni ke roop mein sweekar karega? Ya aap usse nafrat karte rahenge?

title: LOVE EX AUR DHOKHA
d: Apne parivaar ki parampara ka paalan karte hue, ek dhani waaris 24 varsh ki aayu tak delivery boy ke roop mein kaam karta hai, aur yeh baat apni patni se bhi chhupaye rakhta hai. Haalaanki, uski patni ki aakaankshaayen uske vartamaan roop se mel nahi khaatin, jiske kaaran woh talaak lene ka faisla karti hai. Content/Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Rashi Upadhyay.

title: SECRET FAUJI
d: Kahani Kabir Shekhawat ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jo Military Intelligence Bureau ke sabse behtarin sainikon mein se ek maana jaata hai. Haalaat tab badal jaate hain jab uske shareer mein ek aisa rasaayan daala jaata hai jo har guzarte din ke saath uske shareer ko kamzor karta jaata hai. Haalaat tab aur bigad jaate hain jab MIB yaani Military Intelligence Bureau faisla karta hai ki unhe ab Kabir ki apne sainik ke roop mein zaroorat nahi hai. MIB se nikaale jaane ke baad toota hua aur tabaah Kabir apne grihanagarr Delhi wapas jaane ka faisla karta hai. Kabir ko ehsaas hota hai ki uski zindagi badlane wali hai jab uski mulaqat Bollywood abhinetri Jennifer Birla se hoti hai, jo uski patni bhi hai. Kabir ke liye aage kya hai? Kya usne Jennifer se gupchup shaadi kar li hai? Pati-patni ki jodi ke aamne-saamne aane ke baad kya hota hai? Jaanne ke liye sune Secret Fauji

title: WRONG CHOICE
d: Yah kahani Sahar Saxena ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jo Ishan Saxena ki patni thi. Wahin, Ishan ki zindagi mein Jaanvi naam ki ek premika thi, jo Ishan ke bachche ko janam dene wali thi. Sahar shuru mein baanjh thi, jis wajah se uski saas use naapasand karti thi. Haalaanki, Jaanvi ki haalat jaankar Ishan ne jaanbujhkar Sahar ko talaaq de diya. Talaaq ke baad, Sahar Mumbai chali gayi, jahan uski mulaqat Akshay naam ke ek ladke se hui, jisne uski dekhbhal ki. Baad mein, Ishan ko apni galti ka ehsaas hua aur wah Sahar ko wapas apni zindagi mein laana chahta hai. Kya Sahar garbhavati ho paegi? Wah kise chunegi? Aur jaanne ke liye prasarit hone wala yah show 'Wrong Choice' dekhein. Show team: Archana, Richa

title: MY HEART BELONGS TO YOU
d: Apni shaadi ke din, Aaradhya ko apni behen aur hone waale pati dwara dhoka diye jaane ke baad Rudraksh se shaadi karne ke liye majboor hona padta hai. Kya Aaradhya Asia ke sabse bade businessman aur Mumbai ke underworld don Rudraksh ke saath khush reh payegi?

title: THE LEGENDARY AVATAR
d: Rohit aur Kabir naam ke do bhaiyon ki zindagi tab badal gayi jab Kabir ka apaharan ho gaya. Sirf Rohit ko pata tha ki uska bhai chupke se Call of Destiny ka top khiladi tha, gaming ki duniya ka sitara tha. Rohit ne Kabir ko dhundhne ka sankalp liya aur isi ke liye woh gaming ki duniya mein utar gaya. Team - Aditya Sinha, Arpita Das

title: ROWDI KO RANI SE PYAR HOGYA
d: Ye kahani hai gangster Abhay ki jise ek bahut hi khubsurat aur business tycoon Natasha ke swayamvar mein jakar us se shaadi karne ka kaam saunja jata hai. Is kaam ke liye use ek locket diya jata hai aur wo locket dekar Natasha Abhay ko hi chun leti hai. Kya khaas hai is locket mein? Kya hoga inki zindagi mein aage?

title: JASOOS ALIA
d: Jab main pehli baar usse mila, toh woh aspatal ki ek anjaan nurse thi. Jab main doosri baar mila, toh woh mere pasandida bar mein bartender thi. Teesri baar milne par woh mere bhai ki premika thi. Ab main nahi jaanta ki chauthi baar milne par woh kya hogi? Lekin mujhe, use apni patni banana pada...! Aalia, jo ek sub-inspector thi. Woh apni engagement wale din hi... apne pyaar ki qurbani dekar, apni undercover agent aur best friend Naina ke katil, ek serial killer ki khoj mein nikal padi aur iske liye use guzarna pada ek experiment se...! Jab use achanak ek nayi gupt sarkari takneek ke prayog ka hissa banana pada, jiske tehat Naina ki memory ko Aalia mein transfer kiya gaya. Is takneek ke saath, woh ek gangster se dosti karne mein safal ho gayi thi. Idhar uska pyaar Puneet, uske raaste ka kaanta banta ja raha tha. Saath hi woh nayi-nayi musibaton mein phasti ja rahi thi. Gangster se dosti ka raaz, serial killer ki talaash aur uske pati ki guthi.... kya sulajhegi? Aur kaise Aalia, Naina ki memory se mukt hogi?

title: HIDDEN MAFIA
d: Ruksit ka ateet kai rahasyoon ko chhupata hai. Kya hota hai jab apni krurata ke liye jaana jaane waala ek aadmi apratikshit roop se Aarana ke aalingan ki garmahat mein pyaar paata hai?

title: MY DANGEROUS LOVER
d: Yeh kahani hai 22 varsheeya medical chhatra Suhani ki. Achanak ek din do shaitan ek-ek karke uski chhoti si duniya mein pravesh karte hain. Jiske baad uska jeevan puri tarah badal jaata hai. Dono use apne jaal mein phasaana chahte hain. Aakhir ye do shaitan kaun hain? Woh Suhani ke jeevan mein kyun aaye hain? Suhani unse kaise bach payegi?

title: FAKE LOVE
d: Superstar Anant Kapoor, ek famous hospital ki ek doctor Riya Chakravarti ke saath love scandal mein phans jaate hain. Riya ne kabhi sapne mein bhi nahi socha tha ki ek haadsa use Anant Kapoor ki love partner bana dega. Kya hoga jab do anjaan log apne career ko bachane ke liye ek fake love contract ka sahara lenge. Majboori mein shuru kiye gaye is rishte ki koi manzil hai bhi ya nahi? Is fake couple ki zindagi mein aage kya hoga? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye.

title: NA JANE KYA HAI TUJHSE RAABTA
d: Yeh kahani hai Rajvansh aur Avika ki. Avika ek madhyamvargeey parivaar ki seedhi-saadhi ladki hai, jo Lucknow mein apne parivaar ke saath rehti hai aur apne parivaar se bahut pyaar karti hai. Uski khushhal zindagi mein tab badlaav aata hai jab use pata chalta hai ki woh banne waali hai, jabki uski na toh shaadi hui thi aur na hi woh kisi tarah alag hui thi. Antim Avika garbhavati kaise hui? Phir hua kuch aisa jisne Avika ke pyaar aur rishte par se vishwaas hi tod diya. Doosri taraf, Delhi mein rehne waale Rajvansh, Wadhwa Group of Industries waale ka putla hai, jo ek nirmam juda hua hai. Ek aisa insaan jo poori duniya par raaj karta hai, pyaar aur insaaniyat ke liye jaise koi bhi insaan nahi bolta, jo pal bhar mein kisi ke bhi saamne jhuk sakta hai, maut ki ek jhalak duniya bhar mein ladkiyon ko mil sakti hai. Lekin usne kabhi kisi ladki ki taraf dekha tak nahi. Kismat ke khel mein Rajvansh aur Avika ne ek aisa hi mazboot page baandh diya hai, jisse unke saathi bhi hain aur anna bhi.

title: KOEL MALHOTRA KI SECRET LIFE
d: Ek chhote shahar ki khushmizaaj ladki apne pati ke saath ek saadharan shaadishuda zindagi ji rahi hai, jab tak ki use Koel Malhotra naam ki ek ladki ka phone nahi aa jaata, jo uski zindagi ko puri tarah badal deti hai. Show ki Team: Bhaaravi Shah, Swati Tripathi

title: MR. AMIRZAADA
d: Abhay ko zindagi bhar har kisi ne pareshan kiya hai, yahaan tak ki uski patni bhi use garib bataakar use neeche dikhane mein koi qasar nahi chhodi. Lekin sabko pata nahi ki Abhay duniya ke sabse ameer parivaaraon mein se ek se taalluk rakhta hai.

title: SUCCESSOR OF HIDDEN EMPIRE
d: Yah kahani hai ek Arav naam ke ladke ki, jo apni yaaddaasht kho baitha tha. Lekin ek din ek bahut bade hadse ki wajah se uski yaaddaasht wapas aa jati hai. Jis wajah se use pata chalta hai ki uske poore parivar ko kisi ne khatam kar diya hai. To wah apne parivar ki maut ka badla lene ki kasam khata hai. Aakhir Arav kaise lega apne parivar ki maut ka badla, aur apne parivar ko kaise aage badhaega?

title: SUPER SOLDIER
d: Yeh kahani hai Karan ki, jo 7 saal pahle ek durghatna ke baad Delhi se Mumbai aaya tha... lekin in 7 saalon mein Mumbai mein guzara karne ke liye Karan ne kai aise kaam kiye, jinke chalte woh kaafi kushal ban gaya... lekin ek din jab woh wapas Delhi lauta, toh uski zindagi mein ek apratikshit ghatna ghatit hui... toh ab Karan in pareshaniyon se kaise nipaTega aur 7 saal pahle uske saath aisi kaun si ghatna ghati thi, jiske kaaran use Delhi chhodna pada?

title: WAJAH TUM HO
d: Danish Oberoi ek bhaavnaaheen aur sakht mizaaj ke kaarobaari the, jo pyaar shabd mein vishwaas nahi karte the. Lekin ek din Antara naam ki ek anath ladki unke jeevan mein aayi, jisse Danish ko pehli nazar mein hi pyaar ho gaya aur unhone jabardasti Antara se shaadi kar li. Shaadi ke baad hi Antara ko Danish ke baare mein ek aisi sachaai pata chali, jisse woh unse nafrat karne lagi. Aakhir Danish ki sachaai kya thi? Kya Antara ki nafrat kabhi khatam hogi?

title: AAJ KA HERO
d: Vikrant, ek 21 saal ka ladka, teen saal se jail mein tha kyunki woh ek plan mein phans gaya tha. Jab woh riha hua, toh uske saath kuch chaunkane waala hua. Uski girlfriend, Shruti, jisse woh kisi bhi cheez se zyada pyaar karta tha, usne use dhoka diya tha. Lekin yeh ant nahi tha; yeh uske liye ek nayi shuruaat thi. Kuch aisa hua jo uski zindagi hamesha ke liye badlane waala tha. Vikrant ki girlfriend ne uske saath kya kiya? Aur Vikrant ke saath aisa kya hua jo uski zindagi badlane waala tha? Show by: Drishti, Puneet aur Azhan

title: VED-ASTRA SECRETS OF THE DIVYAGRANTH
d: Aadhunik Bharat ke kendr mein, Ved—ek vichitra lekin buddhiman 18 varshiya yuva—ko Divyagranth milta hai, jo ek bhoola hua, rahasyamaya granth hai aur prachin rahashyon se bhara hua hai, jo rahasyamaya tarike se use apna rakshak chunata hai. Jaise hi bhayankar rakshas raja Vikram Agnilok se uthne lagta hai, Kaal Netra Sangh naaamak ek mrityu-pooja karne wala sampraday Paatal Lok se ubharta hai. Unmen Mauni bhi shamil hai—ek kapati, roop badlane wali rakshasi aur Vikram ki sabse samarpit anuyayi—jo sabke samne chhipi hui hai, apne adharmee swami ke liye vinaash karne ko taiyaar hai. Bina kisi shakti, bina kisi prashikshan ke, keval apne man aur ichchhashakti ke bal par, Ved ko apne vansh mein dabe satya ko ujaagar karne ke liye samay ke saath daaud lagani hogi—isse pehle ki bhagya aur duniya andhakaar mein doob jaye.

title: HEROGIRI
d: Chhatravritti prapt chhatra ke vesh mein, Deven Delhi ke ek pratishthit college mein ghuspaith karta hai, aur ek gupt mission par anjaane mein apraadik duniya mein qadam rakh deta hai - 'Herogiri' mein uske bhagya aur Nandita se uske sambandh ke peeche ki sachaai ka pata lagaayen.

title: SHERDIL
d: Ek haadse ki wajah se sena se barkhaast hue Arjun ko ab apne dost ki behen ki jaan bachaani thi. Arjun ne business tycoon Isha ka bodyguard bankar uski jaan bachaane ka sauda kiya, lekin is saude mein usne Isha ke kai hinsak dushmanon ko apna dushman bana liya. Kya woh Isha ko in khataron se bacha payega? Show Team - Mohit Sharma, Aakash, Richa

title: BAALI YUG YUGANTAR
d: Ek bheeshan aatankwadi hamle ke pashchat kuch nishkriy sangathan puna suptavastha se baahar aa gaye aur aarambh ho gayi bheeshan narsanharon ki ek aghorit shrrinkhala jisne desh ke saath-saath sampurna vishwa ko hila kar rakh diya. Is shrrinkhala se ek rahasyamayi yoddha ne apni upasthiti darj karai jis ki jadein prachin Bharat ki gathaon se judi hui thi, wah jis uddeshy ke liye pratibaddh tha usne samuche vishwa ki dharnaon evam itihas ke saath-saath vartaman aur bhavishy tak ko badal kar rakh diya. Satyug, Tretayug, Dwaparyug aur Kaliyug tak chhipa hua ek rahasya, ek aisi shakti, jo sampurna vishwa ke saath-saath ek samuche yug ko parivartit karne ki kshamata rakhti thi.

title: BOUND TO HIM
d: Yeh kahani hai chulbuli aur bindaas ladki Shubhi ki. Paanch saal pehle ek haadse mein Shubhi ka poora parivaar usse chin gaya. Tab Sanjeev Mittal aur unki patni Anita Mittal ne Shubhi ki dekhbhal ki aur uska sahara bane. Lekin aaj achanak Anita ji ne Shubhi se apne ehsaanon ke badle kuch aisi maang ki jisse Shubhi ke pairon tale zameen khisak gayi. Anita ji chahti hain ki Shubhi ki shaadi unke pote Aditya se ho jaye. Shubhi bhi dil se Aditya ko pasand karti hai aur Anita se waada karti hai ki woh kabhi Aditya ka saath nahi chhodegi. Aise mein kya hoga jab Aditya Mittal ko is shaadi ke baare mein pata chalega, kyunki Shubhi mein unki koi dilchaspi nahi hai. Kya Aditya Shubhi ko apna bana payega? Aur jaanne ke liye 'Bound To Him' sunte rahiye.

title: MAAHESHMATI KI MAHAGATHA
d: Mahendra Singh Doshi orf Munnu, ek yuva, shaatir dhokebaaz hai jo din mein taxi chalata hai aur raat mein Baba Hathiram ke roop mein vidharmee ban jata hai. Achanak, wah khud ko 5432 saal peeche, Maheshmati ke jadui rajya mein pata hai. Rajnitik saazishon, khatarnak dushmanon aur rahasyamayi shaktiyon se bhari is duniya mein, kya Munnu apne asli uddeshya ko khoj paega aur itihas ka sabse mahan yoddha ban paega? Kya wah kabhi ghar wapas laut paega?

title: KING OF DRAGON
d: Ek ladka jisne kam umra mein hi itna ooncha mukaam haasil kar liya, jiska log sirf sapna dekhte the. Woh dragon raja bana, lekin logon ke laach aur dhokhe ne use maut ke munh mein dhakkel diya. Jis ladki par usne sabse zyada bharosa kiya, wahi uski barbaadi ka kaaran bani. Lekin das hazaar saal baad, uski aatma ek saadhaaran ladke ke roop mein dharti par lautti hai. Pyaar mein dhoka kha chuka Arjun ab dragon raja ki shaktiyaan praapt karke apni kismat badalne wala hai. Kya Arjun is baar apne dushmanon se badla le payega? 'King of Dragon' ki kahani sunein.

title: MADNESS IN LOVE
d: Yeh kahani hai Mumbai ke sabse bade kaarobaari Akshat Jindal aur madhyamvargeey ladki Vaishali Suryavanshi ki. Vaishali ka chunaav Jindal Industries ke interview mein uski kaabiliyat ke dam par ho jaata hai, lekin woh company ke maalik Akshat Jindal ke baare mein kuch nahi jaanti. Vaishali aur Akshat ki mulaqat ek durghatna mein hoti hai. Akshat ki car Vaishali ki scooty se takra jaati hai aur Vaishali gusse mein aakar Akshat ki car par patthar phenk deti hai. Vaishali ke is bartaav se Akshat aag baboola ho jaata hai. Aakhir Akshat Vaishali ke saath kya karega? Unki is pehli mulaqat ka kya nateeja niklega? Aur jab Vaishali ko company ke maalik ke baare mein pata chalega toh kya hoga? Kya Akshat Vaishali ko apni company se nikaal dega? 'MADNESS IN LOVE.'

title: RUDAALI
d: Chandrakala Mayapur gaon mein rudaali ke roop mein kaam karti hai aur graminon ke antim sanskar bhi karti hai. Uski 12 saal ki beti Neeti hai. Neeti ke paas kuch vishesh shaktiyan hain jo duniya se chhipi hui hain. Ek din, Chandrakala ko gaon ke sarpanch ki beti ka antim sanskar karne ke liye bulaya jata hai. Jab Chandrakala ko pata chalta hai ki yah aatmhatya hai, to wah anushthan karne se inkar kar deti hai. Haalaanki, sabhi ko ek tabaahi ki chetavni dene ke bawajood, use jabardasti antim sanskar karne ke liye majbur kiya jata hai. Uski chetavni sach ho jati hai. Dah sanskar ke turant baad, gramin ek-ek karke marne lagte hain. Graminon ki maut ke peeche kya rahasya hai? Chandrakala ko iske baare mein kaise pata chala? Kya Chandrakala apne gaon ko is vinaashkari ant se bacha paegi? Rahasya ko sulajhane ke liye, 'Rudaali' sunein! Creative team - Kanchan Gosavi, Hardik Gupta

title: SILENT LOVE S01 & S02
d: Apni sauteli maa aur behen se pratadit ek maasoom bacchi, Tia, ek rahasyamay ajnabi ke jeevan mein aane par aasha ki kiran jagaati hai. Uske asli irade spasht na hone ke baavajood, kya woh use woh pyaar aur badlaav dila payega jiski use besabri se talaash hai? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Jyoti Pal.

title: KAUN TUJHE YOU PYAAR KAREGA
d: Tamanna ko uske pati ne chhod diya hai aur woh akeli maa bankar apne saat varsheeya bete Armaan ki parvarish karne ke liye sangharsh kar rahi hai. Udaipur mein uska roodhivaadi parivaar us par ek agyaat vyakti ke bacche ko janam dene ka aarop lagaata hai, kyunki uska premee Arjun garbhaavastha ke dauran rahasyamay tarike se gaayab ho gaya tha. Tamanna ki khoj yeh jaanne ki hai ki uska pyaar kahaan hai aur kya woh kabhi apne bacche ko apnaane ke liye wapas aayega ya kya Tamanna apne ateet ke kaale jhanjhaton aur parivarik rajneeti se ladte hue naya pyaar paayegi. Team - Amrita Sengupta aur Swati Goradia

title: DATING THE DOCTOR
d: Judwan janmi Megha aur Monica ko ghar mein alag-alag rakha jata tha. Monica ki chalaaki hamesha Megha ko kabu mein rakhti thi aur kabhi-kabhi agar Megha Monica ka virodh karti ya uski baaton ko nakaarti, to use iski keemat chukani padti thi. Megha ko Monica ki har harkat ka dard sahna padta tha aur in sab ke chalte usne kayi baar ghar chhodne ka bhi socha, lekin use nahi pata tha ki uski yah ichchha galat tarike se puri hogi. Ek din, ghar mein ek durghatna ke karan Megha beghar ho gayi, jabki ismen uska koi haath nahi tha. Phir use apni mausi Mary ke chhote se ghar mein rehna pada, lekin doosri taraf uske baimaan chacha ne use paison ke liye kisi ameer aadmi ko bech diya. Megha ki zindagi mein ek naya mod aaya, jab uske khaandani dushman ke bete Praveen ne use god le liya. Praveen ne use padhne, jeevan mein aage badhne aur apni bahan aur parivar se badla lene ka mauka diya.

Parivaar chahta hai ki Avni use talaak le le, lekin unhe is baat ka pata nahi hai ki jise woh apni beti ke liye anupyukt damaad samajhte hain, woh vaastav mein Ranjore ka bhagooda raajkumar 'Chhote Hukum' hai. Ek bade vivaad ke kaaran, woh chaar saal baad apne shaahi parivaar se sampark karta hai. Lekin dhan aur satta ke saath-saath use unki ek shart bhi maanni padti hai. Unki shart kya hai? Gautam ne chaar saal baad apne parivaar se sampark kyun kiya, usne Avni aur uske parivaar se apni pehchaan kyun chhupa rakhi thi aur iska Gautam aur Avni ke vivaah par kya prabhav padega?

Dekhne mein aisa lagta tha jaise phone alaukik shaktiyon se bhara ho. Phone mein ek ajeebogreeb khel tha jisne Rohit ke liye ek nayi duniya khol di. Lekin ye khel apne saath anjaane khatron aur doosri duniya ke ajnabiyon ko lekar aaya. Woh khel kab pagal hataaron aur khooni aatmaon ka khel ban gaya, Rohit samajh hi nahi paya. Suniye, rahasya, romanch aur bhoot-preton se bhari ye khaufnaak kahani, jahaan jeetne waale ko inaam milega aur haarne waale ko sirf maut.

Kya contract ki yeh shaadi kabhi pyaar mein badlegi, ya Shreya ko is rishte ke liye bhari qeemat chukani padegi?

title: HAWELI
d: Antara ke pita ke nidhan ke baad, jab uski maa ne apne doosre pati ke saath naya jeevan shuru kiya, toh Antara ne apne college ke doston ke saath apne paitrik haveli mein rehne ka faisla kiya. Yeh baat bilkul sahi hai ki ek purani haveli kai rahasyaon aur gupt baaton ko chhipaye rakhti hai. Apne bhavishy ko lekar anabhigya Antara haveli mein rehne lagti hai, tabhi uske premee Tushar ke saath kuch durbhaagyapoorurn ghatna ghatit hoti hai. Tushar ke saath kya hua? Ab Antara kya karegi? Jab uske doston ka samooh ghar mein kuch bhayankar dekhta hai toh kya hota hai? Yeh jaanne ke liye Haveli ki romanchak kahani dekhein. Show Team: Simran, Prakhar

title: TIME GAME
d: Dev jise kabhi apne maa-baap ka pyaar nahi mila aur jiske kitaabein hi uski dost thin. Use ek din mili ek aisi ghadi jiska istemal kar Dev doosre insaanon ki tulna mein 24 ghante zyada jeeta tha. Par ye nayi shakti lekar aayi apne saath dher saari musibatein. Aakhir kya tha us ghadi ka raaz? Aur kya wakai time ko kisi ghadi ke nawaare badhaya ya ghataaya jaana mumkin tha? Jaanne ke liye sune samay ko rok dene wale ek romanchak safar ki ek hairtangez kahani!

title: MY AGENT WIFE
d: Yah Avya aur Artha ki kahani hai. Avya ek aisi ladki hai jo dohari zindagi ji rahi hai. Usne duniya ki nazaron mein ek alag pahchaan aur haqeeqat apna rakhi hai, kyunki usne kayi gehre raaz chhupa rakhe hain. Tab kuch aisa ghatit hota hai jab Avya ki shaadi karobaari Artha Kunal Singh se ho jati hai, jo usse behad nafrat karta hai. Aakhir wo kaun sa karan tha jiske chalte in do nafrat karne walon ko shaadi ke pavitra bandhan mein bandhna pada? Kya ye Artha ki nafrat ki wajah se hai, ya koi aur karan? Aur Avya ka wo kaun sa raaz tha jise woh sabse zyaada chhupa rahi thi? Kya nafrat ki ye deewar kabhi pyar mein badal paegi? Kya kabhi aap apni patni ke raaz ka matlab jaan paenge? 'My Agent Wife' sunte rahiye.

title: MAIN TERI CHANDANI
d: Kehte hai pyaar zindagi ka sabse khubsurat ehsaas hota hai par kya ho jab ye ehsaas do aise dilon mein dastak de jo ek-doosre se juda ho? Rajeev........ jise nafrat hai pyaar shabd se kyunki isi pyaar ki wajah se samaaj ne unke naam ke saath najaayaz shabd jod diya hai. Uske dil mein itna zeher bhar diya hai ki woh khud se hi nafrat karne laga hai. Usne apni zindagi ka sirf ek hi maqsad bana liya hai. Apne pita ki barbaadi. Aur Chandni ....... jiske liye pyaar hi zindagi hai. Dard mein bhi muskuraane ki wajah dhundhna use bahut achhe se aata hai. Kya ho agar ye dono ek-doosre se takraayein? Agar inke dilon mein ek-doosre ke liye pyaar ka khubsurat ehsaas dastak dene lage? Kya Rajeev apna ateet bhulakar Chandni ko apni zindagi mein shaamil kar payega? Kya Chandni ka pyaar Rajeev ko uske ateet se bahar nikaalkar jeena sikha payengi? Jaanne ke liye suniye ek nayi kahani Main Teri Chandni

title: SHAURYA VEER

Is asafalata ke kaaran uska apni premika Megha se breakup ho jaata hai aur ek din achanak Shaurya ke pita bhi gaayab ho jaate hain, use bhaari karz aur ek jaadui chip chhodkar...! Kya Shaurya is jaadui chip ka upyog karke Megha ka dil wapas jeet payega? Kya woh apne pita ko dhundh payega?

Durbhagya se, kismat ko Anjali ke liye kuch aur hi manzoor tha aur Shlok ne Meera se shaadi kar li. Meera se shaadi ke baad jab Anjali ki mulaqat Shlok se dobara hoti hai, to kya hota hai? title: UNWANTED MARRIAGE

Shaadi ke kuch dinon pahle hi Meera ki best friend Vishu ka bhai Neil America se India aata hai aur kuch aisa hota hai ki na chahte hue bhi Meera ki shaadi Neil se ho jaati hai. Meera ke liye ye rishta keval ek zimmedaari tha aur Neil ko na hi pyaar par vishwaas tha aur na hi use Meera samajh aati hai. Lekin kehte hai na jo kismat ko manzoor hota hai woh hokar hi rehta hai. Is anchaahe rishte ko nibhate-nibhate dono kab ek doosre ko chaahne lage pata nahi chala aur jab dono ko is baat ka ehsaas hua, tab Neil ki dost Jahnavi India aati hai jo Neil se beinteha pyaar karti hai. title: EMPIRE OF HIDDEN KING
d: Atharv Singhania jo duniya ki sabse ameer parivaar ka waaris hai. Desh videsh ki sabhi badi companies mein share hain. Aur uski filmi big jo Singhania Group ke naam se poori duniya mein famous hai. Badi se badi daulat bhi Singhania Group ke logon tak nahi pahunch saki. Lekin Atharv pichhle 10 varshon se vishraam kar raha hai. Ek gareeb ka jeevan. Koi nahi jaanta ki woh kahaan par hai. Unki shaadi Mumbai sheher ki ek jaani maani Mani ne family mein hui thi. Unki shaadi ko poore 3 saal beet chuke hain. Aur woh pichhle teen saagaron se apni taanon ko sunta aa raha hai. Uski life Naina hai. Jo ek khoobsoorat aur jaadui ladki hai. Par aaj tak dekh kar kisi ko yeh pata nahi chala ki woh is shaadi se khush hai. Ya dukhi? Toh kaisi rahegi aapki marriage life aaiye hamaare saath 'Empire of Hidden King'

title: RAABTA

Ek ke baad ek baatein hoti gayi aur uski shaadi Arjun se tay ho gayi, jisse Anushka nafrat karti thi lekin uski badi behen usse pyaar karti thi. Anushka ke liye haalaat tab badal gaye jab woh apne parivaar ke liye jail pahunch gayi. Lekin kehte hain na ki jo kismat ko manzoor hota hai, woh hokar hi rehta hai. Shaadi aur parivaar ke beech phasi Anushka jail se bahar aane ke baad un logon se kaise niptengi jinhe woh apna maanti thi? Is parivaar ki saazish kya hai aur Anushka khud ko is saazish se kaise bacha payengi? Arjun aur Anushka ki shaadi ka kya hoga aur Anushka itne saalon tak kya kehti rahi? title: PARAM SUNDARI
d: Muktanjali ek seedhi-saadhi college chhatra hai, jise hamesha uske roop-rang ke kaaran chidaaya jaata raha hai. Uske chehre ke muhaase, daag-dhabbe, chashma aur daanton par lage braces ka zikr parivaar aur sahpaathiyon ke beech lagaataar hota rehta hai, kyunki woh uska mazaak udaate rehte hain. d: Police se chhipne ke liye, Dakshin Bharat ke daakuon ke ek gang ki neta, Vijayata, apni hamshakal Kaadambari ka apaharan kar leti hai, jo sambhavit Miss India pratibhaagi hai. Haalaanki sabhi limelight ke saath, kya uska ateet use pareshan karne ke liye wapas aayega? Kya mashhoor hokar apni asli pehchaan ko khatre mein daal rahi thi Vijayata?

title: BACK FOR REVENGE
d: Apne mangetar aur apni sabse achhi dost se dhoka khaane aur marne ke liye chhod diye jaane ke baad, Poorva 10 saal pahle apne ateet mein wapis aa gayi hai badla lene ke liye. Lekin kya woh apni kismat badal payegi? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Nishat Iqbal.

title: EK STRANGER SE PYAR
d: Yeh kahani Suhani ki hai, jo 17 saal ki bhi poori nahi hui, uski aunty ne use ek 50 saal ke aadmi ko bech diya, phir woh kisi tarah se us boodhe aadmi se bachkar nikal gayi, boodhhe ne Suhani ke peeche kuch aadmi laga diye, unse bachne ke liye aisi jagah pahunch gayi, jahaan bahut saari shaadiyaan ho rahi thi. Unhi shaadiyaon mein se uski bhi shaadi ek ajnabi se ho jaati hai. Jo ek 24 saal ka billionaire hai. Us ajnabi ko kisi ki feelings se koi matlab nahi hota hai. Sirf woh apne aap se matlab rakhta hai. Woh ek heartless person hai. Kya Suhani is shaadi ko maanegi? Ya is shaadi ko bhool jaayegi, ek sapna samajhkar ya Ayaan bhi is shaadi ko bhool jaayega, kyunki uski nazron mein yeh ek drama tha. Ya Ayaan is shaadi ko kabhi samjhega? Jaanne ke liye suniye, 'Ek Stranger Se Pyar'

title: COMMANDER VIKRAM CHAUHAN
d: Yah kahani hai Vikram ki, ek sadharan se gaon ke ladke ki, jisne bachpan se hi desh ki vishesh sena mein commando banne ka sapna dekha tha. Lekin is sapne ko sakar karne ka safar aasan nahi tha. Apni pehli posting mein Vikram ko seema par tainaat kiya jata hai, jahan har kadam par use andhere mein chhipe ghatak aur khatarnak aatankwadi hamlon ka samna karna padta hai. Jaise-jaise uska safar aage badhta hai, Vikram ko aur bhi badi chunautiyon ka samna karna padta hai, jahan uska samna rashtriya khatron, sainya khufiya jaankari ke rahashyon aur desh ke bheetar chhipe gaddaron se hota hai. Ek mod par, Vikram khud ko aisi sthiti mein pata hai jahan use apne desh aur apne pyar ke beech chunav karna padta hai. Kya Vikram desh ki raksha ke liye apne vyaktigat aur peshewvar sangharshon se upar uth paega? Yah jaanne ke liye, in romanchak aur bhaavnatmak roop se aaveshit gupt missions ki kahani sunein, jinke baare mein aam logon ko koi jaankari nahi hai. Content team: Ritu Shri, Madhukar S

title: MY MYSTERIOUS PRINCESS
d: Yeh kahani hai Anamika ki, jisne Mehta parivaar mein 18 saal bitaaye, jahaan use abhishaap ki tarah maana jaata tha aur use kabhi pyaar, dekhbhaal ya sneha nahi mila. Lekin 18 saal ki umra mein use pata chala ki woh kabhi unki asli beti thi hi nahi! Yeh sochkar ki use kisi garib parivaar ke saath rehne ke liye bheja ja raha hai, Anamika ka desh ke sabse shaktishali aur pratishthit parivaar ki raajkumari ke roop mein swagat kiya gaya. Har koi use maasoom aur pyaari samajhta hai, lekin woh ek gupt pehchaan aur asaadhaaran pratibhaon ko chhupati hai, jo duniya se anjaan hain. Phir aata hai Devansh Singhania, ek nirmam CEO, jo usse beinteha pyaar kar baithta hai. Lekin kya hoga jab Anamika ki gupt pehchaan ujaagar ho jaayegi?

title: NAZAR KA KHEL

title: DONO MILE IS TARAH
d: Bachpan mein mata-pita ko khone aur pita dwara tyaag diye jaane ke baad, Veer Singh apne chacha aur chachera bhai ke saath apne gaon mein pale-badhe. Veer, jo ab ek rajnitik neta hain, Shruti se milte hain aur pehli hi nazar mein unse pyar kar baithte hain. Apne pita dwara tyaage jaane ke karan Veer kadwe swabhaav ke ho gaye hain aur unhe lagta hai ki we Shruti ke layak nahi hain. Veer aur Shruti ke bhavishy mein kya hoga? Kya we saath rahenge ya samay ke saath alag ho jaenge? Veer aur Shruti ki is romanchak kahani ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye 'Dono Mile Is Tarah' sunein. Show team: Rahul, Prakhar

title: LOVE ASHIQANA
d: Pyaar hamesha kisi ke prati aakarshit hone se shuru nahi hota. Aakarshak aur chulbuli Aashna ne kabhi sapne mein bhi nahi socha tha ki use ghamandi aur sankochi Arnav se pyaar ho jaayega. Aashna usse Rajasthan mein apni sabse achhi dost Meera ki shaadi mein mili thi. Lambi garmagaram bahas aur ek-doosre ko phir kabhi na dekhne ki qasam khaane ke baad, unki pehli mulaqat ek aapdaa mein badal gayi. Use kya pata tha ki woh antattah ghamandi aur pareshan karne waale Arnav ke pyaar mein pad jaayegi. Aashna Arnav ke liye apni bhaavnaon ko vyakt karne ki koshish karti hai lekin uski andekhi se uska dil toot jaata hai. Aage kya hoga? Kya Aashna Arnav ke liye apni bhaavnaon ko chhipaane ka faisla karegi? Kya Arnav bhi Aashna ke pyaar mein pad jaayega? Aashna aur Arnav ki is prem-ghrina ki kahani sunne ke liye Love Ashiqana mein tune karein, keval Pocket FM par. Show Team: Amit, Richa

title: HUKUM RANI SA

Uska ekmaatra sapna IAS banna tha, jiske liye woh din-raat mehnat kar rahi thi, lekin achanak ek raat ne uski zindagi puri tarah badal di aur uske sapne uski aankhon ke saamne chaknachoor ho gaye. Aur use bandook ki nok par ek aise aadmi se shaadi karni padi jo usse bahut bada tha, jiske baare mein naam ke alaawa kuch bhi pata nahi tha. Aakhir Nikita ko us aadmi se shaadi kyun karni padi? Majboori aur samajhaute par aadhaarit aise rishte ka kya bhavishy hoga? Ek ajnabi ke saath is nayi duniya mein Nikita ka safar kaisa hoga? Majboori aur samajhaute se bane rishte, jinmein soch aur umra jaisi kai dooriyaan hon, kya unme kabhi pyaar panap payega? Kya Nikita ke sapne phir se udaan bhar payenge ya woh khud is nayi duniya ke anaginat ansujhe rahasyaon mein uljh jaayegi? Nikita ek saadharan ladki se Hukum Rani Sa kaise banegi? title: WARRIOR CHEF

title: SHAADI KE BAAD

Arohi ke pita aur sauteli maa ne usse bina puchhe hi uski shaadi ek ameer lekin shaaririk roop se vikalang vyakti se tay kar di thi. Haalaanki Arohi ne usse shaadi karne se saaf inkaar kar diya tha, phir bhi uske pita aur sauteli maa ne ek aisi shart rakh di jisne Arohi ko apne faisle par sochne par majboor kar diya. title: KASAUTI RISHTON KI
d: Chhoti umra mein hi apne mata-pita ko kho dene ke baad, bechaari Swikruti ko zindagi mein pyaar ka anubhav karne ka saubhaagya nahi mila. Haalaat tab badal jaate hain jab woh Thakur Mahal pahunchti hai jahaan sab use Siddhi kehkar pukaarne lagte hain, jisse woh hairaan reh jaati hai. Baaki baaton ko chhodkar, Swikruti poore parivaar aur apne jeevan ke pyaar, Raghuvendra se sneha paakar khush hone lagti hai. Baad mein use pata chalta hai ki Raghuvendra Siddhi ka devar hai. Apne rishte mein in ulajhanon ki wajah se, Swikruti Raghuvendra ke kareeb aane se bachti hai. Siddhi kahaan hai? Kya hota hai jab Raghuvendra ko Swikruti ki sachaai ka pata chalta hai? Kya use Swikruti ke pyaar ka ehsaas hoga? Jab poore parivaar ko Swikruti ka asli chehra pata chalega toh unki kya pratikriya hogi? Adhik jaanne ke liye sune Kasauti Rishton Ki. title: THE WARRIOR
d: 'Kaali Pahadi' ek aisa sthan jisse jo bhi neeche girta hai, woh jeevit nahi bachta. Lekin ek 27 saal ka yoddha jiska naam hai Atharv Dev, uska peechha kar rahe hain duniya ke sabse khatarnaak dushman. Jinka maqsad hai us anmol khajaane ko paana, jise bachaana hai Atharv ka sabse bada kartavya. Aur use bachaane ke liye woh maut ki pahadi se neeche kood jaata hai, lekin marne ke bajaay woh doosri duniya mein Atharv Churu naam ke ek mrit ladke ke shareer mein punarjeevit ho jaata hai, jise uski shaadi ke din hi zeher dekar maut ke ghaat utaar diya gaya tha. Kya hai Atharv Dev se Atharv Churu bane is yoddha ki niyati? Aakhir, kya hai woh khajaana jiske liye Atharv Dev ko maut ko gale lagaana pada? Aur kyun diya gaya Atharv Churu ko uski shaadi ke din zeher? Kaun bun raha hai is romaanchak kahani ka khatarnaak taana-baana?

title: EKLAVYA

Us vyakti ka kya hua jisne mahanattam purush, Krishna ke viruddh hathiyaar uthaya... yeh jaane bina ki woh vastaav mein Krishna ka hi khoon hai, unka apna bhai hai! Yeh Eklavya ki katha hai, jise khud bhagwan Krishna ne sunayi thi.

title: RENTED ARMY
