Apni bucket list ke sabhi kaam poore kar lene ke baad, ab woh African savanna mein ek jaanwar ka shikaar karne ke liye puri tarah taiyaar hai. Lekin saavdhaan, Yuvraj! Shikaari se shikaar ki or rukh karne mein bas ek second lagta hai. Kya Yuvraj yeh sapna bhi poora kar payega? Ya goliyan hamesha uska peechha karti rahengi? Uski kahani jaanne ke liye dekhte rahiye, The Rented Army - Season 1. Show Team: Mithilesh, Hardik

title: EK AGENT EK HASEENA
d: Samar Pratap Singh, ek aakarshak aur garm swabhaav waala gupt agent, apni anichchhuk mangetar, ek sheersh company ki CEO Shalini se milne ke liye Mumbai lautta hai - kya prem uske pratirodh par vijay prapt karega, ya kya is tayshuddha vivaah ke peeche uska koi chhipa hua agenda hai?

title: DR. BODYGUARD
d: Lakshya, jo peshe se doctor banna chahta tha, niyati ne uske liye kuch aur hi soch rakha tha. Maa Durga ne use alaukik divya shaktiyon se yukt duniya ka sabse shaktishali purush bana diya tha. Kya us asadharan shakti se woh apna lakshya poora kar sakega? Show Team: Ratish Satish Mangalam, Riddhi Kotecha, Amar Pandey.

title: VICHITRA WORLD
d: DESCRIPTION NOT AVAILABLE

title: ASURA
d: 15 saal ka Darsh, jise hamesha se apne parivaar se beiizzat kiya gaya hai, lagaataar paanch saalon se martial arts ki pareeksha mein fail hokar apne parivaar ka naam roshan kar raha hai. Lekin phir ek raat kuch aisa hua, jiski wajah se Darsh ke andar ek bhayankar aur bada badlaav aaya. Us raat kya hua tha? Kya Darsh kabhi apne parivaar ka pyaar aur samman wapas pa payega? Baar-baar asafal hone ke baad, kya Darsh kabhi apne jeevan mein safalta haasil kar payega?

title: HUI TERI DEEWANI
d: Yeh kahani hai Mahika aur Major Ayan ki, us secret ladki ki jisne ek island uda diya! Mahika ko apni jaan bachane ke liye chhipna padta hai aur kismat use Major Ayan ke ghar le aati hai. Mahika ko Ayan se pehli nazar mein hi pyaar ho jaata hai. Lekin Ayan kisi bhi ladki ko apne aas-paas bhi bhatakne nahi deta. Is secret ladki aur Army Major ke rishte ka kya natija hoga? Aakhir Mahika ki jaan ke peeche kaun hai? Kya Ayan kabhi Mahika ka raaz jaan payega?

title: THODI DOSTI THODA PYAAR
d: Zindagi mein jitne bhi rishte hote hai chahe woh apne parivaar se ho, doston se ho ya phir aapka aapke pyaar se ho, sab rishte agar dil se banaaye jaate hain tabhi woh humse nibhaaye jaate hai. Yeh kahani bhi kuch aisi hi hai, jisme Ruhi aur Neil ne har rishte ko nibhaane ki poori koshish ki. College mein mile hue Ruhi aur Neil ko pata hi nahi chala ke zindagi kab unhe ek aise mod par le aayi jahan har rishte ki ek ehmiyat thi. Kya pyaar mein doobe Ruhi aur Neil baaki rishte ko bhi utni ehmiyat de payenge? Kya sab sambhaalne ka ye raasta inke pyaar ko phika kar degi ya aur mazboot bana degi? Jaanne ke liye suniye Ruhi aur Neil ki pyaar bhari kahani Thoda Pyaar Thoda Magic.

title: KISMAT CONNECTION
d: Kismat bhi kabhi-kabhi kuch ajeeb hi mod leti hai. Ye kahani hai Chahak aur Pulkit ke ajeeb kismat connection ki jahaan Chahak ek manmauji ladki hai toh Pulkit hamesha serious rehne waala ladka. Chahak Pulkit ki zindagi mein aati hai, toh Pulkit ko usse pyaar ho jaata hai. Lekin kuch majbooriyan unhe ek hone nahi hone deti hain. Phir poore 5 saal baad Pulkit ko Chahak hathkadi se jakde milti hai! Usp ar uske pati ke khoon ka ilzaam hai. Aisa kya hua Chahak ke saath jo woh Pulkit ko aise haal mein mili? Use dekhkar Pulkit ko uske saath bitaaye purane lamhe yaad aa jaate hain. Chahak ko bachane ke liye Pulkit poore samaaj se lad jaata hai aur pyaar ki paribhaasha hi badal deta hai! Kya is baar Pulkit aur Chahak ek ho payenge? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Chahak aur Pulkit ki anokhi prem kahani Kismat Connection

title: VASHIKARAN
d: Pali gaon ki sadiyon purani parampara ko todte hue, ek shaapit khanabadosh mahila ne 11 bacchon ko janam diya, jiske baad use jal samaadhi de di gayi. 25 saal baad, Dhruv, Ananya aur Vikki ne anjaane mein hi is jaadu ko tod diya. Phir kya hua? Jaanne ke liye sune Vashikaran

title: AGAR TUM SAATH HO
d: Ashwin ke dhoke ke baad, Ashwin ka bhai Dhruv Naina ki zindagi mein umeed ki kiran bankar aata hai. Kya yeh umeed Naina ki zindagi mein khushiyaan laayegi ya koi naya toofaan laayegi? Content/Creative Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Rashi Upadhyay

title: ZERO TO HERO
d: Kartik ki gareebi ke kaaran uske dost uska mazaak udaate hain aur uski girlfriend use apamaanit karti hai kyunki unhe is baat ka andaaza nahi hota ki Kartik ek ameer virasat ka waaris hai. Jab Kartik achanak arabpati ban jaata hai toh uski zindagi mein kya hoga? Show ki Team: Nidhi Agarwal (sah-lekhika), Mohit Sharma, Abhishek Tripathi

title: MALANG
d: Yeh kahani hai kruurta aur maasoomiyat ke beech pyaar ki. Mrityunjay Sarang, ek ghamandi, gussail lekin Bharat ka ek safal businessman. Wahin doosri taraf, Mahek Awasthi bhale hi parivaar aur rutbe mein chhoti ho, lekin uska dil itna bada hai ki woh use takleef dene walon ko bhi maaf kar deti hai. Yeh do alag-alag log bhai-behen ki wajah se mile aur yeh mulaaqaat shaadi mein badal gayi. Lekin is shaadi ki wajah thi Mrityunjay ka gussa aur Mahek se badla lene ki chaahat. Aakhir aisa kya hua jiski wajah se Mrityunjay Mahek se badla lena chahta tha? Rutbe aur izzat mein yakeen rakhne wale Mrityunjay ne ek saadhaaran ladki se shaadi kyun ki? Kya Mahek ka pyaar Mrityunjay ki nafrat mita payega? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye 'Malang'

title: HEART OF THE OCEAN
d: Kehte hain ki pyaar aur mohabbat chhipte nahi hain, lekin agar hum kisi se pyaar karte hain aur use bata nahi paate, toh kya koi love story apne anjaam tak pahunch payegi? Ya phir yeh ek bhayankar kismat ka roop le legi? Aisi hi kahani hai Aakanksha aur Shlok Agnihotri ki, ek aisi ladki jisne bahut kam umra mein ek accident mein apne parivaar waalon ko kho diya! Lekin phir bhi usne kabhi iska pachtawa nahi kiya aur hamesha un logon ki parwah ki jinhone use kabhi apna nahi samjha! Kya hoga agar jinse woh apni jaan se zyada pyaar karti hai, wahi use maarne ki koshish karein? Aur woh Aakanksha ko kyun maarna chahta hai? Kya Aakanksha uski buri saazish ka shikaar ho jaayegi ya koi naya mod aayega? Doosri taraf, Shlok Agnihotri ek mashhoor business tycoon hone ke saath-saath khatarnaak bhi hai, jo apni galti ke liye kisi ko maaf nahi karta, agar woh saza deta hai toh sirf maut ki! Lekin is khatarnaak dikhne waale insaan ko ek gambheer bimari hai jiske baare mein sirf Shlok aur uska dost jaante hai.

title: LOVE THERAPY
d: Olivia Colorado ki ek jaani-maani manochikitsak hain. Ek din, unki mulaqat ek safal vyavsayi Lucas se hoti hai, jo ek blind date par jaate hain. Aur phir, unke beech ek pechida rishta shuru hota hai.

title: MEERA KI JAADUYI KAHANI
d: Yeh kahani 18 varsheeya Meera ki hai, jiska jabran apaharan kar ek raja se vivaah kara diya jaata hai, kyunki use vardaan prapt hai ki woh apne pati ke saath sau varsh ka jeevan vyateet karegi. Bholi-bhaali Meera kis prakar apni ladaaiyaan ladkar badi-badi ladaaiyaan jeetegi, yahi is jaadui duniya mein raakshasaon, daanavon aur jaadoogaron ke beech ki kahani hai. Is romanchak fantasy drama ka aanand keval Pocket FM par lein. Show Team: Ratish Satish Marulkar, Riddhi Kotecha, Amar Pandey, Aakash Abhang

title: IFRIT KI MALLIKA
d: Ye kahani Bandipore ke bhootiya kothe mein ghaTi Laavanya aur Aayushman Ifrit aur Mallika ki dukhdayi prem kahani ke rahasya ko ujaagar karti hai, jahaan sadiyon pahle ek raat Mallika ke saath kothe ki baaki aath tawaaifen bhi gaayab ho gayi. Is rahasya ko jaanne ke liye suniye 'Ifrit Ki Mallika'

title: HOLD ME TIGHT
d: Akira, ek akeli maa jo apne bete Atharv ke liye bas achha hi chahti hai, ke liye zindagi ab tak aasaan nahi rahi hai. Akira khud nahi jaanti ki Atharv ke pita kaun hain. Woh akele hi apne bete ka palan-poshan kar rahi hai aur yeh sunishchit kar rahi hai ki uska beta kisi bhi cheez se vanchit na rahe. Haalaat tab aur bigad jaate hain jab Atharv bimaar pad jaata hai aur doctor Atharv ke mata-pita dono ke wahaan rehne par zor dete hain taaki woh ilaaj jaari rakh sakein. Aage kya hota hai? Akira Atharv ke pita ko kaise dhundhegi? Uske pita kaun hain? Usne unhe kyun chhod diya? Kya is baar uske pita wapas aayenge? Ek akeli maa ki kahani ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye Hold Me Tight keval Pocket FM par sune, jo apne bete ki raksha ke liye kisi bhi had tak ja sakti hai. Show Team: Mithilesh, Prakhar

title: JAILER 2.0
d: Bachpan ki ek dardnaak ghatna ke baad, Abir kamzori se zabardast taakat mein badal jaata hai. Desh ki rahasyamayi jail ki rakhwaali ka kaam saunpa gaya hai, jahaan ajeeb qaidi rehte hain, aur uski kahani control ke liye ek zabardast ladaai ke roop mein saamne aati hai. Jailer 2.0 ki romanchak kahani sune, jahaan Abir ko apratikshit cheezon ka saamna karna padta hai. Show Team: Veerendra Kushwaha

title: HIS SECRET FORTUNE
d: Shanaya Shah ki zindagi kabhi aasaan nahi rahi. Mata-pita ki maut ke baad woh apni behen ke ghar pali-badhi – jahaan pyaar se zyada use taanon ka sahara mila. Par jab uski maujoodgi ek bojh ban gayi, toh usne apne liye ek naya raasta chuna - shaadi ka. Ek seedhi-saadi mulaaqaat mein woh Vaibhav Rana se shaadi ke liye taiyaar ho jaati hai - ek aisa insaan jo baahar se sakht aur bhaavshoonya lagta hai, lekin andar kuch chhupa hua hai. Vaibhav, jo khud ek arabpati hai, apni asli pehchaan chhupa kar sirf ek baat jaanna chahta hai - kya koi ladki use uske paison ke bina bhi apnaayegi? Is anjaani shaadi mein Shanaya ko sirf ek surakshit chhat nahi, balki bahut se sawaalon, rahasyaron aur rishton ki girehein bhi milti hain. Kya Vaibhav ka sach kabhi saamne aayega? Kya Shanaya ka yeh faisla use barbaadi ki or le jaayega - ya ek nayi shuruaat ki or? Jaanne ke liye suniye, 'His Secret Fortune'

title: KAALBHAIRAVI
d: Alaukik shaktiyon se sampann ek yuvati aur uski mausi pitrisattaatmak dhaarnaaon aur prathaon ko chunauti deti hain, jiske parinaamaswaroop unke aas-paas ajeebogreeb aur rongte khade kar dene wali ghataanayein ghatit hoti hain. Rachanaatmak Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Chirag Kulshreshtha

title: ACCIDENTALLY YOURS
d: Paanch saal baad, Maahi apne desh wapis lautti. Uske andar badle ki aag abhi bhi shaant nahi hui thi. Woh apni shaitan behen ko barbaad kar dena chahti thi jisne Maahi se uske maa, baap aur uska pyaar bhi chheen liya tha. Maahi apne bachpan ke sapne ko poora kar ek safal actress banna chahti thi. Haalaanki, uski behen abhi bhi uske khilaf saazish kar rahi thi. Ek din, apni behen ke saazish mein phasne ke baad, woh ek bacche ko bachati hai. Kya us bacche se Maahi ka koi purana rishta hai? Kya Maahi ko apna khoya hua pyaar milega? Jaanne ke liye suniye, Raabta. Rishton ki ansujhi kahani

title: BHIMRAO RAMJI AMBEDKAR
d: 1891 mein ek achoot parivaar mein janme Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar ko Bharatiya Samvidhan ka janak kaha jaata hai. Saamaajik anyaay aur utpeedan ke viruddh Bharat ke mahanattam yoddha ki yeh jeevani sune. Ambedkar ki kahani aapko har mushkil ka saamna karne ke liye prerit karegi.

title: RICH DAD POOR DAD
d: Aaj ke daur mein har koi jald se jald ameer banna chahta hai, lekin kuch hi log jaante hain ki isme safal kaise hua jaaye. Aap paison ke peeche antaheen bhaagte reh sakte hain aur phir bhi manchaahi safalta haasil nahi kar payenge. Robert Kiyosaki ki is kitaab mein, un mantron ko jaanein jo aapko apne dam par ameer banne aur apne sapnon ko saakaar karne mein madad karenge. Lekhak ke shabdon mein, aap yeh samajhne lagenge ki aapko paise ke liye kaam nahi karna hai, balki apne paise ko apne liye kaam karne dena hai.

title: SUPER TREASURE BAG
d: Ek school shikshak ke roop mein Avin ek saadharan jeevan ji raha tha, tabhi achanak uske jeevan mein ek khazaana chhipa hua batua aa gira. Ek aisa batua jise woh phenk nahi sakta tha. Yeh batua Avin se apni sabhi icchaayein poori karne ko kehta hai, aur agar Avin aisa nahi karta hai, toh use durbhagya ka shraap lag jaayega. Ab Avin kya karega? Kya woh batue ki sabhi icchaayein poori kar payega? Agar nahi, toh uska kya hoga?

title: ALIEN VS WITCH
d: DESCRIPTION NOT AVAILABLE

title: LOVE YOU MY ANGEL
d: Yeh kahani hai 17 saal ki maasoom ladki Dhairya ki. Woh ek chhote se gaon mein rehti thi aur apni dost Jyoti se milne Dehradun aayi thi, lekin use nahi pata tha ki Jyoti, jise woh apni sachchi dost maanti thi, use sabse bada dhoka degi. Jab Dhairya ko pata chala ki woh kisi ke saath relationship mein nahi hai, toh woh pregnant ho gayi. Aate hi woh pregnant ho gayi, usi pal uske saare sapne toot gaye. Jab Dhairya ke mata-pita ko uski pregnancy ke baare mein pata chala, toh unhone bhi uska saath chhod diya. Jahaan ek taraf Dhairya mushkilon mein phasi hui thi, waheen doosri taraf Vayu vansh ka iklauta waaris, jiske paas duniya ko apne pairon par jhukane ki taaqat hai. Jab usne Dhairya ko pehli baar dekha, toh woh use apna banaane ki koshish karne laga. Tabhi ek bhayankar accident mein Vayu coma mein chala gaya. Kya Dhairya kabhi jaan payegi ki uske bacchon ka pita kaun hai? Kya Vayu Dhairya ko apnaayega jo bina shaadi ke maa ban gayi hai? Aakhir Dhairya aur uske bacchon ka Vayu vansh se kya rishta hai?

title: RAGHAV BAN GAYA GENTLEMAN
d: Jis din Raghav ko uske dadaji dwara kiye gaye waade se mukti mili, usi din se woh adhik aatmavishwaasi aur shaktishali banne laga. Woh apni patni Tanya ko har qadam par prabhavit karke uske kareeb aane laga. Tanya, us waade se anjaan, apne pati ke is naye vyaktitva ke prati aakarshit hone lagi, jise usne hamesha nazar andaaz kiya tha. Kya Tanya ko kabhi us waade ke baare mein pata chalega?

title: PAKIZA EK NAPAK ZINDAGI
d: Pakiza - ek napaak zindagi ki kahani hai. Ye kahani ek bahut hi khubsurat ladki ke ird-gird ghoomti hai. Jo dhoke ke kaaran veshyavritti mein aa jaati hai. Waqt ke saath-saath ladki anaginat musibaton mein phasti chali jaati hai. Uski madad karne waala har haath kaat diya jaata hai. Kya Pakiza dhoke aur fareb ke shikaar se kabhi bahar nikal payi? Suniye pyaar, ishq aur mohabbat ki daastaan. Lekhak - Sanjana Kirodiwalshaili

title: NOW YOU SEE MY LOVE
d: DESCRIPTION NOT AVAILABLE

title: JAAN TERE NAAM
d: Captain Angad Saxena Bharatiya sena ke ek wafadar adhikari hain, lekin un par deshdroh ka aarop lagta hai aur unhe seva se barkhast kar diya jata hai. Kisi ko nahi pata ki unhone jaanbujhkar deshdroh ka dosh apne upar liya tha. Aakhir kis wajah se unhone itna gambhir aarop sweekar kiya? Kya we apne mission mein safal honge? Prastutakarta: Drishti Nanavati aur Puneet Nayak

title: VIRASAT THE UNSEEN WAR
d: DESCRIPTION NOT AVAILABLE

title: IMPERFECT PYAAR
d: Talaak ke baad, Siddharth aur Anushka alag-alag raston par chalte hue ek baar phir milte hain. Yeh kahani do aise logon ki hai jo apne jeevan mein behad vyast hain, lekin peshewar taur par unke raaste baar-baar takraate rehte hain. Haalaanki Siddharth aage badh chuka hai, waheen Anushka ko apne poorv pati ko roz kisi aur mahila ke saath dekhna padta hai. Kahani is baare mein hai ki Anushka apne peshewar jeevan ke saath-saath apne niji jeevan ko kaise sambhaalti hai, jahaan uska ek baccha bhi hai jiske baare mein is duniya mein koi nahi jaanta. In sabhi uthal-puthal ke beech, ant mein use ek naya pyaar milta hai, jo use saari khushiyan deta hai.

title: SAMARLOK KA SOORMA
d: Saalon baad, Shlok apne ghar Samarlok lautta hai. Apni arjit shaktiyon aur bal se woh Soorma ki upaadhi prapt karta hai. Lekin jald hi, kuch aisa ghatit hota hai jo use Samarlok se door le jaata hai aur use shaktiheen aur kamzor bana deta hai. Kamzor Shlok ke saamne ek bada mission hai jiske liye use apni shaktiyan wapas haasil karni hain. Yeh bada mission kya hai? Kya Shlok kabhi apni shaktiyan aur bal wapas pa sakega aur khud ko Samarlok ka Soorma ki upaadhi ke yogya sabit kar payega?

title: REBIRTH OF DRAGON PRINCE VASU
d: Vasu, ek dragon rajkumar, ek naye sharir mein phir se janam leta hai, aur apni yaadon ke zariye use pata chalta hai ki uski saat mangetarein hain, jinmen se har ek alag-alag field mein expert hai aur bahut khubsurat hai. Vasu ki romanchak yatra ke baare mein jaanne ke liye, yah kahani sunein: REBIRTH OF DRAGON PRINCE VASU

title: TU MERA HERO NO. ZERO
d: Yeh Siddharth ki kahani hai, jo ek garib parivaar ka ladka hai aur abhi school mein padh raha hai, jise ek chhoti si galti ke liye maar diya jaata hai, lekin ek chamatkaar hota hai aur bhagwan use doosri zindagi dete hain.

title: TRAPPED IN VIDEO GAME
d: Lakshya ek video game ke antim boss ko haraakar Archmage ban jaata hai, lekin jald hi use pata chalta hai ki woh game ki jaadui duniya mein phans gaya hai. Creative Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Chirag Kulshreshtha.

title: THE CAT GIRL
d: Paanchvin shataabdi ke Bharat mein, Arkala naam ke nagar mein, ek ladki aur uski neeli aankhon waali jungali billi, mahilaon ke viruddh apraadh karne waalon ke liye jaalevaa khatara ban jaati hain. Rachanaatmak Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Chirag Kulshreshtha

title: CAPTAIN KARTIK
d: Captain Kartik ek vichitra prem kahani hai jo antariksh aur samay se pare hai. College mein Kartik ko Maya se pyaar ho jaata hai, jo ek ameer parivaar ki ladki hai. Maya ke mata-pita Kartik par ghaatak hamla karte hain jo us hamle se bach toh jaata hai, lekin use ek samaantar duniya mein le jaaya jaata hai. Kartik asaadharan shaktiyon ke saath Captain Kartik ban jaata hai lekin woh Maya ko kabhi bhi bhool nahi paata hai aur ant mein Kartik Maya ke liye pyaar ki ladaai chhedne ke liye Prithvi par ek captain ke roop mein lautta hai.

title: THE ROYAL BENGAL FAMILY
d: 10 saal ek veeran island par bitaane ke baad, jab Debina apne ghar lautti, toh usne paaya ki sab kuch badal chuka tha. Is saare hungaame ke beech, use apni maa ki maut ka sach pata lagaana tha.

title: VANSHAJ THE FINAL BATTLE
d: Jab shaahi saamraajya ke asli waaris Vyom ko janam se hi tyaag diya jaata hai aur pratadit kiya jaata hai, jabki ek dhokebaaz sinhaasna par raaj karta hai, toh maut ke kareeb pahunchne ke baad uski chhaati mein chhipa ek rahasyamay ratna jaagrit ho jaata hai. Apne parivaar ka badla lene, apna sahi sthaan wapas paane aur raakshasi buraai Andhakaaram ki waapsi ko rokne ke liye, Vyom ko ghaatak pareekshaon se bachna hoga, apratikshit gathbandhan banaane honge aur samay samaapt hone se pahle divya shaktiyon ko unlock karna hoga. Show ki Creative Team - Saurabh Yadav (Creative Director), Rajinder Singh Pular (Creative Producer)

title: AFLATOON DADDY
d: Shaktishali Isuri ka punarjanm hota hai. Is janam mein woh un bacchon se milta hai jinhe usne god liya hai. Is punarjanm aur in pyaare bacchon ka rahasya kya hai? Rachanaatmak Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora, Chirag Kulshreshtha

title: FALLING FOR THE BEAST
d: Nia ko hamesha se hi ek adventure bhari life aur romanch chahiye tha. Aur phir ek din uski yeh iccha poori hui jab woh pahadon se girkar ek aisi duniya mein pahunchi jahaan rehte the pashu-maanav! Bhediyaon ke jhund se Jeeraj ne bachaai iski jaan. Jeeraj jo aadha insaan aur aadha tendua tha. Toh kya ab woh banayega Nia ko apni rani? Aur kya Nia nikal payegi us duniya se? Jaanne ke liye suniye rahasyamayi duniya ki ek romanchakari kahani.

title: NARAKDOOT
d: Ek alaukik thriller, ek aise vyakti ke baare mein jo apni mrityu ke baad, Narakdoot ban jaata hai, ek mahashaktishali hatyaara. Tabhi use ek praacheen satya ka pata chalta hai, jiska agar pata chal jaaye, toh poori duniya tabaah ho jaayegi. Aur duniya ko bachane ke liye, use jaadoogar Master se ladna hoga, jo ek anokha khalnaayak hai!

title: APNA TIME AAYEGA
d: Jaakar apni pichhli galtiyan sudhaarne ka mauka de, toh kya hoga? Kya ho agar aapko apna ateet badlane ka mauka mile? Aadi ne kabhi sapne mein bhi nahi socha tha ki zindagi use ek aur mauka degi aur woh phir se 18 saal ka ho jaayega, un dinon ko phir se jeene ke liye. Aage Aadi ke saath kya hoga? Kya woh apni purani galtiyan sudharega? Ab uske liye kya hai? Aadi ka safar kaisa hota hai, yeh jaanne ke liye sune Apna Time Aayega

title: HUSBAND BY MISTAKE
d: Naina ko Dehradun ke sabse yogya kunwaare ladke Ishan Pratap Singh se pyaar ho jaata hai. Jab use pata chalta hai ki Ishan ki shaadi ho rahi hai, toh woh saazish rachti hai aur dulhan ki jagah mandap mein baith jaati hai. Lekin dulha Ishan nahi, balki uska bhai Yash Pratap Singh hota hai, jo Dehradun ka sabse khatarnaak aadmi hai. Is galatfahami bhari shaadi ka kya hoga? Naina ko kin chunautiyon ka saamna karna padega? Kya Naina aur Yash kabhi ek-doosre ko sweekar kar payenge?

title: MAHABALI MAYANK
d: Bihar ke ghane junggalon mein, asli Nalanda Vishwavidyalay sthit hai, jo yuddh kala aur jaadu ki ek gupt academy hai. Wahaan Gupt vansh ka ek vidrrohi yuvak Mayank adhyayan karta hai. Uske khoon mein duniya ko jeetne ki shakti daudti hai. Lekin ise saktiv karne ke liye, Mayank ko pahle anushaasan seekhna hoga. Amitav Mitra dwara prastut.

title: SUPER ARJUN
d: Super Arjun samay se pare, ek aisa super yoddha jisne logon par aane waali vipattiyon ko suljhaya magar aage chal kar uske saamne kuch aise rahasya bhi aaye jisme woh khud phasta chala gaya. Kya hua iske baad us yoddha ka, jaanne ke liye suniye Super Arjun

title: TERE ISHQ PAR JAAN KURBAAN
d: Karan aur Madhu ek doosre se anjaan the, par dono ko kya pata tha ki Mahadev ne unki zindagi ko ek doosre se jod diya hai. Kismat ke is khel mein kya milega, sunte rahiye Karan aur Madhu ke pyaar ki daastaan, aur jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Tere Ishq Par Jaan Qurbaan

title: KAISA YEH ISHQ HAIN
d: Sanjay Mittal, shahar ke mashhoor kaarobaari. Achanak ek din unki zindagi mein ek nanhi bacchi aayi aur unhe apna pita kehne lagi. Lekin Sanjay ne aaj tak kisi ladki ko chhhua tak nahi, toh woh kisi ke pita kaise ho sakte hain? DNA report bhi saabith kar rahi thi ki wahi uske iklaute pita hain. Toh aakhir woh nanhi bacchi kaun thi? Uski maa kaun thi? Ye sab jaanne ke liye suniye 'Kaisa Ye Ishq Hai.' Show Team: Mithilesh, Hardik

title: JAANBAAZ
d: Kahani Kanpur se shuru hoti hai jab college student Rohit ko apni classmate Siya se pyaar ho jaata hai. Haalaat tab badal jaate hain jab Rohit Siya se apne pyaar ka izhaar karta hai aur ilaake ke kuch gundaon ko yeh raas nahi aata. Haalaat bad se badtar hote jaate hain aur gundaon ke ek girroh dwara Rohit ki hatya kar di jaati hai. Lagta hai zindagi ne uske liye kuch aur hi soch rakha tha. Uski aatma Thailand ke mashoor yoddha Maurya ke shareer mein pravesh karti hai, jise bhi uske dushmanon ne dhoka dekar maar daala tha. Rohit ab na sirf apne saath hue haadse ke liye, balki Maurya ke liye bhi insaaf chahta hai. Kya Rohit apne maqsad mein kaamyaab hoga? Kya Siya ab uske pyaar ko sweekar karegi? Maurya ke roop mein Rohit ke liye kya hai? Jaanne ke liye dekhte rahiye Jaanbaaz sirf Pocket FM par. Show Team - Indrajeet Kumar, Prakhar Gupta.

title: RAINA EK MOHJAAL
d: Kahani Raina ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jo ek daayan hai aur jise uski naani Maaga ne apni beti ke hataare se badla lene ke liye chuna hai. Raina ke jeevan mein tab mod aata hai jab woh ek insaan ki tarah jeene ka faisla karti hai. Uski daadi, Maaga, isse khush nahi hoti aur Raina ki zindagi mein dakhal dene lagti hain. Iske baad jo hota hai, woh Raina ko andar tak jhakjhod deta hai. Kuch hi samay mein, uska apna baccha apne pita yaani Raina ke pati Veer ke liye khatara banne lagta hai. Raina ke liye aage kya hone waala hai? Woh kya karegi? Woh apne pati ko apne bacche se kaise bachayegi? Kya Maaga yaheen ruk jaayegi? Aur jaanne ke liye 'Raina' sune.

title: SAAJAN EK SACCHA SAATHI
d: Ananya apni zindagi ko zindaadili se jeene waali ladki hai jiske jeevan mein sangharsh ki kami nahi thi par woh apna dard dil mein chhupa kar sabmein khushiyan baanti hai. Mohabbat ke liye uski duniya mein koi jagah nahi thi. Doosri taraf hai Rudra, ek khushmizaaj hasmuukh ladka, jo Ananya ki zindagi mein pyaar lekar aata hai aur uski duniya badal deta hai, uski zindagi ban jaata hai. Kya hota hai jab Ananya apni zindagi apne pyaar ke saath sangharshaon ka saamna karti hai? Kya Ananya ke sangharsh uske pyaar ki pareeksha lete hai? Kya Rudra ka pyaar uski taaqat banta hai ya kamzori? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Saajan Ek Sachcha Saathi sirf aur sirf aapke apne

title: MASEEHA DOCTOR
d: Udaipur mein ek yuva Bhrigu rehta hai, jisne Ayurvedic samgra chikitsa ki praacheen takneek seekhi hai, lekin kya yeh uske ateet ke zakhmon ko bharne mein uski madad kar payega? Creative Team - Sanel Indu Kapoor, Chirag Kulshreshtha

title: RAANJHANAA
d: Sach hi kaha gaya hai ki log yun hi nahi milte, woh kisi na kisi wajah se aapke raaste mein aa hi jaate hain. Sarika ko achhi tarah yaad hai ki kaise Banaras mein Shiva naam ke ek ladke ne uski jaan bachaai thi, maano kal ki hi baat ho. 14 saal baad bhi Sarika ko lagta hai ki us din usne Banaras mein apna ek hissa chhod diya tha aur itne saalon baad woh Shiva se milne ka faisla karti hai. Kya hota hai jab Sarika Shiva se milne Banaras jaati hai? Kya un dono ke beech pyaar panpata hai ya Shiva ki zindagi mein ab koi aur hai? Sarika aur Shiva ki prem kahani, Raanjhanaa.

title: ROCK & ROLL
d: Swara ka Bollywood singer ke taur par safal career ek khubsurat musical tone se shuru hua tha. Us khaas tone ne Swara ko industry mein ek bada naam banne ke liye inspire kiya. Saalon baad aaj bhi, Swara us tone ko dhundh rahi hai, apni prerna ko jisne use gaane ke liye majboor kiya. Tabhi woh Tanmay se milti hai, jo ek blind music director hai aur use lagta hai ki woh ek alag level par connected hain. Kya Tanmay hi woh prerna hai jise Swara dhundh rahi hai? Swara aur Tanmay ke liye aage kya hone waala hai? Jaanne ke liye Rock & Roll. Show Team: Amit, Prakhar

title: QURBAAN HUA
d: Nirvaana, ek MMA fighter, apne parivaar ke vishwaasghaat bartaav ke kaaran sab kuch kho deta hai. Shri Kotnis uske rakshak bankar aate hain, lekin jald hi unka nidhan ho jaata hai aur Nirvaana par ek aajeevan zimmedaari aa padti hai - unki poti, Laavanya Kotnis. Kya Nirvaana apni zimmedaari ko puri tarah nibhaa payega ya uska ateet use sataane ke liye wapas aayega?

title: LOVE DIARY
d: Uski diary ke panne kehte hain; khubsurat aur maasoom si Palak ek chaand thi; aur Mukul ek maamooli sa chakor tha. Woh dono saath rehte the, ek bistar par sote the, ek-doosre ki care karte the - magar phir bhi ek nahi ho pa rahe the. Pyaar mein kai kahaaniyan, hum itni baar sun chuke hote hain jinki hame aadat si ho jaati hai, ye kahani bhi kuch aisi hi hai, pyaar ki tadap apne andar samete ek prem kahani hai Love Diary - jo aapko aadi se ant tak bechain karke rakhegi. Prakaashak - Dheeraj Pocket Books. Lekhak - Dheeraj Pocket Books

title: ZOMBIE KAAL
d: Isse pahle ki zombie ka prakop poori duniya par haavi ho jaaye, ek anath Mohan ko manavta ko poorn vinaash se bachaane ke liye asaadharan shaktiyan prapt karni hongi.

title: FAKE GIRLFRIEND
d: Singhania Textiles ke iklaute waaris, Arav, apne baare mein faili anginat afwaahon ke karan hamesha charcha mein rahe hain. Ek aam din ki tarah, Arav ek hotel gaye, lekin uske baad jo hua, usne unki zindagi badal di. Unhone wahan maujood gaayika Heer ko kiss kiya aur unki is harkat ne agle hi din surkiyaan bator lin. Apne parivar aur samaj ke samne apni chhabi bachane ke liye, Arav ne ghoshna ki ki Heer unki premika hai. Arav ke pita apne bete ko achchi tarah jaante hain aur sachhais jaanne ke liye Heer ko ek parivarik samaroh mein aamantrit karte hain. Aage kya hoga? Ab Arav kya karenge? Heer aur Arav ke liye aage kya hone wala hai? Yah jaanne ke liye 'Fake Girlfriend' dekhein. Show team: Amit Singh, Richa

title: VEERAAN GADH
d: Veeraan-Gadh, ek shaapit gaon, jahaan varshon se band pade preetvadhit haveli ke darwaaze khulne par ek baar phir maut ka saaya mandara raha hai. Prabhat aur Neelam Bhardwaj, jo Veeraan-Gadh se sati zameen par ek kaarkhana shuru karne ke liye wahaan aate hain, rahasyamay tarike se wahaan ki ek preetvadhit haveli mein gaayab ho jaate hain. Unka iklauta beta Siddharth unki talaash mein Veeraan-Gadh pahunchta hai, lekin wahaan pahunchkar Siddharth bhi apni jaan jokhim mein daal leta hai. Veeraan-Gadh ek aisa bhayankar gaon hai jahaan jo bhi jaata hai, wapas nahi laut paata. Us haveli mein anaginat ansujhe rahasya hain. Siddharth qasam khaata hai ki woh na sirf apne mata-pita ke gaayab hone ka rahasya suljhayega, balki graamiinon ko us purane abhishaap aur buri shaktiyon se bhi mukt karega. Lekin us haveli ke rahasyaon se judi paheliyon ko suljhaye bina us haveli ke saikdon darwaaze kholna asambhav tha. Toh kya Siddharth un buri shaktiyon se lad payega? Jaanne ke liye Veeraan-Gadh sune. Show Team - Saurabh Chatterjee, Kamala Kuniyal

title: PSYCHO SAIYYAN
d: Shekhawat parivaar mein ek dusht aadmi Samar ghar jamaai bankar rehta hai, aur apni khoyi hui jaadui shaktiyon ko wapas paane ki koshish mein ajeebogreeb paristhitiyon mein phans jaata hai! Content/Creative Team - Sanel Kapoor Arora

title: UNEXPECTED TRUE LOVE
d: Yeh ek ghamandi CEO aur ek asaadhaaran ladki ki kahani nahi hai. Woh dono bahut saari bhaavnaon wale saadharan insaan hain. Apni supermodel patni Reva se dhoka khakar Abeer Malhotra ek berahm CEO ban gaye, doosri taraf Dhwani ek bahut hi pyaari aur swatantra ladki thi. Woh apne parivaar ka samarthan karne ke liye Abeer ke bete Armaan ki daai ban jaati hai lekin Armaan ke sneha ke kaaran use wahin rehna padta hai. Abeer, jo mahilaon se nafrat karta hai, usse bhi nafrat karta hai, lekin uska beta jo kabhi bhi apni maa ka pyaar nahi pa saka hai, woh kuch hi samay mein Dhwani se judaav mehsoos karne lagta hai. Apne bete Armaan ki khushi ke liye, Abeer Dhwani ke saath ek anubandh vivaah karta hai. Pyaar mein dhoka kha chuka Abeer dheere-dheere Dhwani ki saadgi par fida hone lagta hai. Woh uska pyaar paane ki poori koshish karta hai, Dhwani bhi usse bahut pyaar karti hai lekin woh hamesha usse doori banaye rakhti hai kyunki uska ek ateet hai, ek aisa ateet jo ek baar saamne aane ke baad sab kuch barbaad kar dega, isliye woh Abeer se door rehne ki koshish karti hai.

title: SHART PYAAR KI
d: Apne damankaari jeevan se mukti paane ke liye betaab Gauri, shaktishali Rudra se anubandh vivaah ka prastaav rakhti hai, taaki woh saamaajik maandandon ko chunauti dete hue aur apni aantarik shakti ko khojte hue swatantrata prapt kar sake. Show Team: Riddhi Kotecha, Amar Pandey

title: KASHMAKASH
d: Jeevan ki raahon mein sada 'Kashmakash' rehti hai, magar ise jo paar kar le unhe unka manzil milna nischit hain. Aise hi ek kahani hai, Sharanya ki. Jo ki ek samajhdaar aur sulajhi hui ladki hain. Aisi ladki jo sab par bharosa aur sabse pyaar karna jaanti hai. Lekin uske jeevan mein kuch aisa hua ki 2 saal tak use apne hi parivaar se door rehna pada. Apne maan-baap ko khone ke baad apne chhote bhai bahan ka woh ek maatr sahara thi. Apnon ke dhokhe ne use andar se jhanjhod kar rakh diya. Dhoka aur fareb se uska sab kuch chheen liya gaya tha. Aise mein ab woh kisi aur par bharosa nahi kar pa rahi thi. Aur jab woh apnon ke beech aayi toh khud ko akele hi paya. Tabhi uske zindagi mein ek farishta jo ek umeed ki kiran aur ek bharosemand saathi ban kar aaya. Lekin jiski pehchaan woh kabhi jaan hi nahi payi. Aakhir aisa kya hua tha Sharanya ke ateet mein? Aisa kaun sa dhoka tha jisne Sharanya ki poori zindagi badal di? Aur kaun tha yeh anjaan shakhs jo andhere mein roshni ban kar aaya tha? Koi dost ya phir dost ke bhes mein koi naya dushman?

title: DURGA EK AAM LADKI KI KHAAS KAHANI
d: Ek aam 18 saal ki ladki ko pata chalta hai ki use duniya ko ek bure dushman se bachaane ke liye chuna gaya hai. Apni anokhi yatra ke raaste par chalte hue, use ek aise aadmi se pyaar ho jaata hai, jiske baare mein use pata nahi hota ki woh buri duniya se hai aur uska maqsad use apna bada lakshya haasil karne se rokna hai.

title: ISHQ EK DEAL
d: Yeh kahani hai Aadhya aur Dev Oberoi ki. Dev Oberoi ek ghamandi aur khud ke baare mein ekmaatra vicharak hain, jo unchaaiyaon tak pahunchne ke liye kuch bhi kar sakte hain. Dev uski ek qeemati deal haasil karne ke liye Aadhya ko apne jaal mein phasaata hai. Aadhya aur Anya judwaan behnen hain jo sirf 21 saal ki hain. Aur Aadhya ek saadharan jeevan jeene waali ladki hai, lekin use Dev Oberoi ke jaal mein uski hi behen Anya ne phasa liya hai, jise Aadhya Dev se shaadi karne ke liye majboor kiya jaata hai. Anya ne apni hi behen ke saath kya kiya, jisne use Aadhya Dev se shaadi karne ke liye majboor kiya? Aur Dev ke paas aisi kaun si anmol deal hai jiske liye unhone Aadhya se shaadi karne ka faisla kiya hai, jabki Dev Oberoi ka pyaar se koi lena-dena nahi hai. Toh is deal se shaadi ka kya hoga aur kya Dev ka sach kabhi Aadhya ke saamne aayega? Ya phir woh in baaton se anjaan rehgi? Kya Dev kabhi Aadhya se pyaar kar payega ya phir woh sirf apne saude ke liye Aadhya ka istemal karega?

title: VIRAT EK KARMYODDHA
d: Jis din Virat Singh Raizaada sena mein bharti hone waale the, usi din unke aadhe se zyada parivaar ki berahmi se hatya kar di gayi aur woh apang ho gaye. Is ghatna ke baad, Bharatiya sena ne unhe sena mein bharti karne se inkaar kar diya aur unki mangetar bhi unhe chhodkar chali gayi. Pal jhapakte hi Virat ne apna sab kuch kho diya. Virat ke paas aisi kaun si cheez thi, jise paane ke liye gundaon ne unke saath itni krurata ki? Kya Virat apne saath hue anyaay ka badla lega?

title: NAAGIN
d: Kauravi aur Yagya bas ek-doosre se shaadi karke hamesha khush rehna chahte the, lekin zindagi ne unke liye kuch aur hi soch rakha tha. Naagmani paane ke liye Shivay ne Yagya aur uske parivaar ko maar daala. Ab badla lene ki chaahat rakhne waali Kauravi Shivay aur uske parivaar ko khatam karna chahti hai. Woh Shivay ko maarne ke liye icchadhaari naagin bankar lauti hai, lekin jab uske man mein Shivay ke liye bhaavnaayen panpne lagti hain, toh kya hota hai? Kauravi kya karegi? Kya woh Shivay ko maar daalegi ya usse pyaar karne lagegi? Aur jaanne ke liye 'Naagin' dekhein. Show ki Team: Dimpy, Hardik

title: KHATRE AUR EK KHILADI
d: Raj, ek aam kishor, boarding school mein padhta hai, lekin usse ek aisi galti ho jati hai ki use school se bhagkar jungle mein jana padta hai. Jungle mein use ek anjaan yantra milta hai jo use ek jadui duniya mein le jata hai. Kya Raj ab is jadui duniya ka istemal karega ya kuch khataron ka samna karega?

title: JAB DEY MET
d: Nisha 'Dey' aur Aakash 'Dey' mein sirf teen baatein samaan thin - ek hi upanam, kaala ateet aur dono ek-doosre ke prati jununi the. Baaki sab kuch alag tha. Unhe pata bhi nahi chala ki kab unki pehli mulaqat ek pal mein shaadi mein badal gayi. Yeh do ajnabiyon ki ek anokhi prem kahani hai, jo jeevan ke path par chalte hue ek-doosre ki parwah karne lagte hain aur pyaar karne lagte hain. Team dikhaayein: Ratish Satish Mangalam, Riddhi Kotecha, Shruti Shrivastava, Bidyashish Sarangi.

title: MAI BANUNGA CROREPATI
d: Sunny ek garib aur anath ladka hai jo ek bahut hi mahangi college mein padhta hai... Sunny ke dost hamesha uski gareebi ka mazaak udaate hain... lekin phir ek din uski zindagi mein ek rahasyamayi ladki ki entry hoti hai... aur phir achanak Sunny ki zindagi badal jaati hai... jab woh college mein mahangi gaadi se utarta hai toh use dekhkar sab hairaan reh jaate hain... woh raaton-raat itna ameer ban jaata hai ki pal bhar mein kuch bhi khareed sakta hai... lekin phir woh rahasyamayi ladki Sunny ke saamne ek aisi shart rakh deti hai, jise sunkar Sunny ke hosh ud jaate hain. Kaun thi woh rahasyamayi ladki aur kya thi uski shart jisne Sunny ki zindagi mein toofan la diya..?

title: BEAUTIFUL BETRAYAL
d: Apni shaadi ki pehli saalgirah par, Meera ko apne pati Rishi se talaak ke kaagzaat upahaar mein mile, aur iska kaaran Meera ki apni behen Tanu thi, jo Rishi ke bachche ki garbhavati thi. Is dhokhe se Meera ko itna gehra sadma laga ki woh 5 saal ke liye gaayab ho gayi, aur jab lautti toh Rishi ke jeevan mein ek saadhaaran mahila ke roop mein nahi, balki duniya ki sabse badi wakilon mein se ek ke roop mein lautti. Kya Meera badla lene ke liye lautti thi? Ya koi aisa gehra rahasya tha jisne Meera ko wapas laautne par majboor kiya?

title: SOLDIER ON TIME
d: Yeh kahani hai Major Aarav, jo Army ke sabse kaabil officer hain, aur Jaipur ki chhoti raajkumari Shreya ki. Jahaan dono ki priorities alag-alag hain, ek ne desh ko chuna aur doosre ne parivaar ko? Kya bina taalmel ke rishte mein unki aatmaayein ek ho payengi?

title: ADHURI MOHABBAT
d: Tanya ke jeevan mein kismat ka bahut bada khel chal raha tha. Usne apna pyaar kho diya aur is sadme se uski yaaddaasht chali gayi. Lekin ek car durghatna ne sab kuch badal diya. Uski yaaddaasht wapas aa gayi. Ab woh chhe saal pahle khoyi hui har cheez ko wapas paana chahti thi. Woh apna sab kuch, apni daulat aur apni pehchaan wapas paana chahti thi. Kya Tanya safal hogi? Yeh kahani hai Tanya ki, jo apne ateet aur vartamaan ke beech sangharsh mein phasi hui hai. Adhuri Mohabbat. Show Team: Mithilesh, Prakhar

title: PAKHI EK PYAAR KI PANCHI
d: Yeh kahani ek aisi ladki ki hai jisne tamaam mushkilon se ladte hue apni saari khwaahishein poori kin. In khwaahishon ko poora karne mein Pakhi ki maa ne uska saath diya. Kya hoga jab Pakhi ka pyaar ladaai aur nafrat se shuru hoga? Kaun Pakhi ke dil ko samjhega aur use bepanaah pyaar karega? Kya Pakhi apna sachcha pyaar pa payegi? Kaisa hoga Pakhi ka pyaar? Kya woh ladka Pakhi ke sapne poore karne mein madad karega? Twist, pyaar, suspense aur drama se bharpur is kahani ko jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Pakhi: Ek Pyaar Ki Panchi

title: ROCKY THE COMMITTED CRIMINAL
d: Daniel Joseph, jo din mein patrakar hai, raat mein sheher ki andhere galiyon mein Rocky ke naam se jaana jata hai. Usne shahi parivar ki beti Ketaki Mehta se shaadi karke apni ameeri bhari zindagi ko aur bhi khushhal bana liya. Ketaki usse 15 saal badi hai aur Daniel ke kaale karnaamon se bilkul anjaan hai. Daniel ne patrakarita kyun chuni, jabki wah underworld mein qadam rakhna chahta tha? Daniel ka raaz sabke samne aane par kya hoga? Yah jaanne ke liye 'Rocky - The Committed Criminal' sunein. Show team: Simran, Hardik

title: RUH SE RUH TAK
d: Ek chhote se shahar ka seedha-saadha sa ladka university mein aata hai aur uski chakaachaudh mein kho jaata hai. Pehle hi din uski mulaqat hoti hai Ranveer se - university ka sabse ruaabdaar ladka. Dono dosti se kuch aage badhkar ek-doosre ko bhai samajhne lagte hai. Isi beech Neil ko pyaar ho jaata hai - sachcha pyaar, Aditi se. Pyaar Ranbir ko bhi hota hai - Riya se, lekin ektarfa pyaar. Paristhitiyan kuch yun karwat leti hain ki Riya aatmahatya kar leti hai aur jaane se pahle apni hatya ka ilzaam laga jaati hai Neil par. Kya Neil Ranbir ko apne begaanah hone ka yakeen dilwaa paata hai? Kya hota hai jab aapka sabse achha dost aapka sabse bada dushman ban jaata hai?

title: THE RETURN OF TIGER
d: Dil tootne ke baad, Abhinav naam ke ek saadharan delivery boy ka saamna ek badi sachaai se hota hai: woh koi aam aadmi nahi, balki ek ameer don aur underworld ke bejod baadshah Tiger ka beta hai. Uska lakshya apne pita ke hataare ka khaatma karna aur unki aatma ko shaanti pradaan karna hai. Haalaanki, is kaam ko poora karne ke liye, use apni asli pehchaan chhipaani hogi aur ek naya vyaktitva banana hoga. Show Team - Riddhi Kotecha-Menon, Swapnil Jain

title: JAB RAJAT MET VAANI
d: Painter Vaani ko uske premee Dev ne dhoka diya hai. Anath hone ke kaaran, woh pyaar aur sneha ke liye Dev ki or dekhti thi. Uski sabse achhi dost Ruchi ab Vaani ko apne bhai Rajat se milaane ke liye taiyaar hai. Lekin jaise-jaise woh pyaar mein padne lagte hain, Vaani ki pehchaan kai logon ko hairaan kar deti hai. Woh ek gupt rahasya hai. Kya Rajat aur Vaani sachaai ko pakad payenge? Jaanne ke liye sune 'Jab Rajat Met Vaani'

title: DEVPUTRA RANVEER
d: Ranveer ke pita achanak use apne paitrik sthaan Rajgir bula lete hain. Rajgir ek aisi jagah hai jahaan ek aam insaan nahi pahunch sakta. Haalaanki, jab Ranveer wahaan pahunchta hai, toh use apne baare mein ek ajeebogreeb baat pata chalti hai. Ranveer mein aisa kya ajeeb hai? Uske pita ne use itne saalon baad achanak Rajgir kyun bulaya? Ranveer ki aam zindagi kaise ek kalpanic duniya mein badal jaati hai, yeh jaanne ke liye hamare saath bane rahein.

title: LOVE HATE MARRIAGE
d: Ye kahani hai Chaahat aur Rohan ki. Chaahat jo ki swabhaav se bahut chulbuli aur apni zindagi apni sharton par jeene waali hai, wahi doosri taraf hai dashing ameer businessman Rohan Kapoor hai, apne power ke dam se woh har kisi par apna sikka chalaata hai. Ladkiyon ki toh jaise Rohan ki zindagi mein koi value hi nahi hai. Rohan aur Chaahat ki pehli mulaqat mein hi kuch aisa hota hai jiske kaaran dono ko ho jaati hai ek doosre se bepanaah nafrat. Kya hoga jab do alag soch rakhne waale ajnabi takraayenge ek doosre se? Kya wajah rahi jo dono ek doosre se pehli hi mulaqat mein nafrat karne waale bandh gaye shaadi ke atoot bandhan mein? Aisa kya hua tha unki pehli mulaqat par jisse dono bepanaah nafrat karne lage the ek doosre se? Kya ye bepanaah nafrat, bepanaah pyaar mein badal payegi?

title: FORCED WIFE
d: Ansh Singh Raijada, ek behad ghamandi aur asabhy business tycoon aur mafia king hai, yahaan tak ki uske parivaar ke sadasya bhi uske baare mein baat karne se darte hain... lekin jab maasoom Sona, Ansh ko bhare baazaar mein thappad maar deti hai, toh Ansh apamaan bardasht nahi kar paata, woh Sona se uski shaadi ke din jabran shaadi karke aur uske andhere ateet ke baare mein jaane bina use apni majboor patni banakar badla leta hai.

title: FARZIBAAZ
d: Vicky Bahl ki zindagi us samay utaar-chadhav bhari ho jaati hai jab 17 saal ki umra mein woh ek boarding school mein jaata hai. Uske chacha Rocky, jo us par gehra prabhav daalte hain, apne kishor bhaanje Vicky ko juye, money laundering aur gang mafia yuddhaon ki duniya se achanak parichit kara dete hain. Kam umra mein hi Vicky ek bada scam artist ban jaata hai, lekin jald hi use sachche pyaar aur apraadh ki zindagi ke beech chunaav karna padta hai.

title: THE PROPOSAL
d: Veena ko hai ek nayi naukri ki talaash, aakhir uski jeb jo ho rahi hai khaali. Ghar ka rent aur doosre kharche utha na pa rahi ab Veena bechaari. Apne parivaar se alag hone ke baad Veena ka nahi hai koi apna, aakhir kaise poora karegi Vani apne life ka har sapna. Ek din achanak Veena ki zindagi mein super rich Yaami Jindal ne diya dakhal, lekin Yaami ki shart hai ki Veena ko karni padegi Yaami ki ditto naqal. Is ajab-gajab demand ko kya poora kar payegi Veena? Ya mushkil hoga Veena ko apni life mein jeena.

title: PHIR KAB MILENGE HUM
d: Sabhi prem kahaniyan aur...'we hamesha khushi se rahe' ke saath samapt nahi hotin. Pooja ke liye yah maanna mushkil tha ki uska bina shart pyar Rishi ke liye kuch bhi mayne nahi rakhta. Bechare Rishi ne maafi maangne ki koshish to ki, lekin kabhi-kabhi cheezon ko theek karne ke liye 'sorry' se kahin zyaada ki zaroorat hoti hai. Rishi ne kya kiya? Pooja kyun pareshan hai? Aage kya hoga? Unki prem kahani ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye 'PHIR KAB MILENGE HUM' sunein.

title: JO JEETA WAHI SIKANDAR
d: Daakuon ke hamle mein apne parivaar ko khone ke baad, Karan ko divya lok pareeksha mein bheja jaata hai, lekin uski mrityu ho jaati hai. Karan ki aatma Shaurya ke shareer mein ek nayi duniya mein punrjanm leti hai, jahaan Shaurya ko sabse shaktishali yoddha banna hoga aur ek praacheen aur khatarnak rahasyamayi duniya, Gyanganj ki raksha un logon se karni hogi jo use nasht karna chahte hain. Kya Shaurya apne parivaar ka badla le payega? Woh Gyanganj ki duniya ko kaise bachayega?

title: CODE NAME BOSS
d: Yeh kahani Lucknow nivaasi Rocky ki hai. Uske mata-pita ne uska naam Rocky rakha tha, lekin woh sirf ek naam nahi, balki karmatha vyakti tha. Uske paas na toh dhan tha aur na hi samman. Jis raat usne apni premika ko kisi aur ki baahon mein dekha, usi raat uski zindagi ne ek naya mod le liya. Laal rang mein likhi uski kismat ne use raaton-raat ek kangal se paatal lok ka baadshah bana diya. Toh Rocky ke saath aakhir kya hua? Woh paatal lok ka aghoshit baadshah kaise ban gaya?

title: SIYASAT HUKUM SA KI
d: Adranksh Singh Sherawat jiske naam se aadhi duniya kaanpti thi. Business ki duniya ka betaaj baadshah. Agar inhe ek baar jo pasand aa jaaye toh woh kisi bhi qeemat par haasil karta hai. Waheen doosri taraf hai hamaari chanchal Kamakshi jo Ganga kinaare Sangam nagari mein pali-badhi. Par wahi Adranksh ek badle ki wajah se poore samaaj ke saamne Kamakshi se jabardasti shaadi kar use zillat sahne ke liye chhod deta hai. Use ek nazar bhi nahi dekhta tha. 2 saal baad jab Adranksh Kamakshi ka aamna saamna hota hai toh Adranksh Kamakshi ki khubsurti ka deewana ho jaata hai. Aur use har qeemat par apna banaane ki thaan leta hai. Par kaun hai Kamakshi? Aakhir kis badle ki wajah se Adranksh ne Kamakshi se shaadi kar use chhod diya tha? Jaane 'Siyasat Hukum Sa Ki.'

title: SANAK
d: Kya hota hai jab ek aam din superpower jaagne ka din ban jaata hai? Aur yeh badlati duniya dharti par kya badlaav laayegi? Yeh jaanne ke liye SANAK sune.

title: ACTION ARYAN

d: Dev, jise bachpan se hi tiraskar mila, Aalok Math mein jaakar apne sangharshon ke dam par sarvashaktimaan banta hai. Kathin chunautiyon ko paar karte hue woh apni ek alag pehchaan banata hai.

Lekin kya uska sapna poora hoga aur is rahasyamayi shakti ka raaz kya hai? Team - Aditya Sinha aur Saurav Chatterjee.

d: Anahita ek gupt sena agent hai, shaant swabhaav ki lekin sherni se kam nahi, jise apne hi parivaar se badla lena hai kyunki unhone usse sab kuch chheen liya hai. Doosri taraf, Parth ek khushmizaaj insaan hai jise apne desh se apaar prem hai. Anahita se milte hi use usse pyaar ho jaata hai. Dekhna yeh hai ki in dono ka astitva aur saaya ek doosre se kaise takraate hain? In dono ka bhagya kaise aapas mein juda hai? Lekin 13 saal baad, Yug galti se use aazaad kar deta hai, aur ab woh purushon aur mahilaon dono ka shikaar karti hai. Uske aatank ke raaj ko kaun rokega? Jaanne ke liye suniye Yakshini

title: MAJBURI MEIN BANDHA EK RISHTA

Lekin Varun aur Deepika ek-doosre se dil se nafrat karte the. Kya is arrange marriage mein kabhi pyaar panap payega? Team - Aditya Sinha, Saurav Chatterjee.

title: LOVE AFTER REBIRTH
d: Apnon ke dhoke ka shikaar hokar sena adhikari Aarya Sinha ko berahmi se pratadit kiya gaya aur maar daala gaya. Lekin ab unhone punarjanm liya hai aur apne dushmanon se badla lene ke liye wapas lautti hain. Kya woh haalaaton ko palatkar apne bete ko bacha payengi? Kya unke pati Dr. Shivay Maheshwari is safar mein unki madad karenge? Kya yeh punarjanm unhe ek saath laayega aur unke beech pyaar panpega? Yeh toh samay hi batayega!

title: DOBARA A TALE OF AFTERLIFE
d: Ishan jab 18 saal ke the tab unke mata-pita ka dehant ho gaya tha. Unke vistaarit parivaar ne unki virasat mein mili saari sampatti aur dhan loot liya aur unki behen ko aatmahattya karne ke liye prerit kiya. Use jeevan ka doosra mauka milta hai jab 30 saal ki umra mein uski mrityu ho jaati hai aur uski aatma apne 18 saal ke shareer mein wapas chali jaati hai. Toh kya is baar, kya woh apne naye jeevan mein wahi galti karne se bach payega?
